## origin_default_nomadic_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin_default_nomadic_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

历经纷争与胜利，这个社会终于实现了所有年轻文明的夙愿：人民团结一心，通往群星的道路已然敞开，他们共同的使命由一艘强大的方舟巨舰承载，传遍银河。

## origin_mechanists_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin_mechanists_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这一文明自蒸汽时代早期便醉心于金属制自动机器人的理念。尽管许多人认为不可能做到，早在初步的太空航行前第一台真正的机器人就已从装配线下线。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:52`

### English

This civilization has been preoccupied with the idea of metallic automatons since the early Steam Age. Although many said it could not be done, the first true robots left the assembly lines long before even rudimentary space flight was achieved.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:60`

## origin_syncretic_evolution_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin_syncretic_evolution_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一种第二物种形成了这个文明密不可分的一部分。它们高大健壮，又大都只有相当于格外愚钝的孩童的智力。古老的战争剔除了它们物种具有的最富攻击性的倾向，使其如今相当顺从。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:55`

### English

A second species forms an integral part of this civilization. They are big, strong, and most of them have the intelligence of a particularly dim-witted child. Ancient wars have culled their species of their most aggressive tendencies, leaving them quite servile.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:63`

## origin_post_apocalyptic_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin_post_apocalyptic_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

历经核子烈焰的考验，这一文明曾面临全面灭绝的威胁——又最终死里逃生。虽经毁灭却仍为一体，他们在旧世界的灰烬之上重建了文明。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:64`

### English

Baptized by nuclear fire, this civilization has faced total annihilation - and survived. Devastated yet unbroken, they have rebuilt civilization from the ashes of their old world.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:72`

## origin_post_apocalyptic_machines_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin_post_apocalyptic_machines_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在一场毁灭性的核灾难之后，这些机器就成为这个一度繁荣的文明的唯一幸存者。通过继续履行其原定的目标，它们从旧世界的不适宜居住的灰烬中逐渐重建起一个新的社会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:67`

### English

In the aftermath of a devastating nuclear disaster, these machines emerged as the sole survivors of a once-flourishing civilization. By continuing to fulfill their designated purpose, they gradually rebuilt society from the uninhabitable ashes of their old world.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:75`

## feda.5.a.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afeda.5.a.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在[mega_shipyard_system.GetName]发现一巨大的外星设计的建筑。尽管它已经老化，我们的科学家还是确定这一巨型结构实际上是几个造船船坞的组合体——一个§Y$mega_shipyard_3$§!。\n\n倘若我们获取了如何修复巨型结构的知识和工业能力，我们的生产能力将会极大地提升。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:172`

### English

In the vast reaches of the [mega_shipyard_system.GetName] system rests a vast structure of alien design. Despite its decrepit state, our scientists confirms that the megastructure is in fact a combination of several construction yards - a §Y$mega_shipyard_3$§!.\n\nIf we were to acquire the knowledge on how to repair this magnificent, industrial facility, our production capabilities would increase immensely.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:190`

## feda.5.b.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afeda.5.b.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在[mega_shipyard_system.GetName]发现一巨大的§Y$mega_shipyard_3$§!结构——和我们建造的设计相似。尽管其已老化无法使用，但只需充足的资源，我们应该就能将其恢复至运作状态！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:173`

### English

In the vast reaches of the [mega_shipyard_system.GetName] system rests a vast §Y$mega_shipyard_3$§! structure - similar to that of our own design. The megastructure is in a decrepit state, however, and needs extensive repairs in order to be brought back online.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:191`

## feda.5.c.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afeda.5.c.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

对周围空间的快速扫描显示，巨型结构在数百万年前遭受了某种严重的功率过载，这可能是某种大规模能量风暴穿行星系所造成的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:174`

### English

A quick scan of surrounding space ascertained that the megastructure eons ago suffered from some kind of severe power overload, likely due to some kind of massive energy storm passing through the system.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:192`

## START_SCREEN_SRW

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_SRW&lang=en)

### 中文

在历史的长河中我们早已遗忘我们的人民是如何来到[GetHomeWorldName]的。我们只知道在大约2000年前，一场难以置信的巨大灾变摧毁了环形世界的大部分，罹难者不计其数，而我们则从这片废墟当中站了起来。\n\n我们的文明茁壮成长，如今已准备好探索星海——无论是初次，还是又一次如此。尽管我们已有了长足的进步，然而想要理解并修复我们的环形世界家园，仍然还有很长的路要走。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:189`

### English

If we ever knew how our people arrived on [GetHomeWorldName] our histories have long forgotten it. What we do know is that just over 2000 years ago some inconceivable cataclysm destroyed much of the Ring and killed most of the population, and that our people eventually rose from those ruins.\n\nOur civilization has grown, flourished, and now stands ready to explore the galaxy, whether again or for the first time. But despite all our progress, we still have a long way to go before we can understand and repair the Ringworld which is our home.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:210`

## START_SCREEN_REMNANTS

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_REMNANTS&lang=en)

### 中文

曾经，我们的帝国横亘虚空。曾经，我们的舰队驰骋星河。而后我们衰败，我们陨落。最终，历经千年的涤罪，我们将重返繁星之间！终于，我们的文明重建到了足以开始星际旅行的地步，星海将再次成为我们的囊中之物！\n\n我们的[GetHomeWorldName]上许多的区域仍是废墟一片，清理这些区域将发掘出遗失的资源或遗落的科技。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:190`

### English

Once, our Empire spanned the void. Once, our fleets controlled much of the galaxy. Then came defeat and The Fall. Finally, after millennia of purgatory, it is time to return to the stars! At long last our civilization has rebuilt to the point of interstellar travel. The galaxy shall be ours again!\n\nSeveral regions on [GetHomeWorldName] are still ruined, clearing these areas may reveal lost resources and forgotten technology.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:212`

## START_SCREEN_TREE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_TREE&lang=en)

### 中文

当我们的集体意识觉醒的一刻起，我们便效忠于生命之树。生命之树亦回馈于我们。我们照料它、培育它、保护它，而生命之树哺育了我们。以生命之树之名，我们遍布[GetHomeWorldName]，所到之处，我们播种并保护生命之树的枝桠。\n\n如今我们的星球已侍奉生命之树长达数个世纪，并将继续侍奉下去。当我们意识到一些潜在的危险足以摧毁整个星球时，我们担心生命之树并非处于完全的安全之中。我们早已知道这并非唯一的星球，星海中充斥着无数没有生命之树的行星，而我们渴望改变这一状况。生命之树当被续存，广为散播，生生不息。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:191`

### English

When our collective consciousness awoke, we served the Tree. And the Tree served us. We care for the Tree, feed the Tree, protect the Tree, and the Tree nurtures us. For the sake of the Tree we spread out over [GetHomeWorldName], planting and protecting offshoots of the Tree wherever we went.\n\nOur world has served the Tree for centuries now, and yet, we fear the Tree is not entirely safe as we have learned something of the dangers which may destroy a planet. We have long known that this is not the only world; the galaxy is filled with Treeless planets, and we yearn to change this. The Tree must be protected. The Tree must spread. The Tree must Grow.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:214`

## START_SCREEN_LITHOID

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_LITHOID&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管关于我们的起源（肇始）无处可寻，可以确定的是我们那尚未开智的先祖们是随着一颗庞大的陨石来到[GetHomeWorldName]的，陨石撞击带来了烈焰与灾难，星球上的土著居民大多未能幸免。\n\n千万年已经过去，最初的[GetSpeciesName]逐渐遍布[GetHomeWorldName]全球，不断进化，繁衍生息。我们的文明不断传播并走向繁荣，随着[GetStartingDrive]的发明，我们已准备好探索这片星海。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:192`

### English

While our true origins are unknown, we do know that our presapient ancestors arrived on a vast meteorite which slammed into [GetHomeWorldName] in a fiery cataclysm and wiped out most of the native inhabitants.\n\nIn the eons since, the first primitive [GetSpeciesName] spread out over [GetHomeWorldName], evolved, and multiplied. Our civilization has spread and prospered, and with the invention of the [GetStartingDrive] we stand ready to explore the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:216`

## CLICK_TO_LEAVE_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACLICK_TO_LEAVE_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

§L如果你退出$GALACTIC_COMMUNITY$，你将不再获得任何生效修正的收益，并且在§R20年§!内无法重新加入，且£diplo_weight£外交权重会遭受减益。\n\n而另一方面，你也不再会因违反星系法受到任何负面影响。§!\n

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:223`

### English

§LIf you leave the $GALACTIC_COMMUNITY$ you will no longer receive benefits from any Active Modifiers, but will be unable to rejoin and have reduced £diplo_weight£ Diplomatic Weight for §R20 years§!.\n\nYou will, however, also no longer be negatively affected by being in breach of any galactic laws§!\n

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:253`

### 中文

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:358`

### English

§E§HCohesion§! symbolizes how unified our Federation is and ranges from $NRANGE|Y$ to $PRANGE|Y$.\n§HNegative Impacts§! are caused by the number of different §HEthics§!. Opposing ethics have a worse impact.\n§HTemporary negative§! impacts are caused by members joining and leaving.\n\n§HAdd Officials§! to boost monthly cohesion.§!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:416`

我们渴求所有邻邦的友谊。若友谊的桥梁受到邻邦顽固的现政权阻碍，我们可以且理应推翻其现政权，扶持一个新的。

Greater Purpose

我们不需要再对我们在联邦中的地位产生焦虑和怀疑。当我们被问起“我们该准备多少来提供给你们？”，都将会是一个回答，“我全都要”。

## research_share_2_desc

每一个成员种族都有他们自己的分类学基准，元素周期表还有其他用于知识交流的工具。设立一套通用的术语词典，灵感传递的误差将被缩至最小。

一件从没离开过故乡的伟大发明是有着学术或社会价值的限制的。我们将鼓励这种创新性的生产许可来促进发明的传播。

我们普及到每个民众的资料库已经成为了我们的科技圣典，其中包含着我们所有成员物种的累计知识。即使被人遗忘或者帝国沦陷，我们的资料库也将会继续记录着他们的知识。

构建真正繁荣健康的竞争商业环境始于消除各恒星系间商品与服务流动的阻碍。大局效率胜于短期的局部经济争端。

### 中文

正如于前超光速时代在我们各自的母星上所做过的一样，我们现在必须统一出一套度量时间、距离及价值的星系标准。

## trade_value_3_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Atrade_value_3_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

联盟成员国间和平而互惠互利的合作逐渐构建起了消费者行为中的某种“品牌忠诚”。我们的公民，无需另行鼓动，便似乎更愿意从其他成员国购买商品，因为他们知道利润的大部分将会间接回馈给他们自己。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:798`

Peaceful and mutually profitable cooperation between league member states has, over time, built up a form of 'brand loyalty' in consumer behavior. Our citizens, without much prompting, just seem to prefer to buy from other league members - knowing that much of the benefit will indirectly return to themselves.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:889`

## resolution_ecology_recycling_initiatives_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_ecology_recycling_initiatives_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

如果尽可能地减少浪费并推广循环利用，我们每个人都会受益。在[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]中的国家间共建再利用规程对我们都有好处。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1045`

## resolution_ecology_natural_sanctuaries

### English

Natural Sanctuaries

## resolution_ecology_natural_sanctuaries_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_ecology_natural_sanctuaries_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们应该将自然区域像花园一样保护起来，这样我们的国民就能去那里远离烦恼。重工业将受到少许限制，但这不会有太大影响。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1047`

### English

We should preserve natural spaces as parks, where citizens can escape from their troubles. Minor restrictions to heavy industry are required, but it's a low price to pay.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1171`

## resolution_ecology_integrated_gardens_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_ecology_integrated_gardens_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

通过鼓励公民自耕自食，并强制推广易用的水耕设备，我们可以减少对环境的影响，增加绿化率。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1049`

### English

By encouraging our citizens to grow their own food and mandating easy to use hydroponic systems, we can reduce our impact on the worlds we live in and enjoy more greenery.

## resolution_ecology_environmental_control_board_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_ecology_environmental_control_board_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

工业界不会进行自我监察。因而我们需要一个跨国环境控制委员会，赋予其监督工业和建设的权力，以制止对环境的破坏。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1053`

### English

Industry cannot regulate itself. We need a multinational environmental control board with the power to oversee industry and development to shut down environmental abuse.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1178`

## resolution_ecology_environmental_control_board_tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_ecology_environmental_control_board_tooltip&lang=en)

### 中文

禁止建造§Y都市星球§!，且除改造为§Y盖亚星球§!外，§R禁止§!对行星的一切§Y环境改造§!。禁止使用§Y$arkship_stellar_ignition$§!以及使用§Y$dyson_gun_0$§!改变行星的大气温度。\n§Y环境主义帝国§!从自然存在的障碍中获取的£unity£$unity$：§G+2§!£unity£

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1054`

### English

Converting planets into an §YEcumenopolis§! or §YTerraforming§! them into anything other than a §YGaia World§!, using §Y$arkship_stellar_ignition$§!, and firing a §Y$dyson_gun_0$§! that alters a planet's temperature, are §Rbanned§!.\n£unity£ $unity$ from Naturally Occuring Blockers for §YEnvironmentalist Empires§!: §G+2§! £unity£

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1179`

通过细心呵护我们赖以生存的世界，我们可以与环境和谐相处。我们的目标应是：在踏足过的地方，除回忆以外，什么痕迹都不留下。

## resolution_galacticstudies_advanced_xenostudies_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_galacticstudies_advanced_xenostudies_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

宇宙中的各种文明身上还有许多值得我们学习的地方。我们应当在所有的恒星基地上增设信息获取仪器，以与太空城邦进行更密切的交流合作。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1081`

### English

There is much to learn from all of the cultures of the universe. We should add additional information-gathering instrumentation to all starbases while working more closely with Enclaves.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1217`

## resolution_galacticstudies_advanced_xenostudies_tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_galacticstudies_advanced_xenostudies_tooltip&lang=en)

### 中文

观测站在§Y观测§!前超光速文明时可以产出更多的£society£§H社会学研究点数§!。\n\n增强§Y$sm_art_college$§!、§Y$sm_curator_think_tank$§!、§Y$sm_salvager_workshop$§!以及§Y$sm_mercenary_garrison$§!等恒星基地建筑的效果。\n\n§Y取缔人工智能§!和§Y$interference_not_allowed$§!政策将被§R禁止§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1082`

### English

Observation Posts provide additional £society£ §HSociety Research§! while §YObserving§! pre-FTL civilizations.\n\nEnhances the effectiveness of the §Y$sm_art_college$§!, §Y$sm_curator_think_tank$§!, §Y$sm_salvager_workshop$§!, and §Y$sm_mercenary_garrison$§! starbase buildings.\n\nThe §YArtificial Intelligence Outlawed§! and §Y$interference_not_allowed$§! policies are §Rbanned§!.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1218`

### English

## resolution_galacticstudies_ethical_guideline_refactoring_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_galacticstudies_ethical_guideline_refactoring_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

追寻更加深刻的科学原理，将我们从陈腐的伦理观念的禁锢中解放出来，是我们崇高的责任。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1084`

### English

To possess the ability to further science provides a moral imperative to do so, free from outdated ethical concepts that restrain us. We do what we must because we can.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1221`

## resolution_galacticstudies_ethical_guideline_refactoring_tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_galacticstudies_ethical_guideline_refactoring_tooltip&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y$research_restriction_dangerous_forbidden$§!政策被§R禁止§!。\n启用§Y$research_restriction_dangerous_encouraged$§!政策。\n所有帝国必须使用各自允许的最高级别的§Y领袖增强§!政策，否则将处于§R违反星系法§!状态！\n\n§Y平等主义§!帝国可能无法满足这一要求，因此也将处于§R违反星系法§!状态！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1085`

### English

The §Y$research_restriction_dangerous_forbidden$§! policy is §Rbanned§!.\nEnables the §Y$research_restriction_dangerous_encouraged$§! policy.\nEmpires must use the most powerful §YLeader Enhancement§! policy available to them or be in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!!\n\nEmpires that are §YEgalitarian§! may be unable to meet this requirement and will be in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1222`

### 中文

## resolution_industry_collective_waste_management_desc

### 中文

与其强制每间工厂都肩负起处理自己产生的废弃物的责任，不如去指定特定区域来储存我们发展过程中产生的废物。

## resolution_commerce_buzzword_standardization_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_commerce_buzzword_standardization_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们应该使得我们的企业之间可以进行无缝的对接交流。有目的地简化沟通术语可以让中介工作更加有效，更易于达成关键的指标。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1154`

### English

We have to enable our enterprises to work seamlessly with one another. Streamlining strategic communications empowers our agents, making hitting key performance metrics easier.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1313`

## resolution_commerce_leveraged_privateering

## resolution_commerce_leveraged_privateering_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_commerce_leveraged_privateering_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

贸易流动如同星系的血液。整个[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的所有成员应当共同组成一支跨国的星际武装以镇压海盗及其他对自由贸易的威胁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1156`

### English

Trade is the lifeblood of the galaxy. All members of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] should contribute to a multinational space force to combat piracy and other threats to free commerce.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1316`

## resolution_commerce_underdeveloped_system_utilization

### English

## resolution_commerce_underdeveloped_system_utilization_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_commerce_underdeveloped_system_utilization_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

对我们影响力范围内的星系而言，如果无法最大限度榨取其中的价值将是一种极大的浪费和罪恶。我们建议强制执行前述标准，并且对不达标者进行相应的处罚。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1158`

### English

Failure to extract maximum value from the systems within our sphere of influence is a criminal waste. We propose that it be enforced as such and punished accordingly.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1319`

为了构建更优化的物流输出，我们应当齐心协力共创便捷的星系级基础设施，以提高商贸和信息共享的效率。

## resolution_greatergood_greater_than_ourselves_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_greatergood_greater_than_ourselves_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经要民众付出了许多，但有时我们必须要他们付出更多。我们应该嘉奖那些将国家置于自身需求之上，自愿开拓边陲的人们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1187`

### English

We ask much of our people, but sometimes we must ask more. We should reward those who are willing to place the Empire above their own needs and volunteer to head to the frontier.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1359`

## resolution_greatergood_greater_than_ourselves_tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_greatergood_greater_than_ourselves_tooltip&lang=en)

### 中文

解锁新法令，该法令鼓励失业的自由人口自行迁移至帝国内适合自己且拥有住房与岗位的星球。\n\n§Y基本保障§!与§Y阶层经济§!生活标准将§R被禁止§!。\n\n§Y奴隶劳工§!，§Y牲口§!与§Y电网融合§!奴隶类型将§R被禁止§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1188`

### English

Unlocks an edict that encourages free unemployed pops to voluntarily resettle themselves to suitable planets with jobs and housing within our empire.\n\n§YBasic Subsistence§! and §YStratified Economy§! living standards are §Rbanned§!.\n\n§YChattel Slavery§!, §YLivestock§!, and §YGrid Amalgamation§! slavery types are §Rbanned§!.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1360`

## federations.10010.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations.10010.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着这些权利在刚刚的[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]议案中通过，我们同时要求工人们承担更多的责任。\n\n我们现在可以鼓励失业工人自行迁移到我们控制的其他拥有足够住房，岗位的宜居星球。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1193`

### English

Alongside the rights enshrined in recent [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] resolutions, we ask additional responsibilities of our workers.\n\nWe can now encourage unemployed workers to voluntarily resettle to other worlds we control that have available housing, jobs, and are of adequate habitability.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1365`

## federations.10010.desc_gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations.10010.desc_gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经通过了给予工作子个体更多权限的法规。\n\n尽管这对我们来说没有什么太大的意义，但是我们至少可以从他们为了转运空闲简单子个体而造的基础设施中稍稍获益。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1194`

### English

The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed regulations granting additional privileges for their worker drones.\n\nWhile this is largely meaningless to us, we can at least benefit from some of the infrastructure they have created in order to resettle inactive simple drones.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1366`

## federations.10010.desc_wilderness

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations.10010.desc_wilderness&lang=en)

### 中文

[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经通过了给予劳工更多权益的法规。\n\n尽管这对我们来说没有什么太大的意义，但是我们至少可以从他们为了安置空闲子个体和劳工们而造的基础设施中稍稍获益。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1195`

### English

The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed regulations granting additional privileges for their workers.\n\nWhile this ruling is largely meaningless to us, we can derive some token benefit from the infrastructure they created for resettling their own inactive drones and laborers.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1367`

## resolution_greatergood_balance_in_the_middle

### 中文

不偏不倚

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1196`

### English

Balance in the Middle

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1369`

## resolution_greatergood_balance_in_the_middle_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_greatergood_balance_in_the_middle_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们必须消除一切形式的不平等，不惜一切必要的手段创造公平，绝不允许朱门酒肉臭，路有冻死骨的情况发生。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1197`

### English

We must tackle inequality in all of its forms, enforcing fairness by any means necessary. What good is a feast if you have already had enough, and why should it go to waste when your neighbor is hungry?

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1370`

## resolution_greatergood_balance_in_the_middle_tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_greatergood_balance_in_the_middle_tooltip&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y基本保障§!，§Y阶层经济§!，§Y体面标准§!以及§Y学术特权§!生活标准将§R被禁止§!。\n\n任何形式的§Y奴隶制度§!都将§R被禁止§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1198`

### English

§YBasic Subsistence§!, §YStratified Economy§!, §YDecent Conditions§!, and §YAcademic Priviledge§! living standards are §Rbanned§!.\n\n§YSlavery§! of all types is §Rbanned§!.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1371`

## resolution_greatergood_universal_prosperity_mandate

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_greatergood_universal_prosperity_mandate&lang=en)

### 中文

共同富裕

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1199`

### English

Universal Prosperity Mandate

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1373`

## resolution_greatergood_universal_prosperity_mandate_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_greatergood_universal_prosperity_mandate_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

如果连横跨许多文明的星系都无法供养我们的全体人民，那么我们其实已经失职了。每个人都有追求任何事物的权利。我们应当进行额外的行动来再分配过量的财富，从而改善全体人民的生活。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1200`

### English

If our galaxy spanning civilizations cannot provide for all of our people, then we have failed them. There is no excuse for anyone in the galaxy to want for anything. We should additionally act to redistribute excess wealth for the betterment of all.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1374`

## resolution_greatergood_universal_prosperity_mandate_tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_greatergood_universal_prosperity_mandate_tooltip&lang=en)

### 中文

除§Y同甘共苦§!，§Y乌托邦式富足§!、§Y员工所有制§!、§Y化学极乐§!以及§Y强制调养§!之外的生活标准将§R被禁止§!。\n\n§Y同化§!有机人口将其整合进§Y同化斗士§!或者§Y蜂巢思维§!帝国的行为将§R被禁止§!。\n\n非§Y平等主义§!帝国或§Y失控机仆§!帝国有可能无法满足上述要求，因此也将处于§R违反星系法§!状态！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1201`

### English

All living standards other than §YShared Burdens§!, §YEmployee Ownership§!, §YUtopian Abundance§!, §YChemical Bliss§!, or §YMandatory Pampering§! are §Rbanned§!.\n\n§YAssimilating§! organics into a §YDriven Assimilator§! or §YHive Mind§! empire is §Rbanned§!.\n\nEmpires that are not §YEgalitarian§! or §YRogue Servitors§! may be unable to meet these requirements and will be in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1375`

## resolution_mutualdefense_the_readied_shield_desc

### 中文

## resolution_mutualdefense_military_readiness_act_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_mutualdefense_military_readiness_act_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的每位成员不论为自己还是为他人都有义务为星系防御贡献一份力量。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1223`

### English

Each member of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has a duty to themselves and to others to contribute to galactic defense.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1405`

## resolution_mutualdefense_military_readiness_act_tooltip

### 中文

[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]中舰队数量未达到海军容量一半的非附庸成员将处于§R违反星系法§!状态。

### English

[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] members that are not vassals of another empire that are using less than half of their naval capacity are in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1406`

## resolution_mutualdefense_enemy_of_my_enemy

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_mutualdefense_enemy_of_my_enemy&lang=en)

### 中文

你的敌人就是我的敌人

### English

The Enemy of My Enemy

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1408`

## resolution_mutualdefense_enemy_of_my_enemy_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_mutualdefense_enemy_of_my_enemy_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

与我们当中某位为敌就是与我们全体为敌。如果成员之一遭到进攻，我们难道不应该动用一切力量来惩罚入侵者吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1226`

### English

An enemy of one is the enemy of all. If one of our number is attacked, should we not permit any of our number to punish the offender?

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1409`

## resolution_mutualdefense_enemy_of_my_enemy_tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_mutualdefense_enemy_of_my_enemy_tooltip&lang=en)

### 中文

对向我[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]成员发起侵略战争的未处于[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]之内的国家获得§Y反击§!宣战理由。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1227`

### English

Grants the §Y'Counterattack'§! casus belli on empires that are not [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] members and are in an offensive war against a [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] member.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1410`

## resolution_mutualdefense_castigation_proclamation_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_mutualdefense_castigation_proclamation_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

不与我们为伍者即是敌人，而所有胆敢对抗星系法的国家必须得到他们应有的惩罚。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1229`

### English

Those who are not with us are against us, and all who stand against Galactic Law must be punished.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1413`

## resolution_mutualdefense_castigation_proclamation_tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_mutualdefense_castigation_proclamation_tooltip&lang=en)

### 中文

所有[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]成员能够提出议案以§Y谴责§!处于§R违反星系法§!状态的成员或是未处于[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]之内的国家。\n\n启用§Y无限制战争§!的帝国将能对被[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]所§R谴责§!的国家或是处于§R违反星系法§!状态的成员使用§Y敌意§!宣战理由及§Y羞辱§!战争目标。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1230`

### English

Any Empire in the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] can propose a resolution to §YDenounce§! an Empire in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! or that is not a [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] member.\n\nThe §Y'Animosity'§! casus belli and §Y'Humiliation'§! wargoal can be used by empires with §YUnrestricted Wars§! against empires that have been §RDenounced§! by the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] or are in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1414`

## resolution_mutualdefense_castigation_denouncement

### 中文

征讨

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1231`

### English

Castigation

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1415`

## resolution_mutualdefense_castigation_denouncement_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_mutualdefense_castigation_denouncement_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

对目标帝国发出正式的谴责声明。该行为可以非[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的国家或违反星系法的帝国为目标发起。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1232`

### English

A formal declaration denouncing the target empire. This proposal can target any empire that is either not a member of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] or is in Breach of Galactic Law.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1416`

## resolution_mutualdefense_renegade_containment

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_mutualdefense_renegade_containment&lang=en)

### 中文

### English

## resolution_mutualdefense_renegade_containment_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_mutualdefense_renegade_containment_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]成员国资格的益处不言而喻，拒绝成为成员国的行为本身就彰露出明显的恶意。各成员国应当获得授权，在那些非成员国实现他们的密谋之前用武力抢先阻止任何恶意举动。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1234`

### English

The benefits of membership in the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] are self-evident, and as such refusal to be a member clearly indicates ill intent. Members should be authorized to preempt any nefarious acts with force before non-members enact their plots.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1419`

## resolution_mutualdefense_renegade_containment_tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_mutualdefense_renegade_containment_tooltip&lang=en)

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1235`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1420`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_rulesofwar_repeal_1_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1239`

### English

Might makes right. Attempting to hide the horrors of war by placing limits on it is just lying to ourselves. We should repeal these laws and untie our hands should a true threat appear.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1427`

## resolution_rulesofwar_guardian_angels_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_rulesofwar_guardian_angels_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

将自己的生命奉献给维护我们殖民地和平的士兵必须被人们铭记和尊敬。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1254`

### English

The soldiers that dedicate their lives to keeping our colonies safe should be recognized and honored.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1447`

## resolution_rulesofwar_reverence_for_life

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_rulesofwar_reverence_for_life&lang=en)

### 中文

敬畏生命

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1255`

### English

Reverence for Life

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1449`

## resolution_rulesofwar_reverence_for_life_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_rulesofwar_reverence_for_life_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

星际级帝国之间的战争是一种可怕的东西。我们应该尽一切可能避免被卷入这样的直接战斗当中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1256`

### English

The horror of war on the scale of interstellar empires is a terrible thing. We should do what we can to limit its excesses to active combatants.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1450`

## resolution_rulesofwar_reverence_for_life_tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_rulesofwar_reverence_for_life_tooltip&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y净化§!（驱逐以外）和§Y地爆天星§!被§R禁止使用§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1257`

### English

§YPurging§! (other than Displacement) and the use of §YWorld Crackers§! is §Rbanned§!.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1451`

## resolution_rulesofwar_independent_tribunals

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_rulesofwar_independent_tribunals&lang=en)

### 中文

独立军事法庭

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1258`

### English

Independent Tribunals

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1453`

## resolution_rulesofwar_independent_tribunals_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_rulesofwar_independent_tribunals_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

士兵犯下的罪行必须伸张正义，平民伤亡必须予以考虑。我们应该建立独立的法庭来调查、审判和惩治战争罪行。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1259`

### English

Justice must occur for crimes soldiers commit, and civilian casualties must be accounted for. We should set up independent tribunals to investigate, try, and punish war crimes.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1454`

## resolution_rulesofwar_independent_tribunals_tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aresolution_rulesofwar_independent_tribunals_tooltip&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y末日审判§!、§Y无差别§!轨道轰炸姿态、使用任何除了§Y安乐天使§!以外的巨像武器、使用§Y$dyson_gun_0$§!以及使用§Y$arkship_exodus_jump$§!均被§R禁止§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1260`

### English

§YArmageddon§! and §YIndiscriminate§! bombardment stances, using any Colossus weapon other than a §YGlobal Pacifier§!, firing the §Y$dyson_gun_0$§!, and using the §Y$arkship_exodus_jump$§! are §Rbanned§!.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:1455`

### English

War should be our last resort when all other forms of diplomacy fail. It should never be a tool that is used for unjustified purposes.

### 中文

## origin.3100.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.3100.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在清理[from.GetName]上的残骸时，我们发现了可以追溯到我们前帝国时期的技术储藏。只需要进行少量的研究工作就可以将此知识重新整合进我们的技术体系中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1707`

### English

While clearing wreckage on [from.GetName] we discovered an ancient cache of technology which dates back to our former empire. Only a minimal amount of research should be required to reintegrate this knowledge into our technology base.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2021`

### English

## origin.3101.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.3101.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[planet.GetName]曾经是[owner.GetName]的一处重要殖民地，它的一些残存基础设施仍然可作为重新殖民行星的基础。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1709`

### English

[planet.GetName] was once an important colony of the [owner.GetName], and some remnants of its infrastructure remain usable as a base to re-colonize the planet.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2023`

## progress.3.desc_lith

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aprogress.3.desc_lith&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的降临对[planet.GetName]无异于一场大灾变。一股巨大的冲击波冲刷了这片没有生命的大陆，由于数百万吨的碎片被抛入大气层，[planet.GetName]的宜居性显著的下降了。我们的殖民者—被安全地包围在陨石的岩石核心—将很快从庇护处走出，并开始安装预制殖民地基础设施。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1710`

### English

Our arrival on [planet.GetName] is nothing short of cataclysmic. A massive shockwave scours a continent clean of life, and the habitability level of [planet.GetName] drops noticeably as megatons of debris are thrown into the atmosphere. Our colonists - encased safely within the rocky core of the meteorite - will soon emerge and begin setting up prefabricated colonial infrastructure.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2025`

## building_embassy_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abuilding_embassy_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该建筑构成了帝国外交活动的核心。\n\n由于必须与政府进行密切的交流，该建筑只能建造在我们的首都。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1776`

### English

This building forms the heart of the Empire's diplomatic efforts.\n\nDue to the need to be close to the seat of government, it can only be built at our Capital.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2114`

## building_grand_embassy

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abuilding_grand_embassy&lang=en)

### English

Grand Embassy Complex

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2115`

## building_grand_embassy_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abuilding_grand_embassy_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

该综合设施意图让见者心生敬畏，以使他们在谈判中更愿意达成共识。\n\n由于必须与政府进行密切的交流，该建筑只能建造在我们的首都。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1778`

### English

The complex is intended to awe the viewer, rendering them more compliant in negotiations.\n\nDue to the need to be close to the seat of government, it can only be built at our Capital.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2116`

### English

## building_corporate_embassy_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Abuilding_corporate_embassy_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

外交，不过是一种将其他政府视作顾客的广告。该机构分析当地的风俗习惯，以更有效地为我们的努力提供指导方向。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1780`

### English

Diplomacy is just advertising to governments instead of to the customer. This office analyzes local customs and trends to more efficiently target our efforts.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2119`

通过在宣传中使用春秋笔法，我们可以操纵舆论，将我们对真理的看法加诸众人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1782`

### English

Through targeted advertisements and propaganda, we can control opinion and make the people agree with our version of the truth.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2121`

## colony.8001.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony.8001.name&lang=en)

### 中文

返祖现象

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1810`

### English

Feral Behavior

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2155`

## colony.8001.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony.8001.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

来自[Planet.GetName]殖民地的报告显示:星球上的“返祖现象”正不断增加。显然相当一部分人口已经表现出迄今为止前所未有的性欲与攻击性，而没人知道这是为什么。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1811`

### English

Reports from our colony on [Planet.GetName] claims that there's been an increase in 'feral behavior'. Apparently parts of the population has expressed hitherto unprecedented levels of lust and aggression, and no one knows why.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2156`

## colony.8001.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony.8001.a&lang=en)

### 中文

继续调查。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1812`

### English

Carry on.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2157`

## colony.8002.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony.8002.name&lang=en)

### 中文

暴力在蔓延

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1813`

### English

Violence on the Rise

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2158`

## colony.8002.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony.8002.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Planet.GetName]上的返祖现象没有要停止的迹象。事实上自从上次报告以来，事态愈演愈烈。滥交与暴力事件每时每刻都在发生，极大部分人口都沦陷其中。 

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1814`

### English

The feral behavior on [Planet.GetName] shows no signs of stopping anytime soon. In fact, it has risen since the last report. Promiscuous and violent acts happen all the time, and a large part of the population seems to be affected. 

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2159`

## colony.8002.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony.8002.a&lang=en)

### 中文

情况正在失控。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1815`

### English

This is getting out of hand.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2160`

## colony.8003.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony.8003.name&lang=en)

### 中文

疯了，都疯了！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1816`

### English

This is Madness!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2161`

## colony.8003.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony.8003.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Planet.GetName]上的情况正在迅速失控。不论造成这场返祖狂潮的罪魁祸首是什么，它都已经感染了惊人数量的当地居民并使得殖民地开始分崩离析。因此，我们要么开始行动，要么就会失去[Planet.GetName]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1817`

### English

The situation on [Planet.GetName] has spiraled out of control. A staggering number of inhabitants are now infected with whatever is causing this feral deluge, and the colony has started to break down because of it. Something needs to be done, or [Planet.GetName] will be lost.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2162`

## colony.8003.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony.8003.a&lang=en)

### 中文

行，那开始吧！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1818`

### English

Well, then do something!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2163`

## colony.8004.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony.8004.name&lang=en)

### 中文

凶猛的孢子

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1819`

### English

Savage Spores

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2164`

## colony.8004.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony.8004.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

对困扰[Planet.GetName]的奇异返祖现象的调查已经完成。我们在遍布整个地壳的洞穴隧道网络中找到了一种神秘的真菌。它长满了整个洞穴——地面，墙壁，天花板，并且蔓延了上千里。\n\n这些真菌频繁地释放孢子排出洞穴，其目的尚不明确。但我们可以肯定正是这些孢子释放了我们物种原始的欲望并使起产生返祖现象。\n\n我们可以为这些真菌找一个用武之地，或是干脆将其全部灭绝。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1820`

### English

The investigation of the strange and wild behavior currently besetting [Planet.GetName] has been completed. In the vast network of cave tunnels that permeates the planet's crust an enigmatic fungus has been found. It grows all over the caves - floor, walls, ceiling - and stretches out for thousands of miles.\n\nThe fungus frequently releases spores that are vented out of the caves - for what purpose has not been established, but we know for certain that it causes primitive behavior in our species, releasing primal urges within.\n\nWe can try to find a useful application of this phenomenon, or we can exterminate the fungus altogether.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2165`

### English

### English

## colony.8005.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony.8005.name&lang=en)

### 中文

冲动之云

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1823`

### English

Cloud and Strife

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2168`

## colony.8005.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony.8005.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

大批工业设备在生长真菌的洞穴系统出口处建造起来。除了过滤并控制这些孢子的传播以外，这些工厂也能将多余的孢子云转化为有用的§H异星天然气§!。\n\n由于[Planet.GetName]上有点饥渴的当地居民更频繁地满足自己的性欲，人口增长速率得以提高。与此同时不幸的是[Planet.GetName]的暴力行为也将更为频繁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1824`

### English

Industrial facilities have been built over the outlets for the fungus-infested cave systems. Apart from filtering and regulating the spread of spores, these plants can also convert any excess spore clouds into useful §Hexotic gases§!.\n\nThe population growth is increased as the somewhat randy inhabitants of [Planet.GetName] satisfy their urges more frequently, which unfortunately also means that the level of violence and conflict is somewhat higher on [Planet.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2169`

## colony.8005.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony.8005.a&lang=en)

### 中文

这是发展的代价。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1825`

### English

That's the price of progress.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2170`

## colony.8006.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony.8006.name&lang=en)

### 中文

净化之焰

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1826`

### English

The Cleansing Flames

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2171`

## colony.8006.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony.8006.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

将洞穴蘑菇彻底燃尽的计划现在已经完成，这些激发原始冲动的菌类现在已经被彻底铲除。\n\n碰巧的是，许多被清理过后的洞穴被发现原来潜藏着高品质的矿脉，现在也可以被我们更加妥善地利用了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1827`

### English

The project to incinerate all Cave Mushrooms have now been completed and the primal urge-inducing fungus has been exterminated.\n\nAs luck would have it, several of the burned-out caves turned out to have rich mineral veins, which can now be exploited further.

科研船检测到了一条从[From.Planet.GetName]发射出的怪异读数。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1875`

### English

The Science Ship has picked up a strange reading emanating from [From.Planet.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2232`

## fedev.9430.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.9430.name&lang=en)

### 中文

深渊灯塔

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1876`

### English

Beacon in the Depth

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2233`

## fedev.9430.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.9430.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

只有通过考古论证和想象才能在如今已经荒芜的[From.Planet.GetName]表面上重构出那个曾经繁盛一时的文明。岁月的流逝是残酷无情的，即使是曾经最为坚不可摧的建筑，如今也只化作一地的尘埃。\n\n但在那深不可测的地下，有一个怪异的信号正在脉动着。一座神秘的信标仿佛呼唤着我们的调查和发掘。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1877`

### English

Only through archaeological proof and imagination can one depict a once flourishing civilization on the now desolate surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. So unkind has the passage of time been, that even the sturdiest buildings have been grinded down to little more than dust.\n\nBut from deep underground a strange signal is pulsing. A mysterious beacon yearning for investigation and uncovering.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2234`

## fedev.9435.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.9435.name&lang=en)

### 中文

时日无多

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1878`

### English

Running out of Time

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2235`

## fedev.9435.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.9435.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

当挖掘团队越来越接近深处的信标时，无法忽视的死亡感触突然神秘地在挖掘团队中蔓延。随着更多的泥土和石头被清除，一个坚定的观念在每个人的脑海中徘徊：\n\n生命转瞬即逝。总有一天这一切都会结束……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1879`

### English

A sudden and undeniable sense of mortality has mysteriously crept upon the excavation team as they get closer to the beacon in the depths. As more dirt and rock is removed, an unescapable notion lingers in the back of everyone's mind:\n\nLife is fleeting. Someday all this is going to end...

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2236`

## fedev.9440.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.9440.name&lang=en)

### 中文

无比明亮

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1880`

### English

So very, very brightly

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2237`

## fedev.9440.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.9440.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

信号来源是一座外星墓碑，上面镌刻着奇异的符号。翻译文本充其量只算是略有眉目。这些符号提及了一位举足轻重的人物，其一生的伟业值得铭记与崇拜，整个文明都处于哀伤之中。翻译文本接近末尾时变得十分怪异，诉说体液因悲伤从身体中流出，随后又因天气条件而消逝。\n\n只有全文的最后一部分得到了成功翻译：\n\n§H‘死亡的时刻到了。’§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1881`

### English

The source of the signal is an alien tombstone inscribed with strange symbols. The translation is sketchy at best. It speaks of a person of great importance, of a life's work worthy of remembrance and veneration, and of a civilization in mourning. Towards the end the translation becomes very odd, speaking of grief-induced leakage of bodily-fluids, and their subsequent dissipation due to weather conditions.\n\nOnly the very last part was successfully translated:\n\n§H'Time to die.'§!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2238`

## lost_moment_memento

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Alost_moment_memento&lang=en)

### 中文

活着真好

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1882`

### English

A Life Worthwhile

## lost_moment_memento_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Alost_moment_memento_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在考古发现外星人的墓碑之后，帝国的居民变得更加热爱生活了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1883`

### English

Ever since the archaeological uncovering of an alien memorial stone, the Empire's population have started to appreciate life a bit more.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2241`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asite_lesser_messenger&lang=en)

## site_lesser_messenger_intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asite_lesser_messenger_intro&lang=en)

### 中文

对[From.Planet.GetName]详细的调查揭示了一些属于曾经遍布整个行星的文明的微弱信号。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1886`

### English

A closer look at [From.Planet.GetName] shows small signs of a civilization that once populated the planet.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2245`

## fedev.9445.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.9445.name&lang=en)

### 中文

去此万年

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1887`

### English

Since Long Gone

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2246`

## fedev.9445.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.9445.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在[From.Planet.GetName]地表的初步探索揭示了这颗行星曾经确实是某个文明的家园。\n\n然而，荒芜的程度表明这个文明的存在已经是非常非常久的时间以前的事情了，而且它极有可能曾经遭受到某种突然且可怖的力量袭击。残余的废墟还不足以提供关于这种外星人的生理学信息。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1888`

### English

Initial exploration down on [From.Planet.GetName]'s surface reveals that this planet was indeed home to some kind of civilization.\n\nHowever, the level of devastation indicates that it must've been very long ago, and it's quite likely that the civilization was struck by some kind of sudden and terrifying force. There isn't even ruins enough left to get an idea about the aliens' physiology.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2247`

## fedev.9450.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.9450.name&lang=en)

### 中文

深空凶兽

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1889`

### English

Beasts of Space

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2248`

## fedev.9450.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.9450.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

地表探测团队从行星上分离出一条无线电信号。其发信源仍暂时未知，不过已被破译的部分则已经可以开始向我们讲述这个失落已久的文明的故事了。\n\n某种未知的威胁步步逼近这个文明；对技术的进步陷入了集体的沉迷；传言称在星系的其他地方正在建造一艘硕大无朋的宇宙战舰。这些主题在这些杂乱无章的信息里反复地出现。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1890`

### English

The surface team has isolated a radio signal down on the planet. Its origin is still unknown, but translated parts have started to reveal information about the long lost civilization:\n\nSome unidentified and approaching threat to the civilization. A collective fascination with technological advances. Rumours of a giant spaceship being built in another part of the galaxy. These themes are recurring in the scrambled messages.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2249`

## fedev.9455.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.9455.name&lang=en)

### 中文

原型花园

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1891`

### English

Garden of Prototypes

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2250`

## fedev.9455.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.9455.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

考古学家们设法抵达了这个神秘信号的来源——深藏于地面之下。\n\n刚刚开始不久的遗址发掘工作，就已经表明这似乎是某种研发设施。这个地方到处都是高度微缩的多种科学设备原型。\n\n扫描发现在其下还有一个空洞，发掘正在进行当中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1892`

### English

The archaeologists managed to home in the source of the mysterious signal. It came from deep underground.\n\nUnearthing of the site has only just begun, but indications point to some kind of research and development facility. The place is littered with remarkably high-detail miniature prototypes of various technological devices.\n\nScans show a hollow space further down, and excavation is underway.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2251`

## fedev.9460.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.9460.name&lang=en)

### 中文

他们到底在修建什么……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1893`

### English

What are they building...

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2252`

## fedev.9460.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.9460.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的发掘小组有了一个有意思的发现。一组硬盘，里面记录的是作为该设施的核心焦点乃至他们整个文明核心焦点的某个持续运作的项目信息。\n\n据描述，这是一艘§H能与星系间最庞大飞船相抗衡的巨大舰船§!。\n\n他们在这里到底在建造一个什么样的巨大怪物？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1894`

### English

Our excavation team have made an interesting discovery. A collection of miniature hard drives held information about an ongoing project that seems to have been the focal point of this installation, maybe even that of the entire civilization.\n\nIt speaks of a §Hmighty vessel to rival the galaxy's most gargantuan flyer§!.\n\nWhat beast of a machine did they build down here?

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2253`

## fedev.9465.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.9465.name&lang=en)

### 中文

胜者是……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1895`

### English

And the winner is...

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2254`

## fedev.9465.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.9465.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这是一艘“巨大”的宇宙飞船！\n\n好吧，事实证明，至少对于从前[From.Planet.GetName]上的居民来说，这艘飞船其实还蛮大的。那些我们在这里找到的微缩原型机正是飞船本身的机器，而原以为是某种设备的东西，其实是他们的首都。至于在加密信号里提到的“威胁”，实际上是一场太空技术竞赛里的对手。这个微型文明全体聚集至此则是为了尽全力夺取冠军。\n\n不过好像我们才是这次竞赛的获奖者。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1896`

### English

It's a massive spaceship!\n\nWell, at least to the population of [From.Planet.GetName], who - as it turned out - were absolutely tiny. The miniature prototypes found here were apparently their actual machines, and what was assumed to be a facility, was in fact their capitol city. The 'threat' that was mentioned in the scrambled signals turned out to be their opponents in an intergalactic tech competition. This entire mini-civilization came together trying to get the first prize!\n\nSeems as if we are the ones to score the prize this time.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2255`

## fedev.9470.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.9470.name&lang=en)

### 中文

前进，征服

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1897`

### English

Go forth and conquer

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2256`

## fedev.9470.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.9470.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一艘巨大的宇宙飞船被我们发现了！\n\n其实只是对于原先[From.Planet.GetName]上的居民而言这艘飞船很大，因为他们这个物种十分微小。\n\n由于畏惧某种神秘的威胁降临他们的母星，他们整个族群都聚集至此以建造一艘宇宙飞船来应对这迫在眉睫的威胁。\n\n看上去他们还是晚了一步；毕竟他们的攻击舰还留在原地，可他们自己却消失无踪了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1898`

### English

A massive space ship have been discovered!\n\nOr at least it was massive to the population of [From.Planet.GetName], who turned out to be a minuscule species.\n\nFearing a mysterious threat approaching their homeworld, the entire species came together to build a space ship that could take on the impending terror.\n\nThey appear to have been too late; their assault ship is still here, but they're not.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2257`

## fedev.9475.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.9475.name&lang=en)

### 中文

别破坏了信使

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1899`

### English

Don't shoot the messenger

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2258`

## fedev.9475.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.9475.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

真是一艘宏伟的宇宙飞船啊！\n\n一艘宏伟，却又特别小巧的宇宙飞船。这说明[From.Planet.GetName]上的原住民其实是一种微型物种。我们遇到的微缩物件其实是他们的机器，而这个损坏的设备则曾经是一座主要城市。\n\n在听说星系另一端有人建造了一艘庞大的宇宙飞船后，这些生物决定也建造一艘飞船来比肩那个庞然大物。\n\n真是了不得的决心与勇气，当然了，也捎带着一点可爱。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1900`

### English

It's a grand space ship!\n\nA grand, absolutely tiny space ship. As it turns out the population of [From.Planet.GetName] was a mini-species. The miniatures encountered were their actual machines, and this ruined facility was once a major city.\n\nHaving heard of a space ship of great proportions being built in another part of the galaxy, this species decided to build a ship to match the alien behemoth.\n\nIt shows great determination and courage. It's also a little bit cute.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2259`

## LESSENGER_REMODEL_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ALESSENGER_REMODEL_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

能与§Y小信使§!古怪的科技水平与容量相提并论的就是它可笑的规模了。数千个建造它的渺小生物才能塞满飞船，但如果我们想要塞进最小规格的船员还必须要对其进行大规模的改造。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1904`

### English

The extraordinary level of technology and capacity of §YThe Lesser Messenger§! can only be rivaled by it's ridiculous scale. Of the ship's tiny creator species thousands could fit into the vessel, but to fit even a skeleton crew of our species in there is going to require a massive overhaul.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2265`

## name_list_LITH_desc

## START_SCREEN_GALACTIC_DOORSTEP

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_GALACTIC_DOORSTEP&lang=en)

### 中文

几百年前，我们在自己的恒星系发现了一个神秘的构造。由于这个构造颜色发黑，质地金属，我们将其命名为黑王冠，这一宏伟壮观的存在对我们的社会产生了深远的影响——我们全体人民在精神上和追求上达成了统一。\n\n进军太空成为了我们科研圈优先级最高的事宜，而探索这项科技的渴望也给我们带来了其他方面的一系列有益发现。\n\n黑王冠实际上处于休眠状态，但我们学到了很重要的一课；通往哪里并不重要——通往彼方的浩瀚征程本身就是重要的。而现在，得益于黑王冠的宣召——我们一族亦有了造访繁星的手段。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1918`

### English

The mysterious construct in our solar system was discovered a few hundred years ago. Due to its dark, metallic properties the artifact was named The Black Crown, and its majestic presence had profound effect on our society - it unified our people in both spirit and pursuit.\n\nSpace flight became the highest priority of our scientific community, and the eager quest for this technology brought with it a series of other beneficial discoveries.\n\nThe Black Crown turned out to be dormant, but we learned an important lesson; it's not the destination that matters - it's the journey. And now - thanks to the beckoning of the Black Crown - our species has the means by which we can visit the stars.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2283`

## START_SCREEN_GALACTIC_DOORSTEP_MACH

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_GALACTIC_DOORSTEP_MACH&lang=en)

### 中文

几百年前，我们在自己的恒星系发现了一个神秘的构造。由于这个构造颜色发黑，质地金属，我们将其命名为黑王冠，这一遥远壮观的存在对我们的社会产生了深远的影响——我们亟需获得更多相关数据。\n\n进军太空成为了我们科研圈优先级最高的事宜，而探索这项科技的渴望也给我们带来了其他方面的一系列有益发现，而这些发现也相继得以应用。\n\n黑王冠实际上处于休眠状态，但在前往它的过程中，我们的诸多改进和升级项目提高了我们的总生产能力，现在我已经具备了遨游群星的能力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1919`

### English

The mysterious construct in our solar system was discovered a few hundred years ago. Due to its dark, metallic properties the artifact was designated The Black Crown, and its distinct presence had profound effect on our operations - gathering more data became imperative.\n\nSpace flight became the highest priority of our research and development sub-routines, and the process of reaching this alien technology brought with it a series of other beneficial discoveries that were consecutively implemented.\n\nThe Black Crown turned out to be dormant, but the improvements and upgrades applied in order to reach it did increase our general output, and we now have the capacity to visit the stars.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2284`

## START_SCREEN_GALACTIC_DOORSTEP_HIVE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_GALACTIC_DOORSTEP_HIVE&lang=en)

### 中文

几百年前，我们在自己的恒星系发现了一个神秘的构造。由于这个构造颜色发黑，质地金属，我们将其命名为黑王冠，这一宏伟壮观的存在对我们的社会产生了深远的影响——探寻它的本质成为了我们重中之重的任务。\n\n进军太空成为了我们科研圈优先级最高的事宜，而探索这项科技的渴望也给我们带来了其他方面的一系列有益发现，并在过程中让我们得到了磨炼。\n\n黑王冠实际上处于休眠状态，但是这趟旅途并非徒劳。相比过去，如今我们已经有能力探索更加遥远的地方，让我们的文明能够铺枝散叶。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1920`

### English

The mysterious construct in our solar system was discovered a few hundred years ago. Due to its dark, metallic properties the artifact was named The Black Crown, and its majestic presence had profound effect on us - finding out its true nature became paramount.\n\nSpace flight became the highest priority, and the eager quest for this technology brought with it a series of other beneficial discoveries that improved and honed us.\n\nThe Black Crown turned out to be dormant, but it was not a journey done in vain. We now have the means to grow far bigger, reach much further, than ever before.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2285`

## origin.1000.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.1000.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在毫无征兆的情况下，位于我们母星系的神秘外星星门突然间被激活了！一道能量震荡从这座古迹中激射出来，一息之后，一个耀眼的、不断振动的球体填满了这个结构的重心。看来这个先行者文明的遗迹不再如同我们坚信的那样处于休眠状态了。\n\n尽管星门仅仅打开了不过几秒钟，仍然有不少太空残骸从中穿过；经过细致的检查之后，其中的星岩与星尘成为了非常宝贵的资源。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1922`

### English

Without slightest warning the mysterious alien gateway in our home system came alive! An energy surge pulsed out from the artifact, and for a fleeting moment a glowing, vibrating orb filled the center of the structure. This remnant of a former civilization may not be so dormant as previously believed.\n\nAlthough the gateway was open for no longer than a few seconds, it was enough to let through some space debris; rocks and dust that upon closer inspection turned out to be valuable resources.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2288`

## origin.1005.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.1005.name&lang=en)

### 中文

不速之客

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1923`

### English

The Uninvited

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2289`

## origin.1005.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.1005.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

再一次，沉睡的星门突然间激活了！不过这一次来的不是福神——而是灾疫——巨型未知物种直冲我们而来。\n\n一只单个的、能够在太空中存活的生物从耀眼的星门中现身，看上去似乎在四处徘徊。由于其对我们的友好至信或警告没有任何回应，我们必须立马动员起来，将这一威胁铲除！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:1924`

### English

Once again the slumbering gateway has come alive! This time it was not a boon - but rather a bane - that came to us from the great unknown.\n\nA single, space-dwelling creature sprang out of the glowing gateway, and seems to be on the prowl. Answering to no kind of hailing or warning, we should move to eradicate this threat immediately!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2290`

喷射而出
