## TRACKING_THE_PREDATOR_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ATRACKING_THE_PREDATOR_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

通过分析聚变引擎航迹，我们的研究部门可以确定我们的老客人究竟去了哪里，另一方面而言也就意味着我们可以开始追踪了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2139`

### English

By analyzing the fusion drive trail our science department may figure out where our old visitors went, which in turn means that we can initiate a pursuit.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2540`

## INVESTIGATE_SILENT_FREIGHTER_PROJECT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AINVESTIGATE_SILENT_FREIGHTER_PROJECT&lang=en)

### 中文

调查静默的运输船

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2140`

### English

Investigate the Silent Freighter

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2542`

## INVESTIGATE_SILENT_FREIGHTER_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AINVESTIGATE_SILENT_FREIGHTER_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

一艘废弃的货用太空船静静地停在冰冷的太空中。它年代很久，但看上去没有损伤。我们应该派遣一支登陆队进行进一步调查。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2141`

### English

A derelict freighter ship is waiting in the cold of space. It is very old, but seemingly undamaged. We should send a boarding party to investigate closer.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2543`

## OLD_BEACON_PROJECT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AOLD_BEACON_PROJECT&lang=en)

### 中文

分析古老信标

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2142`

### English

Analyzing the Old Beacon

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2545`

## OLD_BEACON_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AOLD_BEACON_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

这个古老结构在有规律地放出能量震荡，期待着有人发现它。为了找出原因，我们必须允许我们的科学家在更近的距离调查。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2143`

### English

Based on the frequent energy pulse emanating from it, this old space structure wants to be found. In order to figure out why we must allow our scientist to take a closer look.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2546`

## rendezvous_with_freighter_poi

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Arendezvous_with_freighter_poi&lang=en)

### 中文

冲入战火

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2144`

### English

Running into the Fire

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2548`

## rendezvous_with_freighter_poi_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Arendezvous_with_freighter_poi_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

根据位于我们母星系的聚变引擎追迹的分析，此处便是古代无情者所在的最终目的地。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2145`

### English

According to the analysis of the fusion drive trail in our home system, this is the destination of Relentless visitors of old.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2549`

## relentless_home_poi

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Arelentless_home_poi&lang=en)

### 中文

找出上古之敌

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2146`

### English

Finding the Old Enemy

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2551`

## relentless_home_poi_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Arelentless_home_poi_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在远古的年代，无情者庞大的舰队在遇到一艘民用货船之后离开了这个恒星系。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2147`

### English

The destination of the massive Relentless fleet which left this system many eons ago, after a strange run-in with a civilian freighter.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2552`

## origin.1405.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.1405.name&lang=en)

### 中文

无知是福

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2148`

### English

Blissfully Ignorant

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2554`

## origin.1405.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.1405.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

科学家们对古旧空间站的调查已经结束。这整个结构是个某种类型的大炮。很久以前，这门大炮开火了，向无情者的母星发射了一股脉冲。那股脉冲我们——[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]一族——十分清楚作用是什么：§Y心智抹除脉冲§!。\n\n为了补偿他们曾经犯下的罪愆，无情者——现在名为§Y$NAME_Vemetosha$§!——对自己使用了这门武器，让他们的整个文明在心智上退回到了土著时代。\n\n这一决定的规模——还有造成的后果——清楚地说明了无情者对于赎罪是多么的严肃。我们能够原谅他们吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2149`

### English

The scientists have finished their investigation of the old space station. The entire structure is a big cannon of sorts. Eons ago it triggered and fired a pulse at the Relentless homeworld - a pulse that we, the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName], know full well: a §YMind-Wipe pulse§!.\n\nIn a quest to redeem themselves from their past sins, the Relentless - now known as the §Y$NAME_Vemetosha$§! - used the weapon on themselves, effectively diminishing their entire civilization.\n\nThe magnitude of such a decision - and the follow-through - stands as testament to how very seriously the Relentless wanted to atone. Can we forgive them?

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2555`

## origin.1410.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.1410.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

将资源和工业装备运送到[From.Planet.GetName]的庞大任务已经结束。接下来就是向地底深处挖掘，建造一个坚固的，能够经历上千年地址变动和岁月风霜侵蚀的构造。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2154`

### English

The massive undertaking to transport resources and industrial equipment to [From.Planet.GetName] has been completed. Next step is to dig deep into the ground and build a structure strong enough to withstand eons of crude weather and tectonic shifts.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2561`

### English

## origin.1415.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.1415.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一个装着资源和科技蓝图的巨大宝箱被埋藏在了[From.Planet.GetName]的表面之下。我们不清楚$NAME_Vemetosha$的子孙们能不能、会在什么时候以及如何发现我们的宝藏，不过我们可以寄与最大的希望。谁知道呢？或许千年之后他们会发现我们太空船的推进航迹，并找到我们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2156`

### English

A tremendous cache of resources and technology blueprints has been buried beneath the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. We have no idea if, when or how our treasure will be discovered by the $NAME_Vemetosha$ descendants, but we can hope for the best. Who knows? Maybe in a thousand years they will find our space ship propulsion trails and come visit us.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2563`

## origin.1420.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.1420.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

宇宙历史中黑暗的一章已经翻过，崭新而光明的篇章则由我们来谱写完成。我们的德政工程仿佛在我们的社会中投下了一颗石子，每一个人的心中都激起了使命感和道德感的涟漪。尽管漆黑的深空仍然深不可测，但也许这个宇宙并非完全是那么地漆黑冰冷。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2158`

### English

A dark chapter of in the history of the universe has ended, and we have written a new one - a brighter chapter. Our benevolent project initiated a ripple effect in our society, each member feeling a sense of purpose and good intent. Maybe space isn't such a dark place after all - the unfathomably vast darkness of the void notwithstanding.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2566`

## fedev.9500.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.9500.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

威震寰宇的主宰已经建成。\n\n这艘行动自如的庞然巨舰将彻底改变进攻作战的范式。它可以在前线建造和维修舰船，并配有足以摧枯拉朽的火力，使我们得以不间断地攻击那些敢与我们作对的人。\n\n如今只有蠢货才会对抗[Owner.GetName]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2174`

### English

The construction of the impressive Juggernaut has been completed.\n\nThis mobile behemoth changes the paradigm of offensive warfare entirely. It can construct and repair ships on the frontline, and is equipped with devastating firepower, allowing for a ceaseless assault of those who dare stand against us.\n\nOnly fools will oppose [Owner.GetName] now.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2587`

### English

## fedev.9505.name

## fedev.9505.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.9505.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

经确认，§H[From.Owner.GetName]§!已经完成了巨型主宰舰的建造。这一行动自如的太空基地装配了海量火力，并能在作战前线建造和维护舰船，使其在任何作战场景下都是更严峻的威胁。\n\n这真的是太空战里的尖端军备。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2178`

### English

It has been verified that §H[From.Owner.GetName]§! has finished the construction of a massive Juggernaut ship. This mobile space base packs extensive firepower and is able to build and maintain ships at the frontline of battle, making it a superior threat in any combat scenario.\n\nIt is truly the apex armament of space war.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2592`

## galcom.2.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agalcom.2.name&lang=en)

### 中文

星海共同体

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2180`

### English

A Galactic Community

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2595`

## galcom.2a.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agalcom.2a.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着越来越多的太空文明彼此间建立了正式的关系，星系之中愈发生机盎然。为了避免国家间出现悲剧性的误解，越来越多的外交人士呼吁设立一个新的泛星系组织——如果愿意的话也可以称为共同体，在那里星系中的各帝国可以召开会议，共商星系大事。\n\n[Root.GetName]应该承诺支持§H星海共同体§!的创立吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2181`

### English

As more and more spacefaring civilizations establish formal relations with one another, the galaxy is becoming a vibrant and lively place. To avoid tragic misunderstandings between nations, an increasing number of diplomats have called for the establishment of a new pan-galactic organization - a community, if you will, where the empires of the galaxy can meet to discuss important matters.\n\nShould the [Root.GetName] pledge its support for the creation of the §HGalactic Community§!?

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2596`

## galcom.2b.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agalcom.2b.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

让我们再试一次。我们应该组建星海共同体吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2182`

### English

Let's try again. Should we form a Galactic Community?

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2597`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2598`

## galcom.5.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agalcom.5.name&lang=en)

### 中文

星海共同体的诞生

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2185`

### English

The Birth of the Galactic Community

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2600`

## galcom.5.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agalcom.5.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这是历史性的一天。星系中数个重要的太空帝国，包括[Root.GetName]，宣布了§H星海共同体§!的创立。这一国家间组织会作为一个论坛，整个星系的事务都可以在此讨论和决定。\n\n作为其创始成员国之一，我们可以为星系历史的这一里程碑感到骄傲。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2186`

### English

This is a historic day. Several of the galaxy's prominent spacefaring empires, including the [Root.GetName], have announced the creation of the §HGalactic Community§!. This supranational organization will serve as a forum where matters involving the entire galaxy can be discussed and decided upon.\n\nAs one of its founding members, we can take pride in this milestone of galactic history.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2601`

## galcom.5.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agalcom.5.a&lang=en)

### 中文

全星系伟大的一天！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2187`

### English

A great day for the galaxy!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2602`

## galcom.6.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agalcom.6.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管我们决定不为建立某种国家间星系机构提供帮助，若干其他帝国已经联合创立了这种东西。在他们“历史性的”联合声明中，他们向全星系宣布了§H星海共同体§!的创立。这一组织的目的是作为一个论坛，会影响星系整体的重要事务可以在那里讨论。\n\n由于我们拒绝参与这一星海共同体的创立，[Root.GetName]将不被算作成员国。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2188`

### English

Despite our decision not to lend our support behind the founding of some sort of supranational galactic institution, several other empires have banded together to create just such a thing. In their "historic" joint announcement, they declared the creation of the §HGalactic Community§! to the galaxy. This organization is to serve as a forum where important matters that affect the galaxy as a whole can be discussed.\n\nAs we refused to take part in the creation of this Galactic Community, the [Root.GetName] is not yet considered a member.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2603`

Should we accept?

## galcom.51.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agalcom.51.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

星海共同体的各个成员国已经投票决定设立星系理事会。这一受人尊敬的实体只允许社群中三个实力最强、最具影响力的帝国成为其成员。到下一轮议会被选出为止，这三个国家将是§H[council_member_1.GetName]§!，§H[council_member_2.GetName]§!和§H[council_member_3.GetName]§!。\n\n共同体期望理事会成员国可以领导和保卫整个星海共同体。他们获得了提权，可以跳过那些时常在大型政治机构中阻碍决策流程的繁文缛节。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2200`

### English

The members of the Galactic Community have voted to establish a Galactic Council. Membership in this august body will be limited to representatives from the three most powerful and influential empires in the Community. Until a new Council is elected, these are the §H[council_member_1.GetName]§!, the §H[council_member_2.GetName]§!, and the §H[council_member_3.GetName]§!.\n\nThe members of the Council are expected to lead and safeguard the Galactic Community. Their increased powers allow them to cut through some of the red tape that so often inhibits the decision-making process in large political institutions.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2616`

### 中文

[galactic_market_station_system.GetName]泛星系贸易市场总部被拆除

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2204`

### English

[galactic_market_station_system.GetName] Stripped of Galactic Market Headquarters

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2621`

## galcom.62.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agalcom.62.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

根据[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]宪章第19条C款，只有一个会员国可以主办泛星系贸易市场。$galcom.62.base$[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]的贸易董事会已提出陈词对该事态表示遗憾。他们允诺，在[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]内新主办国的选举将会很快开始。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2205`

### English

According to article 19C of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s charter, only a member state may host the Galactic Market. $galcom.62.base$ The [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]'s Board of Commerce has issued a statement expressing regret for this state of affairs. They promise that nominations for a new host within the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium] will commence immediately.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2622`

## galcom.62.base

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agalcom.62.base&lang=en)

### 中文

因此，市场在[galactic_market_station_system.GetName]星系的总部已经被拆除。最后一位交易员在今天不情愿地放弃了他们的岗位，哀叹这一戏剧性的——在他们看来——不必要的步骤对星系贸易造成了巨大的破坏。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2206`

### English

As such, the market's headquarters in the [galactic_market_station_system.GetName] system has been dismantled. The last traders reluctantly abandoned their posts today, bemoaning the massive disruption to galactic trade that this dramatic and - in their view - needless step has caused.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2623`

## galcom.63.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agalcom.63.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着[From.GetName]选择离开[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]，我们不得不执行[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]宪章中的一项晦涩难懂的条款，其大意是只有成员国才能主导泛星系贸易市场。$galcom.62.base$对新总部的选址提名已经开始，[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]的商务董事会发布生命对当前形势表示遗憾。他们保障将尽快找到新的主办国。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2209`

### English

With the [From.GetName] opting to leave the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium], an obscure article of the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]'s charter must be applied, to the effect that only a member state may host the Galactic Market. $galcom.62.base$ Nominations for the headquarters' new location have already opened, with the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]'s Board of Commerce expressing regret for this state of affairs. They promise that a new host will be found swiftly.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2626`

## galcom.64.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agalcom.64.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经表态，迁移泛星系贸易市场的新一轮竞争由此展开。位于[market_founder_planet.solar_system.GetName]星系的的市场总部已经开始收尾工作，交易员的关注都集中在未来几年的预测上。他们哀叹这一戏剧性的——且在他们看来并不必要的决定对泛星系贸易造成了巨大的破坏。\n\n总部新址的提名已经开始，[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]的商业委员会发表了一份声明，对这种状况表示遗憾。他们承诺将尽快找到一个新的星系。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2213`

### English

The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has spoken, and a new competition has begun to relocate the Galactic Market. The market's headquarters in the [market_founder_planet.solar_system.GetName] system has begun wind-down operations, with traders focusing solely on forecasts for the next few years. They bemoan the massive disruption to galactic trade that this dramatic and - in their view - needless step has already caused.\n\nNominations for the headquarters' new location have already opened, with the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]'s Board of Commerce issuing a statement expressing regret at this state of affairs. They promise that a new host will be found swiftly.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2630`

## galcom.69.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agalcom.69.name&lang=en)

### 中文

泛星系贸易市场留在原址

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2214`

### English

Galactic Market Remains in Place

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2631`

## galcom.69.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agalcom.69.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们迁移泛星系贸易市场的动议不幸失败。尽管我们的努力争取到了大量口头支持，却没有转化为新地点的足够提名。\n\n这一意见原则上仍然合理：[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]今后还是可以再次提出迁移市场。然而就目前而言，这个商业机构仍然由获利丰厚的[market_founder.GetName]进行管理。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2215`

### English

Our motion to relocate the Galactic Market has unfortunately failed. While we mustered significant vocal support for the endeavor, this did not translate into enough valid nominations for a new host site.\n\nThe idea remains sound in principle: the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] may propose moving the Market again in future, if it so desires. For now though, this commercial institution remains in the lucrative care of the [market_founder.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2632`

## galcom.70.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agalcom.70.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

泛星系商业最近经历了一次短暂而混乱的复苏，有消息称迁移泛星系市场的努力已经失败。尽管[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]声明希望迁移这一机构，但他们没有收到任何替代东道主的可靠提名。因此，[market_founder.GetName]将继续担任其东道主，直到政治变革的风向再次转向，通过投票寻找到替代。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2216`

### English

Galactic commerce experienced a brief and confusing resurgence recently, with news that the effort to relocate the Galactic Market has failed. Despite the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s stated desire to move this institution, they received no valid nominations for a replacement host. As a result, the [market_founder.GetName] shall remain its hosts until the winds of political change swing back to polling for a replacement.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2633`

## galcom.70.desc.founder

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agalcom.70.desc.founder&lang=en)

### 中文

泛星系的政治意愿显然与其市场的意愿不一致。在引起了广泛的金融混乱之后，[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]想要取消我们作为其专属交易中心东道主的努力已经失败，因为没有其他帝国给出有效的东道主提名。\n\n这项动议的支持者们不为所动，断言泛星系市场随时可能根据商业需要进行迁移到别处。不过就目前而言，在经历了这么多忙乱之后，泛星系最重要的商人们还是更愿意相信我们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2217`

### English

The galaxy's political will is clearly not aligned with that of its markets. After having caused widespread financial upset, the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s effort to remove us as hosts to its dedicated trading hub has failed, with no other empires putting forward a valid nomination for a host site.\n\nProponents of this motion are unfazed, affirming that the Galactic Market may yet move wherever and whenever commercial needs dictate. For now though, it would seem that after all that fuss, the galaxy's foremost merchants prefer to keep their trust in us.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2634`

## origin_void_dwellers_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin_void_dwellers_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这一文明自有记录以来便以太空为家——其对典型行星环境下的生活深恶痛绝。他们生活在几个轨道居住站上，直至近期才联合一统。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2227`

### English

This civilization has made its home in space for as long as it has maintained records - life in a typical planetary environment is anathema to them. They live in several orbital habitats that were only recently united.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2647`

## origin_void_machines_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin_void_machines_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

起初，这个机器文明的创造者是将它们设计用于外太空旅行的、完全按照在零重力环境下流畅工作进行的优化。在经历数个纪元的孤立之后，这些机器最近重新在散布于它们母星系的数个轨道居住站之间团结了起来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2234`

### English

At first, the creators of this machine civilization designed them for eternal space travel, fully optimizing them to function seamlessly in zero gravity environments. After enduring eons of isolation, these machines have recently restored unity among the orbital habitats scattered throughout their home system.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2654`

## d_arcane_replicator_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_arcane_replicator_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这台古代机器深藏于居住站之内，嵌入主反应堆内部并从中汲取能量。这是此居住站原本的建造者留下的遗珍，其物质复制技术对我们而言完全无法理解。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2255`

### English

This ancient machine is nestled deep within the habitat's interior, built into its main reactor from where it also draws its power. A relic of whomever originally built this habitat, its matter replication technology is utterly incomprehensible to us.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2675`

## START_SCREEN_VOID_DWELLERS

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_VOID_DWELLERS&lang=en)

### 中文

对于大多数生物，太空中的真空是一种需要专门征服或攻克的不利环境。而对我们而言，这就是家园。\n\n千百年来，我们的物种栖息在数座独立围绕我们三星系统内恒星的空间站之上。究竟是我们的祖先还是什么其他人建造了这些空间站不得而知。\n\n一些人猜测与我们一同围绕着恒星的破碎行星遗迹就是我们物种失落的家园，但真相仍然扑朔迷离。\n\n自我们发明，又或者叫发现，可以跨越空间站之间虚空的太空航行能力才过去了几个世纪。怀疑和猜忌逐渐让位于贸易和相互合作。随着第一台装有[GetStartingDrivePlural]的舰船竣工，我们的这些居住站就团结在了同一面旗帜之下。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2256`

### English

To most, the vacuum of space is a hostile environment to be conquered or overcome. To us, it is home.\n\nFor thousands of years, our kind has resided on several separate space stations orbiting the suns in our trinary system. Whether our predecessors or someone else built them, we do not know.\n\nSome speculate that the shattered planetary remnants orbiting the stars alongside us are remnants of our creators' homeworld, but the truth remains elusive.\n\nOnly a few centuries have passed since the invention, or rediscovery, of spaceflight capable of bridging the gap between our stations. Suspicion and mistrust gradually yielded to trade and cooperation. With the construction of our first[GetStartingDrivePlural]-capable ship, the habitats had united under one flag.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2676`

## START_SCREEN_VOID_DWELLERS_SOL

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_VOID_DWELLERS_SOL&lang=en)

### 中文

对于大多数生物，太空中的真空环境不适于生存，需要专门征服或攻克。而对我们而言，虚空就是家园。\n\n千百年来，我们的物种分别栖息在围绕我们恒星的数座空间站之上。究竟是我们的先行者还是什么其他人建造了这些空间站，我们不得而知。\n\n尽管我们的身体结构暗示我们物种起源于一颗行星，有记录的历史却完全没有提到这一点。有些人推测，从我们的其中一座空间站之下找到的剧毒废土行星就是我们物种失落的家园，但真相或许永远不得而知。\n\n只在几个世纪前，我们才发明了足以在我们空间站之间往来的太空旅行方式——又或者叫再发明，取决于你问的人是谁。怀疑和猜忌逐渐让位于贸易和相互合作。在我们的第一台[GetStartingDrive]发明之时，这些居住站已经团结在了同一面旗帜之下。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2257`

### English

To most, the vacuum of space is a hostile environment to be conquered or overcome. To us, it is home.\n\nFor thousands of years, our kind has resided on several separate space stations orbiting our star. Whether they were built by our predecessors or someone else, we do not know.\n\nOur physical features indicate we originated on a planet, but recorded history makes no mention of it. Some speculate that the toxic wasteland of a planet found beneath one of our stations is the lost homeworld of our species, but the truth may never be known.\n\nIt has only been a few centuries since spaceflight allowing travel between our stations was invented - or rediscovered, depending on who you ask. Suspicion and mistrust gradually gave way to trade and mutual cooperation. By the time of our first [GetStartingDrive], the habitats had united under one flag.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2677`

## START_SCREEN_VOID_DWELLERS_HIVE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_VOID_DWELLERS_HIVE&lang=en)

### 中文

对于大多数生物，太空中的真空环境不适于生存，需要专门征服或攻克。而对我们而言，虚空就是家园。\n\n千百年来，意识统一的我们栖息在数座空间站之上，每座都各自环绕着三星系统中的一颗恒星。究竟是我们的祖先还是什么其他人建造了这些空间站，我们不得而知。\n\n尽管我们的生物学结构暗示我们物种起源于一颗行星，但共有记忆却没能提供任何答案。我们推测，从我们的其中一座空间站之下找到的破碎的行星遗迹就是我们物种失落的家园，但真相或许永远不得而知。\n\n在重新发现了太空航行技术之后，这些分离的蜂巢终于可以重新交融。到我们第一台[GetStartingDrive]完成时，终于得以融为一体。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2258`

### English

To most, the vacuum of space is a hostile environment to be conquered or overcome. To us, it is home.\n\nFor thousands of years, we resided on several space stations with a single mind, in orbit of the suns in our trinary system. Whether they were built by our predecessors or someone else, we do not know.\n\nOur biology indicates our species originated on a planet, but collective memory provides no answers. We speculate that the shattered planetary remnants in orbit with us is the lost homeworld of our species, but the truth may never be known.\n\nAfter rediscovering space flight, the separate hives were free to intermingle. By the time of our first [GetStartingDrive], we were fully integrated.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2678`

## START_SCREEN_VOID_DWELLERS_HIVE_SOL

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_VOID_DWELLERS_HIVE_SOL&lang=en)

### 中文

对于大多数生物，太空中的真空环境不适于生存，需要专门征服或攻克。而对我们而言，虚空就是家园。\n\n千百年来，我们统一的意识被分割在数座空间站之中，每个都各自环绕着一颗不同的行星。究竟是我们的祖先还是什么其他人建造了空间站，我们不得而知。\n\n尽管我们的生物学结构暗示我们物种起源于一颗行星，但共有记忆却没能提供任何答案。我们推测，从我们的一个空间站之下找到的剧毒废土行星就是我们物种失落的家园，但真相或许永远不得而知。\n\n在重新发现了太空航行技术之后，这几个分离的蜂巢终于可以重新交融。到我们第一台[GetStartingDrive]完成时，终于得以融为一体。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2259`

### English

To most, the vacuum of space is a hostile environment to be conquered or overcome. To us, it is home.\n\nFor thousands of years, we existed as a single mind, separated by several space stations in orbit of our star. Whether they were built by our predecessors or someone else, we do not know.\n\nOur biology indicates our species originated on a planet, but collective memory provides no answers. We speculate that the toxic wasteland of a planet in orbit along with us is the lost homeworld of our species, but the truth may never be known.\n\nAfter rediscovering space flight, the separate hives were free to intermingle. By the time of our first [GetStartingDrive], we were fully integrated.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2679`

### 中文

\n\n我们的物质组成表明我们的设计起源于一颗行星上，但我们的数据库中没有任何答案。只能假定在空我们空间站下方的破碎行星体就是我们文明失落的家乡。\n\n无论我们的虚空文明存在有何意义，[GetStartingDrive]的发明都让一切起了变化。我们现在已经做好了准备征服虚空本身。

## START_SCREEN_SCION

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_SCION&lang=en)

### 中文

在我们历史的早期，在技术尚未有多少发展之时，我们的外星善主向我们告知了他们的存在。他们以我们那不知所措的先祖们能理解的方式解释给我们听，说我们物种的未来不可限量。依靠极大的耐心，他们引领我们走上正途，帮助我们文明发挥出自身的全部潜力。\n\n曾有少数几次，我们偏离了这条正途，他们改正了我们前进的方向——如同监护人一般坚决——很快，我们的科学家掌握了电力、原子能，然后是初步太空航行。在我们监督者的谆谆教诲下，我们如今造出了我们的第一台[GetStartingDrive]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2268`

### English

Early in our history, before we had developed much technology, our alien benefactors made themselves known to us. In terms our bewildered ancestors could understand, they explained that our species showed great promise. With much patience, they guided us onto a path that would help our civilization reach its full potential.\n\nOn those few occasions when we strayed from this path, they corrected our course - firmly, as a caregiver would - but in short order, our scientists had mastered electricity, atomic power, and then crude spaceflight. Under the tutelage of our overseers, we have now constructed our first [GetStartingDrive].

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2689`

## START_SCREEN_SCION_NOMADS

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_SCION_NOMADS&lang=en)

### 中文

远在我们学会解读星辰之前，我们的外星善主便找到了我们——一个年轻而流浪的族群，勇气有余而知识不足，乘着方舟在黑暗中漂泊。他们以我们那不知所措的先祖们能理解的方式解释给我们听，说我们物种的未来不可限量。依靠极大的耐心，他们引领我们走上正途，帮助我们文明发挥出自身的全部潜力。\n\n曾有少数几次，我们偏离了这条正途——如同监护人一般坚决——很快，我们的工程师便学会了从方舟中获取到远比先祖所能想象的更多的能量。在我们监督者的谆谆教诲下，我们现在已经建造了第一台 [GetStartingDrive]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2269`

### English

Long before we had learned to read the stars, our alien benefactors found us - a young, wandering people with more courage than knowledge, drifting through the dark aboard our arkship. In terms our bewildered ancestors could understand, they explained that our species showed great promise. With much patience, they guided us onto a path that would help our civilization reach its full potential.\n\nOn those few occasions when we strayed from this path, they corrected our course - firmly, as a caregiver would - but in short order, our engineers had learned to coax far more from our vessel than our ancestors had ever thought possible. Under the tutelage of our overseers, we have now constructed our first [GetStartingDrive].

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2690`

## origin.10.a.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.10.a.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

你们好，忠诚的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你们做的很不错。在我们的引领下，你们已经掌握了超空间旅行的科技，第一次准备好要探索群星……正如我们曾经所做的一般，那是无数纪元以前了。\n\n不要害怕——如果我们不觉得你们已经准备好了，我们是不会任已经发生的事件带领你们一路走到这里的。现在就出发，成为我们的骄傲吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2274`

### English

Hello, faithful [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You have done well for yourselves. With our guidance, you have mastered the technology of hyperspace travel and are now ready to set off into the stars for the first time... much as we once did, countless eons ago.\n\nHave no fear - if we did not think you ready, we would not have allowed events to carry you as far as they have. Go now, and make us proud.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2696`

## origin.10.b.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.10.b.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。实验的第一阶段成功完成——我们已经指引你们发展出了你们文明的第一台[GetStartingDrivePlural]，现在你们已经准备好了探索群星。\n\n放心吧，要知道第二阶段已经开始，我们会继续监督你们的进展。迄今为止，你们已经证明了自己格外机敏。和其他生物完全不同。\n\n观察你们能用这一机会做到什么将会很有意思。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2276`

### English

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The first phase of the experiment has successfully concluded - we have guided you towards the development of your civilization's first [GetStartingDrivePlural], and you are now ready to take to the stars.\n\nRest assured in the knowledge that we will continue to monitor your progress now that the second phase has begun. Thus far, you have proven remarkably adroit. Not at all like the others.\n\nIt will be interesting to see what you make of this opportunity.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2698`

### 中文

竞技场之战

### English

The Arena

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2743`

## fedel.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

马上就要到决定谁将在下一个任期中领导[Root.GetAllianceName]的时间了。如我们先前同意过的，我们将通过徒手近距离搏斗决定领袖。\n\n每个成员国的领袖将被带到位于[fed_leader.Capital.GetName]，我们当前主席国[fed_leader.GetName]的一个大型竞技场。在那里，一场面向全[Root.GetAllianceName]广播的比赛即将展开，他们将相互战斗，至死方休，直到仅剩一人存留。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2316`

### English

It is nearly time to determine who shall lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] for the duration of the next term limit. As was previously agreed upon, this will be decided through unarmed close quarters combat.\n\nThe leader of each member nation will soon be brought to a large arena on [fed_leader.Capital.GetName] in the [fed_leader.GetName], the current leaders of our federation. There, in an event that is to be broadcast across the [Root.GetAllianceName], they will face off against each other in a battle to the death until only one remains.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2744`

## fedel.2.noleader.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.2.noleader.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

差不多是时候决定谁来在下一个任期中领导[Root.GetAllianceName]了。按照先前的协定，我们将以徒手近身格斗的方式来决定。\n\n不幸的是，由于[Root.GetName]中[Root.GetRulerTitle]一职暂时空缺，我们无法参加此次格斗。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2317`

### English

It is nearly time to determine who shall lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] for the duration of the next term limit. As was previously agreed upon, this will be decided through unarmed close quarters combat.\n\nUnfortunately, as the office of [Root.GetRulerTitle] is currently vacant in the [Root.GetName], we will be unable to participate.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2745`

## fedel.2.vassal.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.2.vassal.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

差不多是时候确定下一个任职期限内领导[Root.GetAllianceName]的人选了。按照先前达成的一致，这将通过徒手近战格斗来决定。\n\n由于[Root.GetName]不是一个独立的国家，我们将无法参与，因为我们没有资格领导联盟。我们应该竭尽全力改变这种不幸的状况。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2318`

### English

It is nearly time to determine who shall lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] for the duration of the next term limit. As was previously agreed upon, this will be decided through unarmed close quarters combat.\n\nAs the [Root.GetName] is a not an independent state, we will be unable to participate as we are not eligible to lead the federation. We should do our utmost to change this unfortunate state of affairs.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2746`

## fedel.2.gestalt.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.2.gestalt.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

差不多是时候决定谁来在下一个任期中领导[Root.GetAllianceName]了。按照先前的协定，我们将以徒手近身格斗的方式来决定。\n\n由于[Root.GetName]的领袖不是以单个个体存在，我们无法参加此次格斗。我们应当尽全力改变这个荒谬而不公平的选举联邦主席的方式。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2319`

### English

It is nearly time to determine who shall lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] for the duration of the next term limit. As was previously agreed upon, this will be decided through unarmed close quarters combat.\n\nAs the [Root.GetName] has no single individual leader, we will be unable to participate. We should do our utmost to change this farcical and unfair method of electing the leader of our federation.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2747`

## fedel.10.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.10.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

[ruler.GetRulerTitle][ruler.GetRegnalName]同组成[Root.GetAllianceName]的其他各成员国的领袖们一道被领向[fed_leader.Capital.GetName]上的竞技场。所有参赛者均不准携带武器和护甲。各个领袖只能依赖他们自身的身体素质，并靠狡黠洞穿别人的心思。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2324`

### English

[ruler.GetRulerTitle] [ruler.GetRegnalName] is ushered into the arena on [fed_leader.Capital.GetName] along with the other individual leaders of the various member nations that constitute the [Root.GetAllianceName]. No weapons or armor are permitted. Each leader can depend only on their physical prowess and their guile to see them through.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2753`

## fedel.10.1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.10.1&lang=en)

### 中文

战斗一开始，[ruler.GetRegnalName]就向反方向逃遁，在随后的混战中大多数时候都是在慌张地从对手们身边逃开。不可思议的是，[ruler.GetSheHe]作为最后的幸存者赢得了比赛，因为最后一名追赶[ruler.GetHerHis]的人自己倒下了，并因先前在战斗中受到的伤害最终死去。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2326`

### English

As soon as the fighting began, [ruler.GetRegnalName] fled in the opposite direction and spent most of the melee running away from opponents in varying degrees of panic. Incredibly, [ruler.GetSheHe] won by virtue of being the last survivor, when [ruler.GetHerHis] final pursuer collapsed and eventually died from wounds suffered earlier in the fighting.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2755`

## fedel.10.2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.10.2&lang=en)

### 中文

战斗开始后，[ruler.GetRegnalName]很快证明了自己在打架方面毫无才能。幸运的是，其他各个领袖甚至更为糟糕。在一场仿佛会永远持续下去的、令人筋疲力竭的搏斗中，[ruler.GetSheHe]最终成为了唯一一名活下来的参战者。宣布胜利时，绝大多数观众已经离开了竞技场。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2328`

### English

When the battle begins, [ruler.GetRegnalName] quickly proves utterly inept at fighting. Fortunately, all the other leaders are even worse. In a grueling struggle that seems to last forever, [ruler.GetSheHe] [ruler.GetIsAre] eventually the last combatant left alive. When this is announced, the vast majority of spectators have already left the arena.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2757`

## fedel.10.3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.10.3&lang=en)

### 中文

战斗过程相当野蛮，但[ruler.GetRegnalName]通过在一片混战中亲自击杀多名与之对战的领袖证明了[ruler.GetHerHis]的实力。尘埃落定时，[ruler.GetSheHe]是唯一一名还站在场上的参战者。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2330`

### English

The battle is a savage one, but [ruler.GetRegnalName] proves [ruler.GetHerHis] mettle by personally dispatching several rivaling leaders in the confusing melee. When the dust settles, [ruler.GetSheHe] [ruler.GetIsAre] the only one left standing.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2759`

## fedel.10.4

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.10.4&lang=en)

### 中文

战斗漫长而血腥，[ruler.GetRegnalName]身被数创。尽管如此，[ruler.GetSheHe]通过比其他各个竞争者坚持了更长时间证明了[ruler.GetHerHis]的耐力。战斗结束时，[ruler.GetSheHe]是唯一一名还活着的领袖……虽然已经奄奄一息。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2332`

### English

The battle is long and bloody, and [ruler.GetRegnalName] is grievously wounded several times. Despite this, [ruler.GetSheHe] prove[ruler.GetSXX] [ruler.GetHerHis] endurance by outlasting all of the other contenders. When the fighting is over, [ruler.GetSheHe] [ruler.GetIsAre] the only leader left alive... even if just barely.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2761`

## fedel.10.5

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.10.5&lang=en)

### 中文

随着战斗打响，情况很快变得显而易见，竞技场中没有哪名领袖可以与我们[ruler.GetRulerTitle]的技巧及纯粹的能力相匹敌。他们被一个接一个易如反掌地击杀，直至只剩[ruler.GetRegnalName]存活。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2334`

### English

As the fighting erupts, it quickly becomes apparent that none of the other leaders in the arena can match the skill and sheer ability of our [ruler.GetRulerTitle]. They are dispatched one by one with little effort, until only [ruler.GetRegnalName] remains.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2763`

## fedel.10.6

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.10.6&lang=en)

### 中文

[ruler.GetRegnalName]干净利落地处理掉了胆敢与[ruler.GetHerHim]一同踏入竞技场的可怜蠢货们。简简单单的一瞥过后，其他各领袖已无生命的躯体便落向地面。整个竞技场寂静无声，目送着[ruler.GetRulerTitle]离去。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2336`

### English

[ruler.GetRegnalName] makes short work of the poor fools who step into the arena with [ruler.GetHerHim]. A single glance and then the lifeless bodies of the other leaders collapse onto the ground. The arena descends into utter silence as the [ruler.GetRulerTitle] makes [ruler.GetHerHis] exit.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2765`

## fedel.10.7

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.10.7&lang=en)

### 中文

竞技场中的其他各领袖立刻被例行公事地烧成灰烬——今天在此的真正战斗将于[ruler.GetRegnalName]和[rival_chosen_country.GetName]的[rival_chosen_leader.GetRulerTitle][rival_chosen_leader.GetRegnalName]的庞大灵能力量间展开。在漫长且规模宏大的决斗过后，[ruler.GetRegnalName]最终获胜，[rival_chosen_leader.GetRegnalName]被彻底击败。竞技场的大部分已经沦为废墟，但事情也告一段落了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2338`

### English

The other leaders in the arena are immediately incinerated as a mere formality - the only true battle here today is between the colossal psionic powers of [ruler.GetRegnalName] and [rival_chosen_leader.GetRulerTitle] [rival_chosen_leader.GetRegnalName] of the [rival_chosen_country.GetName]. After a lengthy duel of titanic proportions, [ruler.GetRegnalName] has somehow succeeded in vanquishing [rival_chosen_leader.GetRegnalName]. Much of the arena lies in ruins, but the matter has been settled.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2767`

## fedel.10.8

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.10.8&lang=en)

### 中文

这是一场真正的强者之间的战斗。在这个竞技场中施展的灵能力量在虚境的桎梏外罕有目睹。当战斗结束时，竞技场已沦为废墟，[ruler.GetRegnalName]是唯一仍然存活的半神。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2340`

### English

This is a true battle of titans. The psionic powers wielded in this arena are on a scale rarely witnessed beyond the confines of the Shroud. When the battle is over, the arena lies in ruins and [ruler.GetRegnalName] is the only surviving demigod.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2769`

## fedel.10.9

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.10.9&lang=en)

### 中文

[ruler.GetRegnalName]强大的灵能能力给了[ruler.GetHerHim]在竞技场中决定性的优势，[ruler.GetSheHe]很快便充分利用了这一优势。他用灵能烤熟了对手的大脑，以念力把其他领袖用致命的速度抛向彼此，战斗很快结束了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2342`

### English

The powerful psionic abilities of [ruler.GetRegnalName] gives [ruler.GetHerHim] a decisive advantage in the arena, one that [ruler.GetSheHe] quickly make[ruler.GetSXX] the most of. After frying brains and using telekinesis to hurl the other leaders into each other at lethal speeds, the battle is quickly over.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2771`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.10.10&lang=en)

### 中文

[ruler.GetRegnalName]安装的大型义体升级套装在竞技场中果然颇具决定性。[ruler.GetSheHe]以机械搬的效率移动，对纯粹的有机体足以致命的攻击也能格挡弹开，很快就消灭了其他领袖。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2344`

### English

The large suite of cybernetic upgrades installed in [ruler.GetRegnalName] prove decisive in the arena. Moving with mechanical efficiency, [ruler.GetSheHe] quickly eliminate[ruler.GetSXX] the other leaders while deflecting blows that could well have proved fatal to a purely organic being.

## fedel.10.11

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.10.11&lang=en)

### 中文

相对于绝大多数有机体，[ruler.GetRegnalName]拥有高人一等的力量和反应速度，在竞技场中表现杰出。其他领袖被一个接一个的消灭，高效且相对没什么痛苦。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2346`

### English

With both superior strength and reflexes compared to the vast majority of organics, [ruler.GetRegnalName] excels in the combat arena. The other leaders are eliminated one by one, in an efficient and relatively painless manner.

## fedel.15.1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.15.1&lang=en)

### 中文

令人难过的是，[ruler.GetRegnalName]并不具有完成任务的实力。混战开始后不久，[ruler.GetSheHe]便失去理智，慌不择路地试图逃离竞技场，在看台上观看的人群纷纷嘲笑奚落。当[ruler.GetSheHe]最终被一名其他领袖逼至角落时，[ruler.GetSheHe]被迅速而毫不留情地击杀。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2350`

### English

Sadly, [ruler.GetRegnalName] does not prove up to the task. Soon after the melee begins, [ruler.GetSheHe] lose[ruler.GetSXX] [ruler.GetHerHis] nerve and attempts to flee the arena in wild panic, much to the derision of the crowds watching from the stands. When [ruler.GetSheHe] [ruler.GetIsAre] finally cornered by one of the other leaders, [ruler.GetHerHis] end is swift and merciless.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2780`

## fedel.15.2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.15.2&lang=en)

### 中文

[ruler.GetRegnalName]发出一声坚定的战吼，随后[ruler.GetHerselfHimself]向竞技场中逐渐展开的野蛮混战猛冲而去。可是，[ruler.GetHerHis]的勇气大大超过了[ruler.GetHerHis]真实的作战能力，[ruler.GetSheHe]被其他领袖中的一位几乎不假思索地击杀。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2352`

### English

With a fierce battle cry, [ruler.GetRegnalName] hurls [ruler.GetHerselfHimself] into the savage melee unfolding inside the arena. Alas, [ruler.GetHerHis] courage greatly exceeds [ruler.GetHerHis] actual combat ability, and [ruler.GetSheHe] [ruler.GetIsAre] dispatched almost as an afterthought by one of the other leaders.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2782`

## fedel.15.3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.15.3&lang=en)

### 中文

[ruler.GetRegnalName]稍作犹豫，在战斗开始后不久便加入了对决。[ruler.GetSheHe]在一片野蛮的混战中前突后撞，为[ruler.GetHerselfHimself]赢得了美名。然而，最终[ruler.GetSheHe]在战斗结束前便屈从于[ruler.GetSheHe]身上的伤口。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2354`

### English

With some hesitation, [ruler.GetRegnalName] joins the fray shortly after the fighting begins. As the savage melee goes back and forth, [ruler.GetSheHe] give[ruler.GetSXX] a good account of [ruler.GetHerselfHimself]. Ultimately, however, [ruler.GetSheHe] succumb[ruler.GetSXX] to the wounds [ruler.GetSheHe] suffered before the battle is decided.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2784`

## fedel.15.4

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.15.4&lang=en)

### 中文

[ruler.GetRegnalName]立即加入战斗，很快便使自己成为了最可怕的参战者之一。也许正因如此，一些其他领袖暂时结成团体来对付[ruler.GetHerHim]。他们的力量合在一起确实过于强大，尽管[ruler.GetHerHis]英勇战斗，[ruler.GetRegnalName]还是很快死于伤势。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2356`

### English

[ruler.GetRegnalName] immediately rushes into battle, and has soon established [ruler.GetHerselfHimself] as one of the more formidable contenders. Perhaps because of this, some of the other leaders momentarily gang up on [ruler.GetHerHim]. Their combined efforts prove too much, and despite [ruler.GetHerHis] valiant efforts, [ruler.GetRegnalName] soon perishes from [ruler.GetHerHis] wounds.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2786`

## fedel.15.5.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.15.5.desc&lang=en)

## fedel.15.5

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.15.5&lang=en)

### 中文

在[winning_leader.GetRegnalName]，[winning_country.GetName]的[winning_leader.GetRulerTitle]简简单单的一瞥过后，竞技场中的所有其他领袖，包括[ruler.GetRegnalName]，落在地面上死去。或许参加竞技是个糟糕的主意。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2358`

### English

With a single glance from [winning_leader.GetRegnalName], the [winning_leader.GetRulerTitle] of the [winning_country.GetName], all the other leaders in the arena, including [ruler.GetRegnalName], dropped dead to the ground. Perhaps this was a bad idea.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2788`

## fedel.15.6

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.15.6&lang=en)

### 中文

在一些参战者惊人的灵能能量相互碰撞后，所有其他领袖，包括[ruler.GetRegnalName]，都被烧成了灰烬。他们只不过是巨人们对决时的附带损害。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2360`

### English

As the awesome psionic energies of some of the combatants clash, all the other leaders, including [ruler.GetRegnalName], are reduced to ash. They were little more than collateral damage in this battle of titans.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2790`

## fedel.15.7.desc

$fedel.10.intro$\n\n$fedel.15.7$\n\n$fedel.15.victor.desc$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2361`

### English

$fedel.10.intro$\n\n$fedel.15.7$\n\n$fedel.15.victor.desc$

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2791`

## fedel.15.7

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.15.7&lang=en)

### 中文

星系中罕有存在能与[ruler.GetRegnalName]的灵能实力相匹敌，不过，[winning_country.GetName]的[winning_leader.GetRulerTitle][winning_leader.GetRegnalName]正是其中之一，在竞技场中的其他领袖们被如同无关紧要的害虫般消灭后，真正的战斗开始了。竞技场中很快掀起了一场灵能风暴，当风暴渐息。[ruler.GetRegnalName]已不剩一丝痕迹…

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2362`

### English

There are few beings in this galaxy who can match the psionic power of [ruler.GetRegnalName], but alas, [winning_leader.GetRulerTitle] [winning_leader.GetRegnalName] of the [winning_country.GetName] is one of them. After the other leaders in the arena are discarded as the insignificant pests they are, the true battle begins. The arena soon becomes a maelstrom of psionic energy, but when it dissipates, no trace of [ruler.GetRegnalName] remains...

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2792`

## fedel.15.8.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.15.8.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$fedel.10.intro$\n\n$fedel.15.8$\n\n$fedel.15.victor.desc$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2363`

### English

$fedel.10.intro$\n\n$fedel.15.8$\n\n$fedel.15.victor.desc$

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2793`

## fedel.15.8

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.15.8&lang=en)

### 中文

这是一场真正的强者之间的战斗。在这个竞技场中施展的灵能力量在虚境的桎梏外罕有目睹。当战斗结束时，竞技场已沦为废墟。只有一位半神仍然存活，可那并非[ruler.GetRegnalName]……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2364`

### English

This is a true battle of titans. The psionic powers wielded in this arena are on a scale rarely witnessed beyond the confines of the Shroud. When the battle is over, the arena lies in ruins. A single demigod remains, and it is not [ruler.GetRegnalName]...

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2794`

## fedel.15.9.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.15.9.desc&lang=en)

$fedel.10.intro$\n\n$fedel.15.9$\n\n$fedel.15.victor.desc$

### English

$fedel.10.intro$\n\n$fedel.15.9$\n\n$fedel.15.victor.desc$

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2795`

## fedel.15.9

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.15.9&lang=en)

### 中文

令人伤感的是，[ruler.GetRegnalName]高人一等的力量和反应速度并不足以在竞技场中确保胜利。其他参战者在不久后就开始用[ruler.GetHerHis]被切断的附属肢体作为武器，对付[ruler.GetHerHis]自己的记忆核心。战斗结束时只剩下残骸的碎片。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2366`

### English

The superior strength and reflexes of [ruler.GetRegnalName] are sadly not enough to ensure victory in the arena. Before long, the other contestants are using [ruler.GetHerHis] severed appendages as clubs against [ruler.GetHerHis] own memory core. Only scattered debris remains when the battle is over.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2796`

## fedel.15.10.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.15.10.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

[ruler.GetRegnalName]拥有的灵能力量给了[ruler.GetHerHim]显著优势，但竞技场中的混乱战斗使得保持注意力十分困难。不幸的是，这最终成了[ruler.GetHerHis]失败的原因，另一个领袖从后方攻击了[ruler.GetHerHim]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2369`

### English

The psionic powers wielded by [ruler.GetRegnalName] gives [ruler.GetHerHim] a significant advantage, but the chaotic battle in the arena makes it difficult to maintain focus. Unfortunately, this proves to be [ruler.GetHerHis] undoing when another leader attacks [ruler.GetHerHim] from behind.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2799`

## fedel.16.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.16.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

竞技场中的厮杀告一段落，[winning_leader.GetRulerTitle]§H[winning_leader.GetRegnalName]§!是唯一挺过了整场竞技的人。§H[winning_country.GetName]§!将在下一个任期中领导[Root.GetAllianceName]。在离开竞技场时，胜利者如是说道：

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2420`

### English

With the slaughter in the arena coming to an end, [winning_leader.GetRulerTitle] §H[winning_leader.GetRegnalName]§! has emerged as the sole survivor. The §H[winning_country.GetName]§! will lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] for the next term. Upon leaving the arena, the winner had this to say:

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2853`

## fedel.16.1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.16.1&lang=en)

### 中文

这里……这里[Root.GetBloodType]流成河。我都干了些什么？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2421`

### English

There... there was so much [Root.GetBloodType]. What have I done?

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2854`

## fedel.16.2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.16.2&lang=en)

### 中文

结束了吗？这……这是说我赢了吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2422`

### English

Is it over? Does... does this mean I won?

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2855`

## fedel.16.3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.16.3&lang=en)

### 中文

他们的惨叫声……我、我仍然能听到。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2423`

### English

Their screams... I... I can still hear them.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2856`

## fedel.16.4

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.16.4&lang=en)

### 中文

总算结束了……总算结束了……总算结束了……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2424`

### English

It's over now... it's over now... it's over now...

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2857`

## fedel.16.5

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.16.5&lang=en)

### 中文

我感觉好想吐。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2425`

### English

I feel like I'm going to be sick.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2858`

## fedel.16.6

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.16.6&lang=en)

### 中文

说真的，我之前没觉得我有这个本事。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2426`

### English

To be perfectly honest, I didn't think I had it in me.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2859`

## fedel.16.7

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.16.7&lang=en)

### 中文

我们别再提这件事了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2427`

### English

Let us never speak of this again.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2860`

## fedel.16.8

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.16.8&lang=en)

### 中文

一定会有更好的途径来决定谁有资格领导……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2428`

### English

There has to be a better way to determine leadership...

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2861`

## fedel.16.9

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.16.9&lang=en)

### 中文

真是浪费。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2429`

### English

What a waste.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2862`

## fedel.16.10

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.16.10&lang=en)

### 中文

绝不能忘掉今天死在这里的那些人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2430`

### English

We must not forget those who died here today.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2863`

## fedel.16.11

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.16.11&lang=en)

### 中文

让我们把这件事抛诸脑后，共同面向未来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2431`

### English

Let us put this behind us now and look to the future.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2864`

## fedel.16.12

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.16.12&lang=en)

### 中文

真是野蛮的体制，但我也只是做了必须要做的事，

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2432`

### English

A barbaric system, but I did what had to be done.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2865`

## fedel.16.13

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.16.13&lang=en)

### 中文

这场屠杀毫无荣耀可言。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2433`

### English

There was no honor in this slaughter.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2866`

## fedel.16.14

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.16.14&lang=en)

### 中文

这只不过是策略的问题。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2434`

### English

It was simply a matter of tactics.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2867`

## fedel.16.15

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.16.15&lang=en)

### 中文

是场不错的决斗。没人能说不是这样。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2435`

### English

It was a good fight. Let no one claim otherwise.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2868`

## fedel.16.16

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.16.16&lang=en)

### 中文

他们战的光荣。我从他们的死亡中得不到任何乐趣。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2436`

### English

They fought honorably. I took no pleasure in their deaths.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2869`

## fedel.16.17

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.16.17&lang=en)

### 中文

现在谁算是丑角？嗯？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2437`

### English

Who's ugly now? Huh?

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2870`

## fedel.16.18

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.16.18&lang=en)

### 中文

愿那些被我击杀的人在来世寻得安宁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2438`

### English

May those I slew find peace in the afterlife.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2871`

## fedel.16.19

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.16.19&lang=en)

### 中文

所有被我击杀的人都勇敢面对死亡。只有一个人除外。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2439`

### English

Everyone I slew faced their deaths with courage. All except one.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2872`

## fedel.16.20

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.16.20&lang=en)

### 中文

我一点都不后悔。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2440`

### English

I regret nothing.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2873`

## fedel.16.21

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.16.21&lang=en)

### 中文

确实，这件事只能通过一种途径来解决。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2441`

### English

Truly, there was only one way this could end.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2874`

## fedel.16.22

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.16.22&lang=en)

已经结束了吗？

Is it over already?

## fedel.501.1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.501.1&lang=en)

### 中文

随着决定[Root.GetAllianceName]下一任领袖的时间逐渐临近，§H虚境§!中的灵体也正日益躁动。是时候让各候选国最具潜力的[GetPsychicNounPlural]选手们启程前往[fed_leader.Capital.GetName]，也即当前主席国的首都了。在那里，灵能选手们将展开战斗，直到最强者胜出为止。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2470`

### English

The spirits of the §HShroud§! grow increasingly restless as the time draws near to decide who should lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] during the next term. It is time for each candidate's most potent [GetPsychicNounPlural] to journey to [fed_leader.Capital.GetName], the capital of the current president. There they shall meet to do battle until only the strongest prevails.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2904`

## fedel.501.2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.501.2&lang=en)

### 中文

为了增强我们自己的灵能选手的实力，我们可以利用我们的泽珞供应。这将为我们在灵能之战中提供额外的优势。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2471`

### English

To bolster the powers of our own psionic champions, we could tap into our Zro supply. It will give us an additional advantage in the battle.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2905`

## fedel.501.3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.501.3&lang=en)

### English

We do not have access to enough [GetPsychicNounPlural] to participate, unfortunately, and must forfeit the battle.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2906`

### 中文

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2485`

### English

As it turns out, we are the only member who could muster enough [GetPsychicNounPlural] to participate.\n\nWith no one to fight, the victory goes to us.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2920`

## fedel.510.1.organic

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.510.1.organic&lang=en)

### 中文

随着[GetPsychicNounPlural]们为战斗而聚集，一股显而易见的恐怖气氛弥漫在[fed_leader.Capital.GetName]之上。有报告称闪电风暴突兀而激烈地出现，阴影凭空产生，莫名的声波扰动诡异显现。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2486`

### English

As the [GetPsychicNounPlural] gather for the battle, a sense of palpable dread permeates [fed_leader.Capital.GetName]. There are reports of sudden and violent thunderstorms, shadows where none should be, and inexplicable sonic disturbances.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2921`

## fedel.510.1.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.510.1.machine&lang=en)

### 中文

随着[GetPsychicNounPlural]们为战斗而聚集，一种不确定性弥漫在[fed_leader.Capital.GetName]上。有报告称闪电风暴突兀而激烈地出现，阴影凭空产生，莫名的声响诡异显现。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2487`

### English

As the [GetPsychicNounPlural] gather for the battle, uncertainty permeates [fed_leader.Capital.GetName]. There are reports of sudden and violent thunderstorms, shadows where none should be, and inexplicable sonic disturbances.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2922`

## fedel.510.2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.510.2&lang=en)

### 中文

战斗开始了。搏斗异常激烈，各支队伍寸步不让。战斗最终变成了耐力测试，一刻的分心就足以导致从§H虚境§!中被永久驱除。我们的[GetPsychicNounPlural]证明了他们最为训练有素，正如我们所知的那样。胜利属于我们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2488`

### English

The battle begins. It is an unusually even struggle, with no team willing to yield. In the end it becomes a test of stamina, where a moment of inattention can result in an eternity of banishment in the §HShroud§!. Our [GetPsychicNounPlural] prove the most disciplined, as we know they would. Victory is ours.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2923`

## fedel.510.3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.510.3&lang=en)

### 中文

战斗开始了。没有一支其他队伍是我们的对手。我们挨个穷追不舍，将他国灵能者的灵能本体喂给了那如饥似渴的§H虚境§!。只余下冰冷又不省人事的躯壳。胜利属于我们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2489`

### English

The battle begins. None of the other teams prove a match for our own. One by one they are hunted down and stripped of their psionic essence which is fed into the ravenous §HShroud§!. Only cold and unresponsive husks remain. Victory is ours.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2924`

## fedel.515.4.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.515.4.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在[Root.GetAllianceName]各处的[GetPsychicNounPlural]们应当聚集在[fed_leader.Capital.GetName]的时间到来后，一种意料之外的局面出现了。§H[winning_country.GetName]§!竟是唯一可以召集足够多[GetPsychicNounPlural]参战的成员国。\n\n既然没有人能够战斗，胜利就属于他们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2498`

### English

As [GetPsychicNounPlural] from across the [Root.GetAllianceName] are meant to be gathering on [fed_leader.Capital.GetName], an unexpected situation arises. The §H[winning_country.GetName]§! is the only member that could muster enough [GetPsychicNounPlural] to participate.\n\nWith no one to fight, the victory goes to them.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2934`

## fedel.515.2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.515.2&lang=en)

### 中文

战斗开始了。各支队伍一个接一个摆好架势相互接战，然后又一个接一个地倒下。我们自己的[GetPsychicNounPlural]是最先倒下的那一批，面对对手们的猛攻他们束手无策。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2499`

### English

The battle begins. One by one, the teams square off against each other, and one by one, they fall. Our own [GetPsychicNounPlural] are among the first to go, powerless in the face of their rivals' onslaught.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2935`

## fedel.515.3.organic

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.515.3.organic&lang=en)

### 中文

战斗开始了。随着各支队伍相互接战，我们的[GetPsychicNounPlural]起先表现不俗，但最终还是没能敌过巨大的挑战。伴随着痛苦的嚎叫，他们被永远放逐到了§H虚境§!最狂暴的深处。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2500`

### English

The battle begins. As the teams clash, our [GetPsychicNounPlural] initially perform well, but in the end the challenge proves too great. They emit a howl of pain as they are banished for all eternity into the most tempestuous depths of the §HShroud§!.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2936`

## fedel.515.3.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.515.3.machine&lang=en)

战斗开始了。随着各支队伍相互接战，我们的[GetPsychicNounPlural]起先表现不俗，但最终还是没能敌过巨大的挑战。伴随着罕见的故障，他们被永远放逐到了§H虚境§!最狂暴的深处。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2501`

### English

The battle begins. As the teams clash, our [GetPsychicNounPlural] initially perform well, but in the end the challenge proves too great. They emit an unfamiliar screeching as they are banished for all eternity into the most tempestuous depths of the §HShroud§!.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2937`

## origin_common_ground_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin_common_ground_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这一文明在早期便与其外星近邻们建立了联系。他们从彼此的差异中汲取力量，不久后便决定要共同面对未来可能发生的一切。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2507`

### English

This civilization established early contact with their immediate alien neighbors. Finding strength in their differences, they soon decided to face the future, and whatever it might bring, together.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2945`

### English

## START_SCREEN_COMMON_GROUND

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_COMMON_GROUND&lang=en)

### 中文

数十年前，在我们的第一批亚光速探测器造访了临近我们的各恒星系后，我们发现那里存在两个迥异的外星文明。尽管我们的生理结构差异巨大，事实不久便表明，我们间的共同之处大于分歧。如我们一般，这两个外星文明也正将有能力开始实用性星际旅行。\n\n纽带在我们三个文明间形成，并最终引向了联邦的诞生——我们将通力合作，当我们准备好步入外面的广阔世界后，我们将一同面对所遭遇的一切。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2509`

### English

Decades ago, when our first crude sublight probes visited the star systems near our own, we discovered the presence of two distinct alien civilizations. Despite the radical differences in our physiology, it quickly became apparent that we had more things in common than not. Like us, they were also on the cusp of unlocking practical interstellar travel.\n\nA bond was formed between our three civilizations, which eventually led to the birth of a federation - we would combine our efforts, and when we were ready to spread out into the cosmos, whatever was out there would be faced by us standing together.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2947`

## START_SCREEN_COMMON_GROUND_NOMADS

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_COMMON_GROUND_NOMADS&lang=en)

### 中文

数十年前，我们在流浪的旅途中造访了两个有人居住的恒星系——随之而来的，是与两个迥异的外星文明的首次接触。尽管我们的生理结构差异巨大，但事实不久便表明，我们间的共同之处大于分歧。如我们一般，他们感受到了宇宙的召唤，正站在叩响星门的边缘。\n\n纽带在我们三个文明间形成，并最终促成了联邦的诞生——我们将通力合作，无论星海中存在着什么，我们都将并肩面对。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2510`

### English

Decades ago, our wandering path brought us within range of two inhabited systems - and with them, first contact with two distinct alien civilizations. Despite the radical differences in our physiology, it quickly became apparent that we had more things in common than not. Like us, they felt the pull of the cosmos, and were on the cusp of answering it.\n\nA bond was formed between our three civilizations, which eventually led to the birth of a federation - we would combine our efforts, and whatever was out there would be faced by us standing together.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2948`

## origin.57.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.57.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管我们已经与联盟的其他成员接触了一段时日了，但唯有现在：超光速引擎的实现，让我们这几个帝国可以真真切切地互相接触。现在的问题是，我们的联邦应当专注于什么方面：一些人提倡目前的通用模式，而另一些人则倾向于专注于在特定领域进行更紧密的合作。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2520`

### English

Though we have for some time been in contact with the other members of our alliance, it is only now - with the invention of FTL drives - that our empires are able to interact with each other on a meaningful level. The question has arisen as to what our federation should focus on: some advocate the current, generalist path, whereas others would favor focusing on closer integration in a particular field.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2960`

## START_SCREEN_HEGEMON

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_HEGEMON&lang=en)

### 中文

数十年前，在我们的第一批亚光速探测器造访了临近我们的各恒星系后，我们发现那里存在两个迥异的外星文明。和我们类似，这两个外星文明也正将有能力开始实用性星际旅行，但他们的政府软弱无力、缺乏组织。\n\n在认识到他们的力量可以用来增进我们自身的力量后，我们开始推动一个在我们监管之下的星际联盟逐步建立，这一联盟把我们三个文明团结在一起。他们起初有所抵抗，但最终我们的领导与雄心所能带来的利益明显到了就连他们也无法忽视的程度。新秩序就此建立。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2535`

### English

Decades ago, when our first crude sublight probes visited the star systems near our own, we discovered the presence of two distinct alien civilizations. Like us, they were on the verge of developing practical interstellar travel, but their governments were weak and disorganized.\n\nRecognizing that their strength would add to our own, we began to gradually push for a political union under our supervision that would unite our three civilizations. There was resistance at first, but eventually the benefits of sharing in our leadership and ambition became too obvious for even them to ignore. A new order had been established.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2976`

## START_SCREEN_HEGEMON_NOMADS

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_HEGEMON_NOMADS&lang=en)

### 中文

数十年前，我们在流浪的旅途中造访了两个有人居住的恒星系——随之发现了两个迥异外星文明。他们马上就要发展出实用性星际旅行，但他们的政府软弱无力、缺乏组织——远未准备好应对宇宙对他们的考验。\n\n在认识到他们的力量可以用来增进我们自身的力量后，我们开始推动一个在我们监管之下的星际联盟逐步建立，这一联盟把我们三个文明团结在一起。他们起初有所抵抗，但最终我们的领导与雄心所能带来的利益明显到了就连他们也无法忽视的程度。新秩序就此建立。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2536`

### English

Decades ago, our wandering path brought us within range of two inhabited systems, and with them the discovery of two distinct alien civilizations. They were on the verge of developing practical interstellar travel, but their governments were weak, sedentary and disorganized - ill-prepared for what the cosmos would demand of them.\n\nRecognizing that their strength would add to our own, we began to gradually push for a political union under our supervision that would unite our three civilizations. There was resistance at first, but eventually the benefits of sharing in our leadership and ambition became too obvious for even them to ignore. A new order had been established.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2977`

## START_SCREEN_DOOMSDAY

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_DOOMSDAY&lang=en)

### 中文

[GetHomeWorldName]行将就木。我们的母星上的地震和火山喷发已经肆虐了数千年，科学家们最终确认了未敢想象的事情。他们的计算表明我们这颗地质构造不稳定的行星将会在一两个世纪内四分五裂。\n\n由于没有方法可以暂停这一过程，我们意识到我们作为一个物种整体的生存将取决于我们能否抛下[GetHomeWorldName]并在群星中的某处寻觅到避难之所。前所未有的工业和技术增长随之而来，我们的文明从原始大气层内飞行迅速进步到早期太空航行阶段。第一艘有超空间航行能力的舰船已经准备就绪，但时间也已经不多了。\n\n我们必须找到新的家园。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2543`

### English

[Root.Capital.GetName] is dying. Our homeworld had been plagued by earthquakes and volcanic eruptions for thousands of years before our [Root.GetScientistPlural] finally confirmed the unthinkable. Their calculations showed that our tectonically unstable planet would tear itself apart within a century or two.\n\nWith no way of halting this process, it was realized that our survival as a species would depend on our ability to leave [Root.Capital.GetName] behind and seek refuge elsewhere amongst the stars. An unprecedented industrial and technological buildup followed, and our civilization rapidly progressed from primitive atmospheric flight to early space travel. The first vessels capable of hyperspace travel are ready, but there is not much time.\n\nWe must find a new home.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2985`
