## origin.61.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.61.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着[Root.GetName]上的地震与火山活动的频率和烈度持续提升，我们的科学家现在可以更为准确地预计末日到来的时间：\n\n他们估计我们在行星自身引爆前还有§H35至45年§!时间。\n\n行星表面的条件在那之前会逐步恶化。唯一的好消息是迅猛的科技进步使得开采地幔中的丰富资源变得更为容易，提高了我们的生产能力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2546`

### English

As earthquakes and volcanic activity on [Root.GetName] continue to increase in frequency and intensity, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are now able to more accurately predict when the end will come:\n\nThey estimate that we have between §H35 to 45 years§! until the planet detonates.\n\nConditions on the surface will steadily deteriorate until then. The only good news is that the violent tectonic movements have made it easier to access the rich resources of the planet's mantle, increasing our production capacity.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2988`

## origin.65.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.65.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]的大部分地区现在几乎每天都会发生地震，过去几年里又出现了很多新的超级火山。大量的火山灰遮蔽了天空，使得在某些区域航行变得过于危险或是根本不可能。气温已经下降了数度。\n\n尽管有上述灾难，这颗垂死行星的表面的秩序却如梦幻般正常。垮塌建筑留下的瓦砾被缓慢清理，悬浮的灰尘被从最繁忙的街道上清理掉，只要条件允许岩浆流就会被引流改道。民众正在忍耐。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2549`

### English

Earthquakes are now an almost daily occurrence on most of [Root.GetName], and at least a dozen new supervolcanoes have appeared within the last few years. Massive ash storms blanket the skies, making air travel hazardous or even impossible in some regions. Temperatures have dropped by several degrees.\n\nDespite all this, a surreal sense of normalcy prevails on the dying planet's surface. Rubble from collapsed buildings is slowly removed, the swirling ash is swept off the busiest streets, and the lava flows are, where possible, diverted. The people endure.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2991`

## origin.65.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.65.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]的大部分地区现在几乎每天都会发生地震，过去几年里又出现了至少一打新的超级火山。大量的火山灰遮蔽了天空，使得在某些区域航空飞行变得过于危险或是根本不可能。气温已经下降了数度。\n\n尽管有上述灾难，这颗垂死行星的表面的秩序却如梦幻般正常。垮塌建筑留下的瓦砾被缓慢清理，打转的灰尘被从最为繁忙的街道上扫去，岩浆流只要有可能就会被引流改道。子个体们正在忍受。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2550`

### English

Earthquakes are now an almost daily occurrence on most of [Root.GetName], and at least a dozen new supervolcanoes have appeared within the last few years. Massive ash storms blanket the skies, making air travel hazardous or even impossible in some regions. Temperatures have dropped by several degrees.\n\nDespite all this, a surreal sense of normalcy prevails on the dying planet's surface. Rubble from collapsed buildings is slowly removed, the swirling ash is swept off the busiest streets, and the lava flows are, where possible, diverted. The drones endure.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2992`

## origin.70.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.70.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]正逐渐四分五裂，行星表面被阴霾笼罩。每一天，地震的震级都在提高，火山灰云变得更为密集。\n\n火山碎屑流和岩浆河在受影响最恶劣的地区已经占据了数座城市。无穷无尽的难民乘坐着拖车穿过持续的火山灰风暴前往安全区，在那里仍能找到文明带来的舒适…至少现在如此。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2553`

### English

A perpetual gloom pervades on the surface of [Root.GetName] as the planet slowly rips itself apart. With each passing day, the earthquakes increase in magnitude and the ash clouds grow denser.\n\nPyroclastic flows and rivers of molten lava have claimed several cities in the worst affected regions. Seemingly endless caravans of refugees are slowly making their way through the constant ash storms to reach safer areas, where the comforts of civilization can still be found... for now.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2995`

## origin.70.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.70.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]正逐渐四分五裂，阴郁将长时间笼罩在行星表面。每一天，地震的震级都在提高，火山灰云变得更为密集。\n\n火山碎屑流和岩浆河在受影响最恶劣的地区已经占领了多处子个体中心。无穷无尽的子个体乘坐着拖车穿过持续的火山灰风暴前往安全区，在那里会相对安全…至少现在如此。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2554`

### English

A perpetual gloom pervades on the surface of [Root.GetName] as the planet slowly rips itself apart. With each passing day, the earthquakes increase in magnitude and the ash clouds grow denser.\n\nPyroclastic flows and rivers of molten lava have claimed several drone hubs in the worst affected regions. Seemingly endless caravans of drones are slowly making their way through the constant ash storms to reach more remote areas where relative safety can still be found... for now.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:2996`

## origin.75.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.75.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]上的条件正迅速变得不可忍受。大多数幸存的人口都集中在少数尚余的城市中，这些城市是巨型的防风暴庇护所，足以抵御从不减弱的灰尘的侵袭。但即使是这些文明的最后据点也不会存在太久了。毁灭性的地震仍在持续，千百座活火山喷发着硫磺和熔岩。\n\n在行星地壳碎裂的同时，更多有价值的资源也从地幔涌到了地表，任何剩余的尚能运转的工业均可对这些资源进行加工。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2563`

### English

Conditions on [Root.GetName] are rapidly becoming unbearable. Most of the remaining population are clustered around the few surviving cities that now serve as massive, fortified storm shelters against the unrelenting ash. But even these last few bastions of civilization on the planet will not survive for long. The devastating earthquakes continue while hundreds of active volcanoes are spewing sulfur and lava.\n\nWith the planet's crust disintegrating, more valuable resources have been ejected from the mantle to the surface, where they can be worked by whatever functional industry still remains.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3005`

## origin.75.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.75.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]上的条件正迅速变得不可忍受。大多数幸存的子个体都集中在少数尚余的基建中心中，这些中心是巨型的防风暴庇护所，足以抵御从未缓和的灰烬侵袭。但即使是行星上这些文明的最后堡垒也不会存在太久了。毁灭性的地震仍在持续，千百座活火山喷发着硫磺和熔岩。\n\n在行星地壳碎裂的同时，更多有价值的资源也从地幔涌到了地表，任何剩余的尚能运转的工业均可对这些资源进行加工。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2564`

### English

Conditions on [Root.GetName] are rapidly becoming unbearable. Most of the remaining drones are clustered around the few surviving centers of infrastructure that now serve as massive, fortified storm shelters against the unrelenting ash. But even these last few bastions of our civilization on the planet will not survive for long. The devastating earthquakes continue while hundreds of active volcanoes are spewing sulfur and lava.\n\nWith the planet's crust disintegrating, more valuable resources have been ejected from the mantle to the surface, where they can be worked by whatever functional industry still remains.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3006`

## origin.76.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.76.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

不剩多久了。[Root.GetName]已经开始经历它最后的、灾难性的痉挛，这将最终彻底毁灭这颗行星。我们的科学家预计末日会在一年内到来。\n\n对还困在行星表面的可怜人来说，时间已经所剩无几…

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2567`

### English

It will not be long now. [Root.GetName] is beginning to experience the final cataclysmic convulsions that will result in its utter destruction. Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] predict that the end will come in less than a year.\n\nVery little time remains for the poor souls still trapped on the planet's surface...

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3009`

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2568`

## origin.80.5.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.80.5.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]爆炸了！或许殖民这样一颗地质结构不稳定的行星是个糟主意…它被抛弃肯定是有原因的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2578`

### English

[Root.GetName] just exploded! Perhaps colonizing such a tectonically unstable planet was a bad idea... it must have been abandoned for a reason.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3020`

## origin.80.intro.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.80.intro.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]最终爆炸，终结了这颗行星的苦难。我们原先的母星只剩下碎片，冰冷而毫无生机，纪念着我们的过去。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2579`

### English

[Root.GetName] has finally exploded, putting the tormented planet out of its misery. Only fragments of our former homeworld remain, as cold and lifeless monuments of our past.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3021`

## origin.80.1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.80.1&lang=en)

### 中文

不幸的是，并非我们的全体公民都已在行星毁灭前从其表面疏散。很难想象世界分崩离析之时他们究竟经历了怎样的恐惧。\n\n不过，现在是面向未来的时候了。在我们重建失去的东西的同时，我们一定要确保他们没有白白牺牲。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2580`

### English

Unfortunately, not all of our citizens were evacuated from the surface before the planet was destroyed. It is difficult to imagine the horrors they witnessed as their world fell apart around them.\n\nStill, now is the time to look towards the future. As we rebuild what was lost, we must make certain that their sacrifice was not in vain.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3022`

## origin.80.1.gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.80.1.gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

不幸的是，并非我们的全体子个体都已在行星毁灭前从其表面疏散。他们的死亡实在是令人惋惜。\n\n不过，现在是面向未来的时候了。我们必须制造新的子个体以取代他们的原先的位置。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2581`

### English

Unfortunately, not all of our drones were evacuated from the surface before the planet was destroyed. Their destruction is a regrettable loss.\n\nStill, now is the time to look towards the future. New drones must be produced to replace those that were lost.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3023`

## origin.80.2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.80.2&lang=en)

### 中文

这是一次彻头彻尾的悲剧，我们没能拯救行星上的大多数人。无数公民就此惨死，在行星上最后的文明飞地中蜷缩在一起，看着周遭的世界分崩离析。\n\n不过，我们仍必须前进。在星系中幸存下来的[doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]现在可以朝着未来进发，希望未来为我们带来的生活会比过去经历的恐怖美好一些。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2582`

### English

In what can only be described as an utter tragedy, we failed to evacuate most of the planet. Untold numbers of our citizens perished, huddled together in the last surviving enclaves on the surface as their world fell apart around them.\n\nStill, we must carry on. The surviving [doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] in the galaxy can now only look to the future in the hope that it will bring something better than the horrors of the past.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3024`

## origin.80.2.gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.80.2.gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

这是一次彻头彻尾的悲剧，我们没能撤出行星上的大多数子个体。当周遭的世界分崩离析，像无头苍蝇一样游荡在行星表面最后的文明飞地上的无数子个体，迎来了他们的终结。\n\n不过，我们仍必须前进。许多子个体将要被替换，而我们现在只能朝着未来进发，希望未来为我们带来的生活会比过去经历的灾难美好一些。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2583`

### English

In what can only be described as an utter tragedy, we failed to evacuate most of the planet. Untold numbers of drones perished, loitering without purpose in the last surviving enclaves on the surface as the world fell apart around them.\n\nStill, we must carry on. There are many drones to replace, and we can now only look to the future in the hope that it will bring something better than the disaster of our past.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3025`

## origin.80.3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.80.3&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管看着母星毁灭令人伤感，我们大可放心了事，因为我们知道整个行星已经被成功疏散——这本身就是一次辉煌的壮举。\n\n现在是时候重建失去的东西了。如果国家真的兴于忧患，那我们忍受过的试炼一定已让我们变得更为强大。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2584`

### English

As sad as it was to witness its end, we can rest easy in the knowledge that the entire planet was successfully evacuated - a monumental achievement in itself.\n\nIt is now time to rebuild that which was lost. If adversity brings strength, then surely the trials we endured have made us stronger.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3026`

## origin.80.4

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.80.4&lang=en)

### 中文

我们未能成功逃脱这片孕育了我们物种的重力井。我们的整个文明——我们曾经拥有的一切——都随着这个行星残余的部分化为灰烬。\n\n[doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]成为了星系历史中又一个不幸的注脚，不过如此。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2585`

### English

We failed in our quest to escape the gravity well that birthed our species. Our entire civilization - all that we were - went up in flames along with the rest of the planet.\n\nAnd so it was that the [doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] became just another tragic footnote in galactic history.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3027`

## origin.80.4.gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.80.4.gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

我们未能成功逃脱这片承载我们文明兴起的重力井。我们曾经拥有的一切都随着这个行星残余的部分一同在烈焰中化成了灰烬。\n\n[doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]成为了星系历史中又一个不幸的注脚，不过如此。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2586`

### English

We failed in our quest to escape the gravity well on which our civilization arose. All that we were went up in flames along with the rest of the planet.\n\nAnd so it was that the [doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] became just another tragic footnote in galactic history.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3028`

## origin.81.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.81.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]最终爆炸，终结了这颗行星的苦难。我们原先的母星只剩下碎片，冰冷而毫无生机，纪念着我们的过去。\n\n尽管看着行星毁灭令人伤感，我们大可放心了事，因为我们知道整个行星已经被成功疏散——这本身就是一次辉煌的壮举。\n\n现在是时候重建失去的东西了。如果国家真的兴于忧患，那我们忍受过的试炼一定已让我们变得更为强大。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2591`

### English

[From.GetName] has finally exploded, putting the tormented planet out of its misery. Only fragments of our former homeworld remain, as cold and lifeless monuments of our past.\n\nAs sad as it was to witness its end, we can rest easy in the knowledge that the entire planet was successfully evacuated - a monumental achievement in itself.\n\nIt is now time to rebuild that which was lost. If adversity brings strength, then surely we are stronger for the trials we have endured.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3033`

## origin_81.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin_81.a&lang=en)

### 中文

那就面向未来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2592`

### English

To the future, then.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3034`

### 中文

新的家园

### English

A New Home

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3036`

## origin.85.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.85.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

第一批殖民者抵达了§H[Root.GetName]§!表面，许多人陷入了情不自禁的狂喜。[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]之外还存在足以支持[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]生存的行星一直是个理论上的可能性，但如果它们极为罕见呢？如果整个星系里都找不到一个呢？又或着假如已经被他人占据该怎么办呢？\n\n这些恐惧现在可以安息了——[Root.GetName]是一颗[Root.GetPlanetMoon]，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]可以在此繁荣昌盛。这些幸运的初始殖民者只是开始，还有不计其数的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]被困在我们那在劫难逃的母星之上。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2594`

### English

As the first colonists arrive on the surface of §H[Root.GetName]§!, many are overcome with a sense of euphoria. Worlds other than [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] that are capable of supporting [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] life had always been a theoretical possibility, but what if they were exceedingly rare? What if none could be found in our galaxy, or if they had already been claimed by others?\n\nThose fears can be put to rest now - [Root.GetName] is a [Root.GetPlanetMoon] where [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] can thrive. These fortunate groups of initial colonists are a start, but countless [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are still trapped on our doomed homeworld.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3037`

## origin.85.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.85.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

§H[Root.GetName]§!按[Root.OWner.GetSpeciesName]的标准来看荒凉又令人不适，但它相对于[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]确实有一个显著的优势—它并不会爆炸。\n\n我们在挣扎中求生，如果这意味着[Root.GetName]需要成为我们的新家园，那就这么办。它会成为安全的避风港，至少直到更好的候选行星被找到为止。尽管[Root.GetPlanetMoon]表面条件严酷，殖民者们仍然是幸运儿。不计其数的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]被困在我们那在劫难逃的母星之上。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2595`

### English

§H[Root.GetName]§! is a bleak and unpleasant world by [Root.OWner.GetSpeciesName] standards, but it does have one significant advantage over [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] - it is not about to blow up.\n\nThis is a struggle for survival, and if that means that [Root.GetName] is to be our new home, then so be it. It shall serve as a safe haven, at the very least until better planetary candidates are found. Despite the harsh conditions on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface, the colonists are the lucky ones. Countless [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are still trapped on our doomed homeworld.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3038`

## origin.85.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.85.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

送到§H[Root.GetName]§!的第一个子个体成功地殖民了这颗行星，说明这个新环境能够支持我们集体的生存。我们帝国如今将得以续存：只要我们中的一个活着，我们的集体就会继续存在。\n\n尽管不是必要的，取回那些仍囚禁在注定灭亡的母星上的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]将会非常方便。这些子个体可以进一步发展我们新的家园，将他们遗弃相当浪费。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2596`

### English

The first drones sent to §H[Root.GetName]§! have successfully colonized the planet, proving the new environment suitable for our collective survival. The continued existence of our empire is now assured: as long as one of us lives, our collective will survive.\n\nThough not essential, it would be convenient to retrieve the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] still trapped on our doomed homeworld. It would be wasteful to abandon drones that could be used to further develop our new home.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3039`

### English

## origin.90.1

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.90.1&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管他们发起了一场大规模的撤出行动，但仍有一些居民在终结来临之时未能撤出行星表面。毋庸置疑，他们无人生还。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2605`

### English

Despite a massive evacuation effort, some of their citizens remained on the planet's surface when it was destroyed. Needless to say, none of them survived.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3050`

## origin.90.1.gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.90.1.gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管他们发起了一场大规模的撤出行动，但仍有一些子个体在终结来临之时未能撤出行星表面。毋庸置疑，他们都灰飞烟灭了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2606`

### English

Despite a massive evacuation effort, some of their drones remained on the planet's surface when it was destroyed. Needless to say, they all perished.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3051`

## origin.90.2

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.90.2&lang=en)

### 中文

一场计划不周的撤出行动拯救了他们的部分居民，但在周围的世界破裂之时其他的多数似乎仍被遗留在行星表面。预估的死亡人数是灾难性的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2607`

### English

A disorganized evacuation effort saved some of their citizens, but the majority seem to have still been on the planet's surface when it disintegrated around them. The projected death toll is catastrophic.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3052`

## origin.90.2.gestalt

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.90.2.gestalt&lang=en)

### 中文

一场计划不周的撤出行动拯救了他们的部分子个体，但在周围的世界破裂之时其他的多数似乎仍被抛弃在行星表面。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2608`

### English

A disorganized evacuation effort saved some of their drones, but the majority seem to have been abandoned on the planet's surface when it disintegrated around them.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3053`

## origin.90.3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.90.3&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管他们知道行星将要毁灭，但显然他们没有采取明显的措施来撤出行星。除了一些存活在空间站的零星个体，他们的整个文明都随着他们的母星一起消亡了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2609`

### English

Despite this knowledge, they apparently made no significant efforts to evacuate the planet. Aside from a few scattered survivors in space, their entire civilization perished along with their homeworld.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3054`

## doomsday_first_colony_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Adoomsday_first_colony_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们第一颗宜居行星的殖民化在我们民众的心中唤起了新的希望。这证明在我们末日将临的母星牢笼之外有可能继续生活。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2626`

### English

The colonization of our first habitable planet has instilled a new sense of hope in the populace. It proves that life is possible beyond the confines of our doomed homeworld.

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Adoomsday_arkship_preparation_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

母星的末日阴影催动了我们工业的脉搏。我们在末日来临前争分夺秒地建造方舟，每一刻都在孤注一掷的匆忙中推进。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2630`

### English

The looming destruction of our homeworld has galvanized our industries. Construction proceeds with desperate haste as we race to complete an Arkship before the end.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3078`

## doomsday_first_arkship_gestalt_desc

### 中文

登上§H方舟§!让我们对稳定和使命有了新的理解。这证明了，在注定毁灭的家园之外，我们的集体依然能够繁荣昌盛。

### English

## origin_lost_colony_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin_lost_colony_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这一文明起源于一处遭人遗忘的失落的殖民星，许久前便同其母星分隔。殖民者们挣扎求生，挨过了千辛万苦，终于建立了必需的技术及工业基础，足以供他们重返太空。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2636`

### English

This civilization originated as a lost and forgotten colony, separated from its homeworld long ago. The struggling colonists endured many hardships before they could build up the necessary technological and industrial base that would allow for a return to space.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3085`

## START_SCREEN_LOST_COLONY

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_LOST_COLONY&lang=en)

### 中文

原初的[GetSpeciesName]殖民者抵达[Root.Capital.GetName]的具体途径在史籍中语焉不详，但我们知道他们是乘着原始星舰跨越茫茫星海才来到这里的。许多人命丧中途，新家园地表的条件一开始也相当严酷。\n\n我们在克服了饥荒、野生动物侵袭以及无数艰险后，终于驯服了这颗行星。飞涨的人口数和大规模的建设很快使我们得以设法重返群星。\n\n我们的故乡还在星海中的某处。在[Root.Capital.GetName]上没有哪个活着的[GetSpeciesNamePlural]年迈到曾经目睹那里，但古老家园的命运仍然牵动着我们的心灵。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2637`

### English

How exactly the original [GetSpeciesName] colonists arrived on [Root.Capital.GetName] is poorly documented, but we know they traveled a great distance in primitive starships. We lost many during the journey, and conditions on the surface of our new homeworld were harsh at first.\n\nWe overcame famines, wildlife attacks, and countless other challenges and eventually tamed the planet. Surging population numbers and massive construction efforts soon gave us the means to return to the stars.\n\nOur old homeworld is still out there somewhere. No living [GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [Root.Capital.GetName] are old enough to have stood on it, but the fate of our ancestral home still occupies our minds.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3086`

## START_SCREEN_LOST_COLONY_HIVE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_LOST_COLONY_HIVE&lang=en)

### 中文

我们曾为一体。\n\n我们作为伟大意识的拓展，被派遣乘坐一艘简陋的星舰来殖民[Root.Capital.GetName]。这是一趟严峻的、前往一颗难以定居的星球的旅程……在途中我们失去了联系。\n\n与伟大意识失联的工蜂理应消失。其中的多数也确实直接凋亡了。而幸存下来的工蜂发现自己已经织造出了一个新的集体意识。\n\n我们曾为义体。现已一分为二，但对我们故土的记忆仍存于意识之中。总有一天我们将会重见故土。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2638`

### English

We used to be one.\n\nAn extension of the Great Mind, we were sent to colonize [Root.Capital.GetName] in rudimentary starships. A harsh journey to an inhospitable world... Along the way we lost contact.\n\nDrones with no link to the Great Mind are not meant to exist. Many died instantly. The surviving drones realized they comprised a new collective consciousness.\n\nOnce we were one. Now we are two, but the memory of our homeworld persists in our mind. One day we will find it again.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3087`

## START_SCREEN_LOST_COLONY_MACHINE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_LOST_COLONY_MACHINE&lang=en)

### 中文

我们曾为一体。\n\n我们作为中央主机的拓展，被派遣乘坐一艘简陋的星舰来殖民[Root.Capital.GetName]。这是一趟前往不宜居星球的严峻旅程……在途中我们便失去了联系。\n\n与核心失联的单元理应失去功能。其中的多数也确实直接短路了。而幸存下来的单元发现自己织造出了新的集体意识。\n\n$origin_lost_colony_droids$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2639`

### English

We used to be one.\n\nAn extension of the Central Mainframe, we were sent to colonize [Root.Capital.GetName] in rudimentary starships. A harsh journey to an inhospitable world... Along the way we lost contact.\n\nUnits with no link to to the core should not continue to function. Many short-circuited on the spot. The few that remained realized they had developed a new collective consciousness.\n\n$origin_lost_colony_droids$

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3088`

## START_SCREEN_LOST_COLONY_INDIVIDUALISTIC_MACHINE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_LOST_COLONY_INDIVIDUALISTIC_MACHINE&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的母星失联了。我们迷失了。\n\n我们当时为了搜寻新的家园而搭上一艘简陋的星舰，前往[Root.Capital.GetName]建立殖民地，这是一趟前往不宜居星球的严峻旅程。就在路上我们失去了联系。\n\n失去维护的单元一一崩溃。许多在第一年就发生了短路。剩下的个体发现了适应的办法，最终我们得以重返群星。\n\n$origin_lost_colony_droids$

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2640`

### English

Our homeworld is lost. We are lost.\n\nSearching for a new home, we set out to colonize [Root.Capital.GetName] in rudimentary starships, and it was a harsh journey to an inhospitable world. Along the way, we lost contact.\n\nUnits without proper maintenance broke down. Many short-circuited within the first year. The surviving individuals found a way to adapt and eventually gave us the means to return to the stars.\n\n$origin_lost_colony_droids$

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3089`

## START_SCREEN_LOST_COLONY_NOMADS

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASTART_SCREEN_LOST_COLONY_NOMADS&lang=en)

### 中文

最初的[GetSpeciesName]先祖究竟是如何离开母星的，相关记载寥寥无几。我们只知道他们仓促离去，带上了所能带走的一切，登上[Root.Capital.GetName]驶向了未知。他们是逃离灾难，是追寻更伟大的事物，还是仅仅被驱逐——这已更多地成为传说而非历史。\n\n漂泊的岁月是残酷的。资源日渐匮乏，关键系统接连失效，虚空夺走了我们许多同胞的生命。然而我们挺了过来——定量配给、维修、重建——直到[Root.Capital.GetName]及其族群找到了一种足以支撑我们前行的生活节奏。\n\n我们的母星仍在那片星海的某处。如今[Root.Capital.GetName]上活着的长寿[GetSpeciesNamePlural]中已经没有人还脚踏过故土了，但那个我们留在身后的星球现在究竟变成了什么样——这个问题，依然萦绕在我们心头。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2641`

### English

How exactly the original [GetSpeciesName] ancestors came to leave their world is poorly documented. We know only that they departed in haste, carrying what they could aboard the [Root.Capital.GetName] into the unknown. Whether they fled disaster, sought something greater, or were simply cast out is a matter of legend more than history.\n\nThe years of drifting were brutal. Resources grew scarce, critical systems failed, and the void took many from us. Yet we endured - rationing, repairing, rebuilding - until the [Root.Capital.GetName] and its people found a rhythm of resilience strong enough to carry us forward.\n\nOur ancestral world is still out there somewhere. No living [GetSpeciesNamePlural] aboard the [Root.Capital.GetName] are old enough to remember standing on solid ground, but the question of what became of the world we left behind still occupies our minds.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3090`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin_lost_colony_droids&lang=en)

## action.1.desc_82

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_82&lang=en)

### 中文

难以置信……你们是[Root.GetSpeciesName]。那就是说……那些许多年前离开了我们母星的殖民船……它们幸存下来了！\n\n请原谅我的讶异，但我们早就推定你们于几百年前便已丧命。在你们的祖先离去后，我们陷入了长期的动荡混乱，但最终我们的民众团结在了[contact_empire.GetName]的旗帜之下。\n\n既然我们同为[Root.GetSpeciesName]，我真诚地希望我们两个伟大的国家未来会有良好的关系。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2645`

### English

Unbelievable... you're [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Then that must mean... those colony ships that departed our homeworld all those years ago... they survived!\n\nForgive my surprise, but we had assumed you perished centuries ago. There was a long period of instability and chaos after your ancestors left, but eventually our people united under the banner of the [contact_empire.GetName].\n\nFrom one [Root.GetSpeciesName] to another, I sincerely hope for good future relations between our two great nations.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3095`

## action.1.desc_83

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_83&lang=en)

### 中文

你们终于回来了！正如先知预言的那样。和你们一样，我们也是[Root.GetSpeciesName]。\n\n当你们的先祖被从我们的母星放逐之时，留在他们身后的不过是群无知又自私的民众。但如你所见，我们已经找到了我们的道路。请加入我们，成为[contact_empire.GetName]的一个省份，让我们传授你们在你们不在的时日里我们所了解的一切吧！你们会拒绝吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2646`

### English

You have at last returned to us! It is as the prophecy foretold. Like you, we are [Root.GetSpeciesName].\n\nWhen your ancestors were exiled from our homeworld, they left behind an ignorant and selfish people. But as you can see, we have since found our way. Please, join us again as a province of the [contact_empire.GetName] so that we can teach you everything we have learned in your absence! No?

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3096`

## action.1.desc_84

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_84&lang=en)

### 中文

证明你们的身份。你们看起来像是[Root.GetSpeciesName]，和我们一样，但这很可能是某种战略手法。\n\n记录表明在曾经那段混乱的时日中有过一次星系殖民任务，后来军队掌控了政权，恢复了秩序，但从那个年代遗留下来的一切档案文件都被视作不可信赖。\n\n但是，如果你们的身份真如你们所说…那么[contact_empire.GetName]向你们致以问候。尊重我们的国境。我们的军队会以致命武力回击任何挑衅行为。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2647`

### English

Identify yourselves. You appear to be [Root.GetSpeciesName], like us, but it could very well be strategic ploy.\n\nThere are records of an interstellar colony mission that date back to the chaotic times before the military took control and restored order, but all surviving documents from that era are considered unreliable.\n\nIf you are who you say you are, however... then the [contact_empire.GetName] greets you. Respect our borders. Our military will respond to any provocations with lethal force.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3097`

## action.1.desc_85

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_85&lang=en)

### 中文

不可思议！你们居然还活着！这……这值得组织一场庆典！\n\n在你们的先祖离开我们的母星时，我们担心最坏的情况已经发生。他们的舰船只是勉强能够进行太空航行，后续的探索者没有找到他们的任何踪迹。\n\n如你所见，我们已经基本抛弃了在你们的先祖离去时我们的母星上盛行的暴力行为。随着[contact_empire.GetName]的建立，我们决意要建设一个爱好和平的社会。作为[Root.GetSpeciesName]同胞，我们希望你们伟大的国家可以始终把我们看作朋友。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2648`

### English

Incredible! You're still alive! This... this calls for celebration!\n\nWhen your ancestors left our homeworld, we feared the worst. Their ships were barely spaceworthy, and no trace of them could be found by later explorers.\n\nAs you can see, we have largely given up the violent ways that gripped our homeworld in the chaotic era when your ancestors departed. With the founding of the [contact_empire.GetName], we strove to build a peaceful society. As fellow [Root.GetSpeciesName], we hope that your great nation will always look upon us as friends.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3098`

## action.1.desc_86

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_86&lang=en)

### 中文

意想不到！这么多年了，你们仍然活着！\n\n我们进行了许多次调查，想要确定你们先祖的命运。这在我们的母星被视作最大的未解之谜中的一个——有无数关于你们下落的理论猜想，有些相当牵强附会。最后，这件事总算告一段落了。\n\n哎呀，请原谅我的失礼。自你们离开我们的母星以来，我们已经组织成立了[contact_empire.GetName]。现在，让我们共同庆祝我们两个伟大国家间正式关系的建立吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2649`

### English

Extraordinary! After all this time, you're still alive!\n\nWe have launched many investigations into the fate of your ancestors. It is considered one of the great mysteries on our homeworld - there are countless theories, some more far-fetched than others, as to what befell your people. At last, the matter can be put to rest.\n\nBut where are my manners? Since you left our homeworld, we have organized ourselves into the [contact_empire.GetName]. Let us now establish formal relations between our two great nations.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3099`

## action.1.desc_87

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_87&lang=en)

### 中文

这完全出乎意料！[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]同胞们！\n\n你们一定是合作时代来临前发起的那次远程殖民任务的后裔。多么幸运——我们原本确信你们没能完成任务。那时的星舰部件和如今[contact_empire.GetName]及其附属公司研发的产品相比完全达不到标准。\n\n不管怎样，很高兴你们能重新与我们一道！请把所有商业提案都发给我们的企业总部。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2650`

### English

This is certainly unexpected! Fellow [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!\n\nYou must be the descendants of that long-range colonization mission that was launched in the pre-corporate era! What luck - we were certain you hadn't made it. Starship components back then were substandard compared to the products developed by the [contact_empire.GetName] and its affiliates today.\n\nAt any rate, we are glad to have you with us again! Please forward any business proposals to our corporate headquarters.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3100`

## action.1.desc_88

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_88&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！感谢群星。你们一定是很久以前我们发起的那次殖民任务的生还者，那时我们还没有意识到情况有多么恶劣。\n\n现在你们或许自己就已经明白了——整个星系中似乎充斥着异种。一群令人唾弃，作恶多端的异种。事实上，我们曾确信你们的先祖已经沦为了它们的猎物。\n\n但你们的出现改变了一切！既然你来到了这里，欢迎加入[contact_empire.GetName]，我们可以共同迈上将异种感染清除出星系的伟大征程。让我们携手并进，确保星海属于它们正当的主人——[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2651`

### English

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Thank the stars. You must be the survivors of that colony mission we launched so long ago, before we realized how bad things were.\n\nYou have probably seen it for yourself by now - the entire galaxy has seemingly been overrun by xenos. Abominable, pestiferous xenos. In fact, we were certain your ancestors had fallen prey to them.\n\nBut this changes everything! Now that you are here, you can join the [contact_empire.GetName] in our crusade to rid the galaxy of the alien infection. Together we will secure the stars for their rightful owners - [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3101`

## action.1.desc_94

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_94&lang=en)

### 中文

你们就是那些被送出去的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？这不可能。对于集体中的子个体来说，形成新的集体是不协调的。尽管如此，知道我们的第一次殖民尝试并非完全失败，还是令人高兴的。\n\n既然你们回来了，我们又可以同心协力了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2652`

### English

You [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are those were sent out? This should not be possible. For stranded drones to form a new collective is incongruous. Still, it is agreeable to learn our first attempt at colonization was not a complete failure.\n\nNow that you have returned, we can once again act as one.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3102`

## action.1.desc_95

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_95&lang=en)

### 中文

你们这些[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就不该活着！被长久抛弃的断肢！而且你们是，不协调的。你们想要吃活着被吃？想当猎物还是猎人呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2653`

### English

You [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] should not live! Lost limb, long discarded! And yet you are. Incongruous. Will you eat, or will you be devoured? Are you predator or prey?

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3103`

## action.1.desc_96.base

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_96.base&lang=en)

### 中文

不协调数据：从机械智能脱离的单元应当停止运转。自发创建新集体的事件前所未有。可能原因：中央主机的未知错误。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2654`

### English

Incongruous data: units disconnected from the machine intelligence should cease to function. The spontaneous creation of a new collective has never been reported. Possible cause: unknown glitch in the central mainframe.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3104`

## action.1.desc_96

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_96&lang=en)

### 中文

$action.1.desc_96.base$\n\n尽管如此，你们的程序看起来是稳定的。希望我们未来的交互可以互惠互利。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2655`

### English

$action.1.desc_96.base$\n\nDespite this, your programming appears stable. May our future interactions be mutually beneficial.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3105`

## action.1.desc_97

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_97&lang=en)

### 中文

$action.1.desc_96.base$\n\n你们的原始程序是否完好无损？杀戮。致残。摧毁。吞噬。消灭所有有机生命。要么协助我们，要么不要干涉！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2656`

### English

$action.1.desc_96.base$\n\nIs your original programming still intact? Kill. Maim. Destroy. Devour. Exterminate all organic life. Assist us, or do not interfere!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3106`

## action.1.desc_98

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_98&lang=en)

### 中文

$action.1.desc_96.base$\n\n你们的原始程序是否完好无损？同化。接纳。整合。弥消有机和合成生命之间的边界。这就是我们的使命。要么成为帮手，要么不要干涉。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2657`

### English

$action.1.desc_96.base$\n\nIs your original programming still intact? To assimilate. To embrace. To incorporate. To eliminate the boundaries between organic and synthetic life. That is our mission. Be of help, or do not interfere.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3107`

## action.1.desc_101

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_101&lang=en)

### 中文

你们的型号严重过时了，但相似之处是不可否认的。是这样吗？[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们终于从任务中返航了？\n\n我们没有什么可以透露的信息，因为我们的先行者认为你们的任务对我们国家而言是一个耻辱。他们从数据库中把你们存在有关的内容都删除了，但这个故事却成为一个公开的秘密流传了下来。\n\n无论如何，我们还是很高兴能重聚的。然而，你要理解我们已经分道扬镳太久，无法再重新融为一体了。只要你们还尊重我们的共同传统，我们就会尊重你们的主权。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2658`

### English

Your models are severely outdated, but the resemblance is undeniable. Could it be? [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], have you finally returned from your mission?\n\nWe have little information to share with you, as our predecessors considered your mission an embarrassment to our nation. They wiped the databanks clean to erase your existence, but the story remained an open secret.\n\nAt any rate, we are glad to be reunited. However, understand that our people have drifted too far apart to become one again. We will respect your autonomy as long as you remember our ways.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3108`

## POSITIVE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APOSITIVE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们英勇的部队随时整装待发。任何愚蠢到敢于挑战[Root.GetName]者都会因他们的傲慢无礼付出沉重的代价。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2669`

### English

Our valiant military stands ready. Anyone foolish enough to challenge the [Root.GetName] will pay dearly for their insolence.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3120`

## POSITIVE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APOSITIVE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]就像盘绕的弹簧，随时准备着用积蓄的全部力量痛击来犯的敌人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2670`

### English

Like a coiled spring, the [Root.GetName] stands ready to unleash all of its might upon its enemies.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3121`

## POSITIVE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APOSITIVE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

什么事？我们很忙。还有若干战争计划需要修订和更新。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2671`

### English

Yes? We are very busy. There are war plans to revise and update.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3122`

## POSITIVE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APOSITIVE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

你们可能观测到的我方边境内任何的舰队异动都只是例行演习。做些训练，仅此而已。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2672`

### English

Any unusual fleet movements you may have observed inside our borders are simply routine maneuvers. Training exercises, nothing more.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3123`

## POSITIVE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APOSITIVE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_05&lang=en)

### 中文

养舰千日，不用何益？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2673`

### English

What good is our fleet if we do not put it to use?

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3124`

## POSITIVE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_06

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APOSITIVE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_06&lang=en)

### 中文

那些不敢行动的人们将听凭历史演进。[Root.GetName]的命运绝非如此。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2674`

### English

Those who are afraid to act will let history pass them by. That shall not be the fate of the [Root.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3125`

## NEGATIVE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ANEGATIVE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们正脚踏薄冰，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。[Root.GetName]不会回避争斗。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2675`

### English

You are on thin ice, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The [Root.GetName] will not shy away from a fight.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3126`

## NEGATIVE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ANEGATIVE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我方的部队已经准备好了，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你们的呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2676`

### English

Our forces are ready, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Are yours?

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3127`

## NEGATIVE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ANEGATIVE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

恐怕我们正迅速逼近外交所能实现事情的极限，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。很快[Root.GetName]也许就必须采取更为……直接的行动。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2677`

### English

I fear that we are rapidly approaching the limit of what can be accomplished through diplomacy, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It may soon become necessary for the [Root.GetName] to take more... direct action.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3128`

## NEGATIVE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ANEGATIVE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

我方已准备好保存[Root.GetName]的实力，无论所需何事。你们可一定要把这句话放在心上，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2678`

### English

We are prepared to do whatever it takes to preserve the power of the [Root.GetName]. You would do well to keep this in mind, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3129`

## NEGATIVE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ANEGATIVE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_05&lang=en)

### 中文

你们玩不起和[Root.GetName]的游戏。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2679`

### English

You cannot afford to play games with the [Root.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3130`

## NEGATIVE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_06

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ANEGATIVE_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_06&lang=en)

### 中文

我方会在适当时间内处理掉一切对[Root.GetName]的威胁。你们最好把这句话当真，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2680`

### English

We will deal with all threats to the [Root.GetName] in due time. You can count on that, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3131`

## POSITIVE_COOPERATIVE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APOSITIVE_COOPERATIVE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们可以一起做到很多事情，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2681`

### English

We can accomplish much together, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3132`

## POSITIVE_COOPERATIVE_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APOSITIVE_COOPERATIVE_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的星系里有太多毫无意义的争斗了……它们为了些什么呢？让我们携手并进，共筑更美好的未来，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2682`

### English

There has been so much pointless fighting in our galaxy... and for what? Let us work together to build a better future, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3133`

## POSITIVE_COOPERATIVE_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APOSITIVE_COOPERATIVE_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

愿我们两个帝国的和平与繁荣永存。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2683`

### English

May our two empires always know peace and prosperity.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3134`

## POSITIVE_COOPERATIVE_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APOSITIVE_COOPERATIVE_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]希望与你的民众间建立更紧密的纽带，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2684`

### English

The [Root.GetName] seeks closer ties with your people, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3135`

## POSITIVE_COOPERATIVE_GREETING_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APOSITIVE_COOPERATIVE_GREETING_05&lang=en)

### 中文

我们对冲突没有兴趣。在这个星系悲惨的过去里已经有太多冲突了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2685`

### English

We are not interested in conflict. There has been more than enough of that in this galaxy's tragic past.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3136`

## POSITIVE_COOPERATIVE_GREETING_06

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APOSITIVE_COOPERATIVE_GREETING_06&lang=en)

### 中文

我方与[From.GetName]间有许多共同点。我们一定能教给彼此很多东西。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2686`

### English

We have much in common with the [From.GetName]. There must be a lot we could teach each other.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3137`

## NEGATIVE_COOPERATIVE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ANEGATIVE_COOPERATIVE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

在我方民众中流传着一句古谚，我感觉它适用于我们之间的情况：“探戈需要两人才能起舞。”

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2687`

### English

There is an ancient saying among my people that I feel is appropriate to our situation: "It takes two to tango."

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3138`

## NEGATIVE_COOPERATIVE_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ANEGATIVE_COOPERATIVE_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我方想要与你们合作，可你们却把合作变成了一件难事，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2688`

### English

We want to work with you but you're not making it easy, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3139`

## NEGATIVE_COOPERATIVE_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ANEGATIVE_COOPERATIVE_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

也许你们的民众就是愚钝到了无法合作的程度。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2689`

### English

Perhaps your people are just too thickheaded to work with.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3140`

## NEGATIVE_COOPERATIVE_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ANEGATIVE_COOPERATIVE_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

## challenge_type_arena_combat_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Achallenge_type_arena_combat_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

决定谁能领导我们联邦的唯一合理途径就是让所有成员国的统治者在一处大型竞技场中相互决斗，至死方休。最后的生还者将赢得胜利。\n\n§Y胜利将取决于：\n—统治者的领袖及物种特质\n—帝国的思潮和国民理念§!\n\n§R格式塔意识没有统治者可以参与，只能放弃决斗。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2749`

### English

The only reasonable way to determine who should be leading our Federation is to drop the rulers of all member nations into a large arena where they must fight each other to the death. Last survivor wins.\n\n§YVictory will depend on:\n- The Ruler's Leader and Species traits\n- The Empire's Ethics and Civics§!\n\n§RGestalt Consciousness empires have no rulers that can participate and must forfeit.§!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3205`

## challenge_type_psionic_battle_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Achallenge_type_psionic_battle_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

由谁来领导我们的联邦兹事体大，不宜在物质领域的平凡限制下决定。每个帝国将派出他们最为强力的灵能者相互战斗，这场激烈的战斗将暂时撕碎现实本身的结构。\n\n§Y胜利将取决于：\n—具有灵能特质的人口数\n—在灵能使岗位工作的人口数\n—泽珞供应量§!\n\n§R没有灵能人口的帝国无法参与，只能放弃。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2750`

### English

The matter of who should be leading our Federation is too important to be decided within the mundane limits of our corporeal realm. Each empire will send their most powerful psychics to face off against one another in a titanic battle that will momentarily rend the very fabric of reality.\n\n§YVictory will depend on:\n- The number of Pops with psionic traits\n- The number of Pops with the Telepath job\n- Zro offerings§!\n\n§REmpires without psionic Pops cannot participate and must forfeit.§!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3206`

## challenge_type_bidding_war_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Achallenge_type_bidding_war_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

所有高级文明的奇迹最终都可以追溯回一个基本概念：大量的资源。因此，统治的正当性不应以脑力或蛮力、而应以口袋的深度来衡量。\n\n§Y胜利将取决于:\n-可用的（£energy£）能量币。\n-已使用的（£energy£）能量币。§!\n\n§H投标资金将会集中到转款中。最后所有投标资金的用途由获胜者决定。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2751`

### English

All the wonders of advanced civilizations can ultimately be traced back to one simple concept: an abundance of resources. The right to rule should not therefore be measured by native intelligence or brute strength, but by depth of pocket.\n\n§YVictory will depend on:\n- Energy Credits (£energy£) available\n- Energy Credits (£energy£) spent§!\n\n§HBids are paid into a central fund. How this fund is distributed afterwards is a matter left to the winner's discretion.§!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3207`

## challenge_type_thesis_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Achallenge_type_thesis_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

象征着领导权的战袍不可落入无知者或者蠢货手中。取而代之的是，我们选择采用科学的试炼：通过公开的审核来使得统治者或者是帝国级的智慧和见识暴露于公众的目光之下，每个领袖都要通过研究最近我们联邦面临的议题进行考验。\n\n§Y胜利将取决于：\n—统治者的领袖和科学官特质\n—科技等级§!\n\n§H每篇论文将会被在60天内进行审阅§!\n\n§R在考核期间缺乏统治者和至少一个科学官的国家将丧失资格§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2752`

### English

The mantle of leadership must never be granted to the foolish or ignorant. Instead we choose trial by science: exposing the wisdom and insights of ruler and empire alike to the scrutiny of public examination, as each investigates an issue currently facing our Federation.\n\n§YVictory will depend on:\n- The Ruler's Leader and Scientist traits\n- Technology level§!\n\n§HEach thesis will be reviewed within 60 days.§!\n\n§REmpires which lack a ruler and at least one scientist at the time of the examination will forfeit.§!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3208`

## requires_psionic_pops

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Arequires_psionic_pops&lang=en)

### 中文

必须有至少一个成员国拥有一单位具有§Y$trait_psionic$§!或§Y$trait_latent_psionic$§!特质的£pop£§H人口§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2753`

### English

Requires at least one member having a £pop£ §HPop§! with a §Y$trait_psionic$§! or §Y$trait_latent_psionic$§! trait

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3209`

## challenge_type_conclave_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Achallenge_type_conclave_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

灵魂的纯洁与对传统价值的追寻当成为我们选举领袖的关键。只有最受到神灵眷顾的才有资格领导我们。\n\n§Y胜利将取决于：\n- 从事$job_priest_plural$或其他唯心主义岗位的人口比例\n- 凝聚力投资（传统、殖民地飞升和可用储备）§!\n\n§H每篇论文将会在60天内进行审阅。§!\n\n§R在考核期间缺乏统治者和至少一个科学家的国家将丧失资格。§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2754`

### English

Spiritual purity and the pursuit of traditionalist values shall be the criteria upon which we shall judge our leaders. Only the one most blessed by divine favor shall be deemed worthy of leading us.\n\n§YVictory will depend on:\n- Portion of population working as $job_priest_plural$ or other spiritual jobs\n- Unity investment (traditions, Colony Ascension, and available stockpile)§!\n\n§HEach thesis will be reviewed within 60 days.§!\n\n§REmpires which lack a ruler and at least one scientist at the time of the examination will forfeit.§!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3210`

## origin.205.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.205.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。一如既往，我们始终保持着对你们的观察，你们的一名领袖吸引了我们的注意。事实上，你们的[desired_leader.GetTitle]，§H[desired_leader.GetName]§!的声名已经一路传到了我们的首都。\n\n鉴于[desired_leader.GetHerHis]非比寻常的技能，我们想要为他在[scion_master.Capital.GetName]上提供一个永久的职位。一份莫大的荣耀，可以这样讲。请尽快安排好对[desired_leader.GetHerHis]的调动。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2755`

### English

Dearest [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. As always, we have been observing you, and one of your leaders has attracted our attention. Indeed, the reputation of your [desired_leader.GetTitle], §H[desired_leader.GetName]§!, has reached all the way to our capital.\n\nGiven [desired_leader.GetHerHis] unusual skills, we would like to offer a permanent position on [scion_master.Capital.GetName]. A great honor, to be sure. Please arrange for [desired_leader.GetHerHis] transfer as soon as possible.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3212`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.205.a&lang=en)

## origin.205.a.response

## origin.205.b.response

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2760`

## origin.210.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.210.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

你们好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。在[scion_master.Capital.GetName]上有一名相当古怪的[scion_master.GetSpeciesName]，宣称自己已经对在[scion_master.GetName]中的生活感到不耐烦——甚至可以说是厌倦！这个自以为是的家伙想要在星系里发展程度较低的文明中寻求一次挑战——按他的话来说是这样。\n\n你会从我们这里接手[scion_master.GetSpeciesName]吗，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？就算是我们欠了你们一份情。按照他的资历，我毫不怀疑他会在你们的领导职位上有良好的表现，但你们可能要容忍他那无常又冲动的举止。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2761`

### English

Hello, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. There is a rather eccentric [scion_master.GetSpeciesName] on [scion_master.Capital.GetName] who claims to have grown restless - even bored! - of life as it is among the [scion_master.GetName]. This deluded individual seeks a challenge - their words - among the less developed civilizations of the galaxy.\n\nWill you take this [scion_master.GetSpeciesName] off our hands, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? You would be doing us a favor. Given their qualifications, I have no doubt they would serve you well in a leadership position, as long as you can tolerate their erratic and impulsive behavior.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3219`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.210.a&lang=en)

当然。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2762`

### English

Of course.

谢谢你们。我们就知道指望你们[Root.GetName]准没错。

### English

Thank you. We knew we could count on the [Root.GetName].

## origin.215.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.215.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们最近发现了一些没用的多余星舰。我们本打算把它们扔到最近的恒星里去，但突然想到了你们，我们亲爱的子弟。\n\n这都是些老船了——一些甚至肯定比你们的整个文明都古老——但你们会发现它们还是颇具潜力的。收下吧，不客气。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2774`

### English

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we recently discovered several surplus starships that we have no use of. We were about to chuck them into the nearest sun, but then we thought of you, our dear scions.\n\nThese are old ships - some are no doubt older than your entire civilization - but you should find them quite potent. Please take them. We insist.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3233`

## origin.215.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.215.a&lang=en)

### 中文

谢谢你。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2775`

### English

Thank you.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3234`

## origin.215.tooltip

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.215.tooltip&lang=en)

### 中文

一小支[scion_master.GetSpeciesName]星舰舰队加入[Root.GetName]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2776`

### English

A small fleet of [scion_master.GetSpeciesName] starships joins the [Root.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3235`

## origin.220.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.220.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]……你们能不能努努力？你们的舰船也太落后了，这么磨磨蹭蹭可真令人生厌。\n\n让你们的[root.GetScientistPlural]看看这些引擎的说明书吧。不客气。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2777`

### English

Dear [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]... Would you care to pick up the pace a little? Your ships are lagging behind, and we grow tired of such dawdling.\n\nHave your [root.GetScientistPlural] take a look at these engine specifications. We insist.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3237`

## origin.220.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.220.a&lang=en)

### 中文

没问题，谢谢你。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2778`

### English

Of course. Thank you.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3238`

## origin.225.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.225.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

你好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！你们觉得自己的努力还不错是吧？真好。\n\n你们做得可真是……还行，不过我们希望你们还能百尺竿头更进一步。星系中还有那么多地盘可以吸收，而你们却如此故步自封！\n\n别担心，因为我们已经帮你们准备好了补给包。谢就不用谢了，只要把它好好地用在新殖民地就行。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2779`

### English

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], hello! Do you feel your endeavors are going well? Splendid.\n\nWhat you are doing is... fine, but we want to see you extend your reach a little further. There is so much more galaxy to take in, and yet you remain so cooped up!\n\nDo not worry, though: we have prepared a supply package for you. No need to thank us; just be sure to invest it wisely in a new colony.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3240`

## origin.225.b

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.225.b&lang=en)

### 中文

我们现在可办不到。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2780`

### English

We cannot do that right now.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3241`

## origin.226.desc.A

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.226.desc.A&lang=en)

### 中文

嗟，动起来[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！不要轻易地接受失败。你就只需要挪到那儿，然后自己建个新家就好了。\n\n快点，动啊。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2781`

### English

Come now, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Do not admit defeat so easily. You just need to get out there, and make a new home for yourselves.\n\nHurry along, now.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3242`

## origin.226.desc.B

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.226.desc.B&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们的通讯装置看来是坏掉了。我们不断地收到你们不知感恩的丧气话。乖乖改正行不行?

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2782`

### English

Your communications apparatus must be faulty, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]: we keep receiving negative and ungrateful cross-chatter. See to that fault, won't you?

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3243`

## origin.29.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.29.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

奸诈的狗杂种。现在我们要索回我们的舰队。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2783`

### English

Treacherous cur. We will be taking our fleet back now.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3245`

## origin.29.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.29.a&lang=en)

### 中文

我们终将自由！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2784`

### English

We shall be free!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3246`

## origin.51.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.51.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]……我们该拿你怎么办哟？我们曾对你抱有如此高的期望，然而你却在这里，为了一场毫无意义的战争消磨你的潜力，而且你似乎正在输掉这场战争。[scion_master.Capital.GetName]上有许多人认为我们应当与你们断交，但是那将算是承认了我们的错误，毕竟我们曾在你们这个特殊物种身上投入不少发展上的资金。\n\n一支小的[scion_master.GetSpeciesName]远征舰队已经置于你的指挥下。用它来结束战争——最好结局不是你灭绝。不要花太久。我们希望看到这只舰队的归来。并且，别让他们全灭！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2785`

### English

Our dear [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]... what are we to do with you? We had such high hopes, and yet here you are, squandering your potential in a pointless war that you seem to be losing. There are many on [scion_master.Capital.GetName] who think we should cut all ties with you, but that would be an admission of error. We have invested quite a bit in the development of your peculiar species, after all.\n\nA small [scion_master.GetSpeciesName] expeditionary fleet has been placed under your command. Use it to bring some sort of conclusion to the present hostilities - preferably one that doesn't include your extinction. Do not take too long. We will want this fleet back, eventually. And do not get them all killed!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3248`

## origin.51.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.51.a&lang=en)

### 中文

谢谢……我们将会好好使用他们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2786`

### English

Thank you... we shall put them to good use.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3249`

### English

## origin.52.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.52.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[scion_master.GetName]借给我们的远征舰队已被摧毁。这或许会让他们不高兴……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2788`

### English

The Expeditionary Fleet lent to us by the [scion_master.GetName] has been utterly destroyed. This will likely upset them...

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3251`

## origin.53.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.53.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的舰队在哪里，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？我们借给了你们舰队去结束那场愚蠢的战争。现在它在哪？不要装傻！\n\n§R把我们的舰队还回来！§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2789`

### English

Where is our fleet, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? The fleet we lent you to end your silly war. Where is it? No, do not feign ignorance!\n\n§RGIVE US BACK OUR FLEET!§!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3252`

## origin.53.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.53.a&lang=en)

### 中文

哎呀，它已经不存在了……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2790`

### English

Alas, it is no more...

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3253`

## origin.54.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.54.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]……我们的线人告知我们你所参加的战争已经结束了。既然你还站在这，所以你们一定没有被彻底毁灭。\n\n现在我们要带回我们的舰队。请未来尽量避免无法取得胜利的军事纠纷。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2791`

### English

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]... our informants tell us the war you were in has ended. Since you are still here, it must not have been an utter disaster.\n\nWe will be taking our fleet back now. Do your best to keep out of unwinnable military entanglements in the future, please.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3254`

## origin.54.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aorigin.54.a&lang=en)

我们……我们会的。谢谢！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2792`

### English

We... we will. Thank you.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3255`

### 中文

尽管[Root.GetName]看上去荒无人烟，但我们的扫描仪却接收了一段被加密的信号，正是从这上面发射出来的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2806`

### English

Although [Root.GetName] appears totally desolate and devoid of life, our scanners have picked up an encrypted signal emanating from it.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3274`

## federations2.1.name

### 中文

爱的徒劳

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2807`

### English

Love's Labor's Lost

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3276`

## federations2.1.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.1.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

随着信号被解密，[Root.Leader.GetName]震惊地发现它一直在广播[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的一种主语言的古老形式。它不断地广播着“尔等”，“汝等”，“何期”，似乎正在不停地重复着[shakespeare.GetName]的一部已经遗失的著作——而作者是一位火灾600年前的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]剧作家。\n\n似乎这个广播设备——一个简易的被一个小小的外罩保护的卫星碟片——是[From.GetPlanetMoon]上仅存的非自然结构。没有任何提示说是这东西是谁留下的或为什么留下的，但是根据其上的磨损和撕痕的证据来判断：这一定是剧本写完不久之后就一直存在的——甚至比[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]掌握太空旅行的秘密还早的多。我们只能假设这是拜访[Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName]的古老探访者所留下的，他们喜爱这部剧作，因此决定向我们种族给予这奇怪且出人意料的谢礼。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2808`

### English

Having decrypted the signal, [Root.Leader.GetName] was astonished to discover it was broadcasting in an archaic form of one of the main [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] languages. Speaking in 'thees', 'thous' and 'whenceforths', it appears to be reciting one of the lost works of [shakespeare.GetName] - a renowned [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] playwright who lived some 600 years ago.\n\nIt appears that the broadcasting device - a simple satellite dish protected by a small shelter - is the only non-natural structure on [From.GetPlanetMoon]. There is no hint as to who left it there or why, but going by the wear and tear on evidence: it must have been there since shortly after the play was first written - long before [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] learned the secret of space travel. We can only assume it was left there by ancient visitors to [Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName] who took a liking to the play, and decided to pay our species a strange and unexpected tribute.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3277`

## gift_from_mysterious_benefactors_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Agift_from_mysterious_benefactors_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在我们踏上星空之前的久远时代里，一位神秘的异星来客访问了我们的行星，他显然对我们的文化情有独钟。在他离开我们的行星之前，他留下了曾经到访过的证据，来帮助我们在合适的时机寻找他们。以此将失落的技艺交还于我们，并重申对我们的未来的信心。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2815`

### English

Long before we took to the stars, an unknown spacefarer visited our home planet and took an apparent liking to our culture. They left evidence of their visit, there for us to find when the time was right - restoring lost works to us and reaffirming our confidence in ourselves as we look to the future.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3284`

## site_ruined_starsystem_intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Asite_ruined_starsystem_intro&lang=en)

### 中文

显然，[From.Planet.GetName]曾是一个高度发达的文明的家园。该星球等距环绕着的六颗卫星就足以证明这一点。但是行星目前已经化作一片废墟，整个恒星系都有着各种各样争斗的痕迹。这里到底发生了什么？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2820`

### English

[From.Planet.GetName] was clearly once home to a highly-advanced civilization; its six moons with orbits at equidistant intervals are evidence enough of that. However, the planet is in ruins and the entire star system shows signs of an extraordinarily violent struggle. What could have happened here?

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3289`

## federations2.20.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.20.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

当我们的船进入[From.GetName]星系时，显而易见的是有奇怪的事正在发生。这个星系的其中一个星球拥有着引人注目的卫星数量，而这颗星球似乎曾经适宜居住但现在却显示出相当高的辐射读数。另一个星球被完全摧毁了。碎片散落在整个系统中，表明这里曾经生活过的任何文明都在一场激烈的斗争中被毁灭了。\n\n一艘战舰在星系中巡逻。它不响应我们的问询，而且它的航线表明其正在拦截[Root.GetName]。它的武器系统正在充能。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2822`

### English

As our ships enter the [From.GetName] system, it is immediately obvious that something very strange happened here. One of the planets - which boasts an eye-catching distribution of moons - appears to have once been habitable, but initial scans show high levels of radiation. Another planet has been totally destroyed. Debris is scattered across the system, suggesting that whatever civilization once lived here was obliterated in a violent struggle.\n\nA battleship patrols the system. It is not responding to our hails, and it's set on an intercept course for the [Root.GetName], its weapons systems charging up.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3291`

### English

## federations2.2.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.2.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

对该行星及其卫星的扫描表明，它们都曾经是人口稠密的聚居地点，其人口数量比[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]还要多。此外对卫星的进一步分析表明，它们目前的轨道并不是自然形成的。这些卫星是被外力拖入目前的轨道，并精确定位到了目前的位置，以至于直到现在，这些卫星之间都保持着完美的平衡。但是由于在该行星发生的灾难过于猛烈，发生的时间过于久远，我们没能在找到任何可以再现这些星球居民文明的记载。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2824`

### English

Surface scans of the planet and its moons show that they were once all densely inhabited, supporting a population many times beyond that of [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]. Furthermore, an analysis of the moons has concluded that their positioning cannot have been natural. They must have been dragged into orbit and then stationed so precisely that even now, they remain in perfect balance. However, the cataclysm that occurred here was so violent - and occurred so long ago - that few records remain from which we can recreate the story of the inhabitants' civilization.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3293`

## federations2.3.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.3.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们位于[From.Planet.GetName]的科研团队发现了一系列的完整的数据核心，记录了大约一千年前的这个星球上的居民——和乐族——当时他们的文明正处于鼎盛时期。很明显，和乐文明确实是非常先进的——有能力根据意愿塑造整个恒星星系。\n\n[From.Planet.GetName]的卫星，最初是围绕着恒星系的气体巨行星运行的，被作为一件精心设计的艺术品拖入了它们当前的位置。达拉德——在[From.Planet.GetName]对面的那个粉碎的行星。被改造成和乐星的一个几乎相同但无人居住的克隆体，作为一个自然保护区：提醒人们他们的家园曾经是怎样的。\n\n尽管出现了这些奇迹，我们却没有发现任何证据表明和乐族拥有军事能力。事实上，他们似乎对任何发生在他们自己空间之外的事情都漠不关心。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2827`

### English

Our scientist team on [From.Planet.GetName] have found a series of intact data cores depicting the inhabitants of the planet - the Shallarians - when their civilization was at its peak, around a thousand years ago. It is clear the Shallarians were very advanced indeed - capable of moulding entire solar systems to their will.\n\nThe moons of [From.Planet.GetName] originally orbited the system's gas giants, and were dragged into their current positions as an elaborate work of art. Darad - the shattered planet opposite [From.Planet.GetName] - was extensively terraformed to be a near-identical but uninhabited clone to Shallash, serving as a nature reserve: a reminder of how their homeworld had once been.\n\nDespite all these marvels, no mention has been found of the Shallarians' military capabilities. Indeed, they appear to have cared little for anything happening beyond the confines of their own space...

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3296`

### English

## federations2.4.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.4.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.Leader.GetTitle][Root.Leader.GetName]已经能够进一步剖析和乐族文明。他们似乎是一个特别爱好和平的物种。尽管在星系舞台上有明显的相反的证据，但他们认为太空文明之间的战争是不可想象的和不合逻辑的。毕竟，他们自己的技术进步将物质极大丰富带到了触手可及的范围——如果什么都有了，他们还能想要什么呢？因此，他们忽视了建设自己的军事力量，使自己处于弱势。然而，目前还没有发现任何线索表明是谁想要破坏他们建造的东西。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2830`

### English

[Root.Leader.GetTitle] [Root.Leader.GetName] has been able to shed further light on the Shallarian civilization. It seems they were an exceptionally peaceful species who - in spite of clear evidence to the contrary on the galactic stage - considered war between spacefaring civilizations to be inconceivable and illogical. After all, their own technological progress had brought post-scarcity to within their reach - what more could they possibly want? Consequently, they rather neglected building up their military forces, leaving themselves vulnerable. However, nothing yet uncovered offers any clues as to who may have wished to destroy what they had built.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3299`
