## federations2.6.desc.fe

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.6.desc.fe&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.Leader.GetName]已经揭示了和乐族文明陨落的真相。他们似乎在[fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesName]帝国崛起之前的几百年里都过着平静的生活，而后者让他们措手不及。这与今天[fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetName]颓废和厌倦的生活大为不同。在那个时代，[fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是一个暴力的、侵略性的、扩张主义的种族。\n\n在他们第一次接触时，和乐族认为[fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是无知和不文明的暴发户，需要指导；[fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural]视整个和乐族的前景为诅咒。他们对这种乌托邦式的和平主义的恐惧是如此之大，以至于他们决定必须把和乐族文明从星系中抹去。由于他们的受害者没有军队，随后的战争既短暂又残酷。当这一事迹完成后，[fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural]离开了，留下了一个自动化的守卫，以确保没有幸存者可以回来并恢复他们如此憎恨的文明。\n\n除了这些记录之外，[Root.Leader.GetName]还发现了一个数据核心，解释了和乐族的环境改造方法。他们在这方面的技术比我们先进得多，所以这方面的知识一定会使我们的帝国受益。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2834`

### English

[Root.Leader.GetName] has uncovered the truth of the Shallarian demise. It seems that they lived in peace for hundreds of years before the rise of the [fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesName] Empire took them by surprise. A far cry from the decadent and weary [fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetName] of today, in that era the [fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were a violently aggressive expansionist race.\n\nUpon their first encounter with each other, the Shallarians considered the [fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to be ignorant and uncivilized upstarts in need of guidance; the [fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural] saw the entire Shallarian outlook as anathema. So great was their horror at this utopian pacifism that they resolved the Shallarians must be wiped from the face of the galaxy. Since their victims had no military, the ensuing war was as short as it was brutal. When the deed was done, the [fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural] left behind an automated guardian to ensure that no survivors could return and thus revive the civilization they so hated.\n\nIn addition to these records, [Root.Leader.GetName] found a data core explaining Shallarian terraforming methods. Their technology in this field is far superior to our own, so this knowledge will surely benefit our empire.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3303`

## federations2.6.desc.afe

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.6.desc.afe&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.Leader.GetName]已经揭示了和乐族文明陨落的真相。他们似乎在几百年里都过着平静的生活，直到[fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的崛起打破了他们的美梦。就像现在一样，[fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是一个暴力的、侵略性的、扩张主义的种族。在他们第一次接触时，和乐族认为[fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是无知和不文明的暴发户，需要指导；[fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural]视整个和乐族的前景为诅咒。他们对这种乌托邦式的和平主义的恐惧是如此之大，以至于他们决定必须把和乐族文明从星系中抹去。由于他们的受害者没有军队，随后的战争既短暂又残酷。当这一行动完成后，[fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural]离开了，留下了一个自动化的守卫，以确保没有幸存者可以回来并恢复他们如此憎恨的文明。\n\n除了这些记录之外，[Root.Leader.GetName]还发现了一个数据核心，解释了和乐族的环境改造方法。他们在这方面的技术比我们先进得多，所以这方面的知识一定会使我们的帝国受益。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2835`

### English

[Root.Leader.GetName] has uncovered the truth of the Shallarian demise. It seems that they lived in peace for hundreds of years, before the rise of the [fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural] took them by surprise. Then, as now, the [fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were a violently aggressive expansionist race. pon their first encounter with each other, the Shallarians considered the [fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to be ignorant and uncivilized upstarts in need of guidance; the [fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural] saw the entire Shallarian outlook as anathema. So great was their horror at the concept this utopian pacifism that they resolved the Shallarians must be wiped from the face of the galaxy. Since their victims had no military, the ensuing war was as short as it was brutal. When the deed was done, the [fanatic_xenophobe_fe.GetSpeciesNamePlural] left behind an automated guardian to ensure that no survivors could return and thus revive the civilization they so hated.\n\nIn addition to these records, [Root.Leader.GetName] found a data core explaining Shallarian terraforming methods. Their technology in this field is far superior to our own, so this knowledge will surely benefit our empire.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3304`

## federations2.7.desc.base

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.7.desc.base&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.Leader.GetName]已经揭示了和乐族文明陨落的真相。似乎在经历了几百年的和平与安宁之后，许多人变得沮丧，因为其他更好战的国家辜负了他们的期望。他们对许多折磨星系的战争大失所望，决定利用他们的先进技术建立一支强大的舰队，以确保和平。\n\n与此同时，在他们的人工智能技术上取得了巨大的进步，完全自主的感性人工智能在他们中间广泛传播。由于对实际参与暴力的想法很反感，他们把维和部队的控制权交给了新人工智能们。然而，很明显，他们的计划并不像他们想的那么可靠：他们的舰队在第一次出海时就把矛头对准了他们。\n\n显然，事实证明，维和部队的强大程度完全符合他们的预期。和乐族科学家只能惊恐地看着他们的文明被一个简单的堆栈溢出错误化为尘土……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2844`

### English

[Root.Leader.GetName] has uncovered the truth of the Shallarian demise. It seems that after several hundred years of peace and tranquility, many Shallarians became frustrated at the failure of other, more warlike nations to live up to their expectations. Disillusioned at the many wars that plagued the galaxy, they elected to use their superior technology to build a powerful fleet capable of enforcing the peace.\n\nAt the same time, the Shallarians had made significant advances in their artificial intelligence technology - so much so that fully sentient autonomous AIs became widespread among them. As the thought of actually engaging in violence was distasteful to them, the Shallarians instead handed over control of the peacekeeping force over to their new AIs. However, evidently their programming was not as infallible as they thought: their fleet turned on them during its very first outing.\n\nEvidently, the peacekeeping force proved every bit as formidable as they had intended it to be. The Shallarian scientists could only look on in horror as their civilization was turned into dust by a simple stack overflow error...

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3313`

## federations2.7.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.7.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$federations2.7.desc.base$\n\n除了这些记录之外，[Root.Leader.GetName]还发现了一个数据核心，解释了和乐族对计算技术的创新。虽然他们的命运可能警告我们要小心，但他们的知识可能对我们有益。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2845`

### English

$federations2.7.desc.base$\n\nIn addition to these records, [Root.Leader.GetName] found a data core explaining the innovations the Shallarians had made to their computing technology. Although their fate may warn us to caution, their knowledge may yet be of benefit to us.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3314`

## federations2.7.desc.synth

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.7.desc.synth&lang=en)

### 中文

$federations2.7.desc.base$\n\n我们只能嘲笑和乐族的愚蠢，并庆祝我们自己的程序相对于他们还是优越的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2846`

### English

$federations2.7.desc.base$\n\nWe can only laugh at the folly of the Shallarians, and celebrate the superiority of our own programming compared to theirs.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3315`

## federations2.7.desc.machine

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.7.desc.machine&lang=en)

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2847`

### English

$federations2.7.desc.base$\n\nAlthough a machine has no emotions: if we did, we would be amused at the folly of the Shallarians, and would celebrate the superiority of our own programming compared to theirs.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3316`

## federations2.701.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.701.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在[From.Planet.GetName]上的考古远征队。由于高水平的放射性物质，我们不得不采取预防辐射中毒的措施。然而，一次在考古学家挖掘的地点的泄露似乎造成了严重的恐慌。[Root.Leader.GetName]和[Root.Leader.GetHerHis]的团队不得不暂停挖掘工作，直到辐射恢复到安全水平。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2853`

### English

The archaeological expedition on [From.Planet.GetName] has been forced to take precautions against radiation poisoning due to the high levels of radioactivity on the ruined planet. However, it seems that a leak has caused a significant scare on the site where the archaeologists were excavating. [Root.Leader.GetName] and [Root.Leader.GetHerHis] team have had to pause excavations until radiation can be restored to safe levels.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3322`

## federations2.702.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.702.name&lang=en)

### 中文

隐蔽的前哨船只被激活

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2854`

### English

Hidden Sentinel Ship Activated

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3323`

## federations2.702.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.702.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的考古学家在[From.System.GetName]星系不经意间引起了隐藏在小行星带的前哨船只的注意。我们不确定为什么它一直保持隐蔽到现在。可能是它的传感器出故障了？我们可以确定的是现在它已经苏醒了，并且它的武器系统正在激活！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2855`

### English

Our archaeologists in the [From.System.GetName] system have inadvertently drawn the attention of a sentinel ship concealed in the asteroid belt. We are not sure why it had remained hidden until now. Perhaps its sensors had malfunctioned? What is certain is that it is awake now, and its weapons systems are activating!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3324`

### English

## federations2.8.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.8.name&lang=en)

### 中文

起舞的原因？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2857`

### English

A Cause to Dance?

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3326`

## federations2.8.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.8.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]上不断地有奇怪的事件被报道。很显然有大量的个人在大街上跳舞，持续数小时甚至是一天到晚。他们拒绝停下来直到生理上的力竭。\n\n至今，这种现象只影响了人口的相对一小部分，我们的当局政府尚未建立应对方案。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2858`

### English

Strange occurrences have been reported among the colonists on [Root.GetName]. Apparently many individuals have taken to dancing on the streets for hours and even days on end, refusing to stop until they are physically restrained.\n\nSo far, it has only affected a relatively small portion of the population, and our authorities have yet to establish a pattern.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3327`

### English

## federations2.9.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.9.name&lang=en)

### 中文

舞蹈瘟疫

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2860`

### English

The Dancing Plague

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3329`

## federations2.9.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.9.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

从自发孤立的现象开始，这种[Root.GetName]上不断延续的舞蹈已经升级到了某种[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]数百人成群结队的舞蹈，现在甚至还强迫性的出现了各式不同的舞姿。令人惊讶的是，许多本来从未对舞蹈有任何兴趣的人突然就有了表演专业动作的能力。尽管许多居民揶揄地将之称为“舞蹈瘟疫”，但这绝不是开玩笑的事——舞蹈者对他们的生理需求不管不顾，冒着生命风险舞蹈直至死亡。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2861`

### English

The isolated incidents of spontaneous, prolonged dancing on [Root.GetName] have escalated somewhat, and groups of hundreds of [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are now compulsively dancing in a variety of different styles. Surprisingly, even those who have never shown much interest in dancing are suddenly able to perform expert moves, and the old among them have rediscovered the vigor of their youth. Although many residents are jokingly referring to it as the 'Dancing Plague', it is no joking matter - the dancers show no concern for their bodily needs, and risk dancing themselves to death.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3330`

## federations2.9.A

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.9.A&lang=en)

这绝不是自然的！我们必须找到是什么在折磨他们。

### English

This is not natural! We must find out what is afflicting them.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3331`

### English

Start the music - it's party time!

## federations2.10.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.10.name&lang=en)

### 中文

舞蹈瘟疫的病原体被发现

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2864`

### English

Dancing Plague Pathogen Isolated

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3333`

## federations2.10.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.10.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的研究员成功发现了[Root.GetName]上发生的舞蹈事件的原因。似乎罪魁祸首是当地植物释放的一种气体。这种气体能诱导产生极度兴奋的感情以及对舞蹈不可抗拒的渴望，同时还能抑制疲劳。这看上去是相当良性的，但是殖民者的自我保护本能正阻止他们字面意义上的舞蹈至死。不仅如此，我们的科学家还开发了一种合成气体——一旦被释放入空气——会中和这种“舞蹈气体”的效果。\n\n当地的企业家建议我们可以保留该殖民地的独特特性，允许气体在某些区域有限制地释放，为老老少少提供安全的空间以体验“[Root.GetName]的永恒派对”。还有人指出这种气体还包含了特定有价值的特性，如果我们能够在其被释放入空气之前从植物中提取，那么就能够利用它。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2865`

### English

Our researchers have succeeded in isolating the cause of the dancing incidents on [Root.GetName]. It appears the culprit is a gas released by the local vegetation. This gas induces feelings of exhilaration and an irresistible urge to dance, while suppressing fatigue. It seems to be fairly benign, however, as the colonists' self-preservation instincts prevent them from literally dancing themselves to death. Furthermore, our scientists have developed a synthetic gas that - once released into the air - will neutralize the effects of the 'dancing gas'.\n\nLocal entrepreneurs suggest that we preserve the unique character of the colony by allowing the gas free rein in certain areas, providing a safe space for young and old alike to experience the 'Eternal Party of [Root.GetName]'. Others point out that the gas has certain valuable properties we can make use of, if we can extract it from the plants before it is released into the air.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3334`

## federations2.10.A

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.10.A&lang=en)

### 中文

表演必须继续！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2866`

### English

The show must go on!

## federations2.11.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.11.name&lang=en)

### 中文

舞蹈瘟疫已治愈

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2868`

### English

Dancing Plague Neutralized

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3337`

## federations2.11.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.11.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的研究员成功发现了[Root.GetName]上发生的舞蹈事件的原因——可花了好一会功夫！星球上的情况已经是燎原之火，医护人员们不得已不断地对舞蹈者使用高剂量镇定剂以迫使他们从舞蹈至死的过程中停下来。\n\n似乎罪魁祸首是当地植物释放的一种气体。这种气体能诱导产生极度兴奋的感情以及对舞蹈不可抗拒的渴望，同时还能抑制精疲力尽的感觉，压倒了[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]自我保护的本能。\n\n幸运的是，我们的科学家已经开发出了一种合成气体——一旦被释放入空气——会中和这种“舞蹈气体”的效果。不仅如此，如果我能够在其被释放入空气之前从植物中提取这种气体，似乎这种“舞蹈气体”具有某些我们能够利用的有价值的特性。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2869`

### English

Our researchers have succeeded in isolating the cause of the dancing incidents on [Root.GetName] - and not a moment too soon! The situation on the planet has grown dire, as medics have increasingly been forced to use heavy sedatives on the dancers to stop them from dancing themselves to death.\n\nIt appears that the culprit is a gas released by the local vegetation, which induces feelings of exhilaration and an irresistible urge to dance, while suppressing feelings of exhaustion, overriding [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] self-preservation instincts.\n\nFortunately, our scientists have developed a synthetic gas that - once released into the air - will neutralize the effects of the 'dancing gas'. Furthermore, it seems that the 'dancing gas' has certain valuable properties we can make use of, if we can extract it from the plants before it is released into the air.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3338`

## federations2.12.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.12.name&lang=en)

### 中文

舞蹈瘟疫的肆虐

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2871`

### English

The Ravages of the Dancing Plague

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3340`

## federations2.12.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.12.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

“舞蹈瘟疫”进入到了更糟糕的阶段，起初，我们的医护人员采用高剂量的镇定剂来阻止这些舞蹈者舞蹈至死。然而，随着他们不断地受到日益增强的综合征的影响，剩余的医护人员已经无法应对这样的情况，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的居民正因精疲力竭不断倒下。\n\n随着越来越多的殖民者受到影响，我们再也不能如同过去那样，认为这是一个无伤大雅的玩笑。我们必须立即采取行动以摆脱这种瘟疫，一劳永逸根除后患！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2872`

### English

The 'Dancing Plague' has taken a turn for the worse. At first, our medics took to using heavy sedatives to stop the dancers from dancing themselves to death. However, as they themselves were increasingly affected by the symptoms, the remaining medics were unable to cope, and scores of [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have collapsed from exhaustion.\n\nWith more of the colonists affected by the day, this has gone far beyond the harmless joke we had thought it to be. We must take immediate action to rid ourselves of this plague, once and for all!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3341`

## federations2.13.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.13.name&lang=en)

### 中文

舞蹈瘟疫消退

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2874`

### English

The Dancing Plague Wears Off

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3343`

## federations2.13.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.13.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管我们的科学家还对造成所谓的“舞蹈瘟疫”的原因感到困惑，但是它的影响似乎在其对我们殖民者造成危险之前就消退了。或许是殖民者对这种病原体随着时间产生了免疫力，又或者是这只是为了引起[Root.GetName]注意的一种恶作剧？无论是什么情况，殖民者不再跳舞了！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2875`

### English

Although our scientists are still baffled by the cause of the so-called 'Dancing Plague', its effects seem to have worn off before it could pose a danger to our colonists. Perhaps it was a pathogen that the settlers have grown immune to over time, or else an elaborate hoax to attract attention to [Root.GetName]? Whatever the case, the settlers are no longer dancing!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3344`

## federations2.14.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.14.name&lang=en)

### 中文

永恒派对

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2876`

### English

The Eternal Party

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3345`

## federations2.14.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations2.14.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管我们的科学家还对造成所谓的“舞蹈瘟疫”的原因感到困惑，这似乎对我们的殖民者不构成危险。尽管这种瘟疫能影响人们感受到极度兴奋的感觉以及对舞蹈不可抑制的渴望，他们的生存本能还是能通过力竭的感受让他们时不时地休息一会儿。\n\n当地的企业家已经开始规划这些区域为派对区域，并对[Root.GetName]打广告说这是“星球的永恒节日”，在这里老老少少能够放下种种限制来享受身心。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2877`

### English

Although our scientists are still baffled by the cause of the so-called Dancing Plague, it does not seem to pose a danger to our colonists. While those affected by it experience a feeling of exhilaration and an irresistible urge to dance, their survival instinct means that exhaustion forces them to rest sooner or later. Furthermore, it seems that only some areas are significantly affected by this phenomenon.\n\nLocal entrepreneurs have already begun designating these areas as party zones, advertising [Root.GetName] as the 'Planet of Eternal Festivity', where young and old alike may come to release their shackles and enjoy themselves.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3346`

## d_disco_planet_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Ad_disco_planet_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个星球大气层所包含的一种气体能诱导极度兴奋的感觉和对舞蹈不可抑制的渴望，以及某种性冲动。这使得这个世界成为了那些派对爱好者的绝佳去处。老老少少为了寻求剥除束缚体验快乐的颤栗荒废无度地在此星球上进行永不停歇的舞蹈盛宴。同时，我们还能够利用这些气体以满足一些我们自己的目的……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2891`

### English

A gas in this planet's atmosphere induces feelings of exhilaration and the irresistible urge to dance, as well as certain aphrodisiac urges. This has made the world a prime destination for party-goers young and old who seek to shed their inhibitions and experience the thrill of the planet's perpetual dancing festivals with abandon. Meanwhile, we are also able to utilize this gas for our own purposes...

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3360`

## 01_ASK_TO_LEAVE_REFUSE

### 中文

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2938`

## HM_ASK_TO_LEAVE_REFUSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHM_ASK_TO_LEAVE_REFUSE&lang=en)

### 中文

你不能偏离神之意志。它的计划实行取决于你能继续留在[Root.GetAllianceName]之中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2939`

### English

You must not stray from the will of the Mind. Its plans depend on your continued membership in the [Root.GetAllianceName].

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3413`

## E_ASK_TO_LEAVE_REFUSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AE_ASK_TO_LEAVE_REFUSE&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的任务是如此神圣，我们不会允许你退出[Root.GetAllianceName]。也许有一天我们终将把所有的有机生物的痕迹从星海中抹去。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2940`

### English

Our mission is too great - we cannot allow your withdrawal from the [Root.GetAllianceName]. Perhaps when we have erased every last trace of organic life from the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3414`

## S_ASK_TO_LEAVE_REFUSE

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:2941`

## A_ASK_TO_LEAVE_REFUSE

## action.1.desc_89

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_89&lang=en)

### 中文

你…你是[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？这真是不可思议…你一定是尤利西斯计划的幸存者。地球上的每个人都认为方舟上的船只都失踪了，但显然至少有一艘成功了！你是说你的祖先在“菊”号上吗?\n\n这肯定很不容易，但你们似乎确实干得不错。我谨代表地球人民和联合国大会的成员，向我们在[Root.GetName]的兄弟姐妹伸出友谊之手。\n\n让我们共同努力，为全人类建设更美好的未来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3003`

### English

You... You're [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? This is incredible... You must be survivors from the Ulysses Initiative! Everyone back on Earth assumed the arkships had all been lost, but clearly at least one made it! Did you say your ancestors were on the 'Chrysanthemum'?\n\nIt can't have been easy, but you certainly seem to have done well for yourselves. On behalf of the people of Earth and the constituents of the United Nations General Assembly, I would like to extend a hand in friendship to our brothers and sisters in the [Root.GetName].\n\nLet us strive together to build a better future for all of humanity.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3485`

## action.1.desc_90

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_90&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]……这么多年过去了，联合国居然设法保持了对权力的控制？你必须原谅我们——当我们的祖先乘坐尤利西斯方舟离开地球时，地球上有些混乱。许多人认为你们在另一次世界大战中毁灭了自己，或者可能成为外星人入侵的受害者。\n\n当然，你看起来比我们当时的腐败的地球当局更强大、更有能力。我们的祖先从无到有地建立了[contact_empire.GetName]。我们将保卫它到最后。我们将看看你是否值得我们尊敬。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3004`

### English

The [From.GetName]... So the UN has managed to somehow maintain its grasp on power then, even after all these years? You'll have to forgive us - things were somewhat chaotic on Earth when our ancestors departed on the Ulysses arkships. Many assumed you had destroyed yourselves in another world war, or perhaps fallen victim to an alien invasion.\n\nStill, you certainly appear stronger and more capable than the corrupt Earth authorities we left behind. Our ancestors built the [contact_empire.GetName] out of nothing, and we will defend it to the last. We shall see if you are worthy of our respect.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3486`

## action.1.desc_91

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_91&lang=en)

### 中文

啊，宇宙的造化是多么神奇……在发生了这么多事之后，我们又相遇了。但请不要担心，$NAME_MSI_country$会代表董事会，随时准备再次协助你。\n\n当然，我们不能就此忽视公司财产遭受的损失。我们的收款代理人如果还没有与你们联系，想必很快就会了。希望我们能够达成一个友好的解决方案。\n\n我们生活在一个十分有趣的时代，不是吗？请允许我率先祝贺你们的人民取得了令人难以置信的进展。我们很期待检验你们的成长。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3005`

### English

Ah, how strange are the workings of the universe... That we should come into contact with one another again, after all that has transpired. But never fear: on behalf of the Board, $NAME_MSI_country$ stands ready to assist you again.\n\nOf course, we can not simply overlook the damages incurred to company property. Our collection agents will no doubt be in contact with you soon, if they haven't done so already. We hope we will be able to reach an amicable settlement.\n\nWe live in such interesting times, don't you think? Allow me to be the first to congratulate you on the incredible progress your people have made. We look forward to testing how much you've grown.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3487`

## action.1.desc_92

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_92&lang=en)

### 中文

啊，我们昔日的资产……再见到你们简直太高兴了。请允许我代表$NAME_MSI_country$的董事会，率先祝贺你们和……人民所取得的进步。出身如此卑微却能取得这样的成就，实属不易。\n\n如果你们有需要，请不要犹豫，尽管联系我们。我们不记仇。毕竟，欠发达社会不能真正为自己的行为负责。在这方面，你们就如孩童一般。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3006`

### English

Ah, our erstwhile assets... You have no idea how good it is to see you again. On behalf of the Board at $NAME_MSI_country$, allow me to be the first to congratulate you on the progress you and your... people have made. It is no small thing to have come so far from such humble beginnings.\n\nShould you need anything, don't hesitate to contact us. We hold no grudges. After all, less developed societies cannot truly be held accountable for their actions. In that regard, you are very much like children.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3488`

## action.1.desc_93

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_93&lang=en)

### 中文

谨代表$NAME_MSI_country$的董事会，请接受我们衷心的问候。在$NAME_MSI_country_initials$，我们相信通过技术和贸易能够增强其他文明的能力。毕竟，每个有情感的生命体都有权实现自己的梦想。\n\n迄今为止，我们已经为几十个前超光速星球提供了知识，并计划在未来十年内将这个数字增加 40%。我们还提供财政援助和专业的契约劳动服务，来支持泛星系的众多航天帝国。\n\n如果你们有需要，请不要犹豫，尽管联系我们。我们很期待与你们做生意！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3007`

### English

On behalf of the Board at $NAME_MSI_country$, please accept our heartfelt greetings. At $NAME_MSI_country_initials$, we believe in empowering other civilizations through technology and trade. After all, every sentient lifeform has the right to live their dreams.\n\nTo date, we have granted insights to dozens of pre-FTL worlds, and aim to increase that number by 40% within the next decade. We also support the galaxy's space-faring empires by providing financial assistance and the services of our specialized indentured workforce.\n\nShould you need anything, don't hesitate to contact us. We look forward to doing business with you!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3489`

## action.1.desc_99

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_99&lang=en)

### 中文

啊，你好——\n\n我的老天岩！你们是从太阳系来的！我们很早就推测过你们物种的存在。原谅我有点失态——我在此仅代表[contact_empire.GetName]；依据留存在我们体内的DNA标记判断，我们就是失散亿年的表亲。我们彼此的祖先曾经沐浴在同一个阳光下，但一场远古的灾难把我们猛地投向了星际空间。既然我们现在重逢了，是时候叙叙这数亿年的旧了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3008`

### English

Ah gree-\n\nFractures and fragments! You are from Sol! We have long theorized about the existence of your kind. But I am getting ahead of myself - I am here to represent the [contact_empire.GetName]; judging by DNA markers left in our species, we are your long-lost cousins. Our ancestors shared the same star, but an ancient cataclysm sent us hurtling through space. Now that we are reunited, we can make up for lost time.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3490`

## action.1.desc_100

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Aaction.1.desc_100&lang=en)

### 中文

与你们的相遇就像凝视着一面陌生的镜子……你是说，远在地球和月球形成之前我们曾有过共同的祖先？确实有许多科学家已经建立过忒伊亚存在的理论，但无论如何，我们很高兴认识你。作为表兄弟，我们期待能建立繁荣的伙伴关系。与此同时，请接受这份月球岩石的礼物：也许其中隐藏着你们祖先的痕迹。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3009`

### English

Meeting you is like peering into some strange mirror... You say we share a common ancestry, long before the formation of Earth and Luna? Many scientists have theorized about the existence of Theia, and in any case we are happy to make your acquaintance. As something like cousins, we look forward to a prosperous partnership. In the meantime, please accept this gift of lunar rocks: perhaps traces of your ancestry are hidden there.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3491`

### 中文

£trigger_no£ 当我们拥有他们所有定居星系的宣称时，由于战争胜利会导致对他们的彻底吞并，我们无法使用这个战争目标。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3023`

### English

£trigger_no£  We cannot use this War Goal when we have claims on all of their inhabited systems, as victory would result in their annexation.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3505`

## fedev.500.intro

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.500.intro&lang=en)

### 中文

让历史铭记这一天，§H[fed_founder_1.GetName]§!与§H[fed_founder_2.GetName]§!政府签署了一个联邦条约，作为§H[Root.GetAllianceName]§!的共同缔造者，他们将携手并肩面对未来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3025`

### English

Let history record that on this day, the governments of the §H[fed_founder_1.GetName]§! and the §H[fed_founder_2.GetName]§! signed a treaty of federation. As founding members of the §H[Root.GetAllianceName]§!, they will now face the future as firm allies.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3507`

## fedev.500.a.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.500.a.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$fedev.500.intro$\n\n这个新的星系联合将作为一个光辉的榜样，告诉星系里的其他人，所有的一切都可以通过共同努力来实现。\n\n星际外交的新时代已经开始了!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3026`

### English

$fedev.500.intro$\n\nThis new Galactic Union will serve as an shining example to the rest of the galaxy of all that can be accomplished by working together.\n\nA new era of interstellar diplomacy has begun!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3508`

## fedev.500.b.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.500.b.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$fedev.500.intro$\n\n新的贸易联盟将会毫无疑问的给我们所有的成员带来经济繁荣。\n\n新的星际商业时代来临了！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3027`

### English

$fedev.500.intro$\n\nThis new Trade League will no doubt bring about economic prosperity for all of its members.\n\nA new era of interstellar commerce has begun!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3509`

## fedev.500.c.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.500.c.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$fedev.500.intro$\n\n这个研究联合组织将给我们所有成员的科学家以新机会来联合我们的知识。\n\n科学进步的好时代来临了！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3028`

### English

$fedev.500.intro$\n\nThis Research Cooperative will provide the scientists of all its member states with new opportunities to pool their knowledge.\n\nA new era of technological advancement has begun!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3510`

## fedev.500.d.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.500.d.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$fedev.500.intro$\n\n这一军事同盟的联合力量肯定会使那些企图在其成员国领土上搞阴谋的人踌躇不前。\n\n一个军事霸权的新时代已经开始了!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3029`

### English

$fedev.500.intro$\n\nThe combined might of this Martial Alliance is sure to give pause to those with designs on the territory of its member states.\n\nA new era of military supremacy has begun!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3511`

## fedev.500.e.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedev.500.e.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

$fedev.500.intro$\n\n这种霸权主义将通过其统治霸权的开明领导确保其下级成员的安全。\n\n一个[fed_founder_1.GetSpeciesName]霸权的新时代来临了！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3030`

### English

$fedev.500.intro$\n\nThis grand Hegemony will ensure the safety of its junior members through the enlightened leadership of its ruling Hegemon.\n\nA new era of [fed_founder_1.GetSpeciesName] dominance has begun!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3512`

### English

## fedel.1501.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.1501.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一个公正的，由科学家和思想家组成的委员会正聚集在我们的联邦内庭。他们想要在我们即将开始的领导力测验中为[root.GetAllianceName]提供学术仲裁。\n\n每个帝国现在可以聚集一支团队来研究这一问题，这一研究的结果将会对我们的联邦产生积极影响。这只团队将会发表他们的结果在公开的讨论区。无论哪篇论文在创新、科学严谨性和连贯性方面得分最高，它的作者帝国都将在下一期获得领导地位。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3103`

### English

An impartial committee of scientists and thinkers is gathering within our federation chambers. Its purpose: to serve the [root.GetAllianceName] as academic arbiters during our upcoming leadership contest.\n\nEach empire will now assemble a team of researchers to investigate an issue, the findings of which should somehow benefit the future of our federation. The teams will present their findings to an open forum. Whichever thesis study rates highest in innovation, scientific rigor and coherence will earn its authors' empire the right of leadership for the next term.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3591`

## fedel.1501.desc.subject

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.1501.desc.subject&lang=en)

$fedel.1501.desc$\n\n不幸的是，由于我们不是一个独立的国家，我们被禁止参加，因为我们没有资格领导联邦。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3104`

### English

$fedel.1501.desc$\n\nUnfortunately, as we are not an independent state, we are barred from participation as we are not eligible to lead the federation.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3592`

## fedel.1506.win.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.1506.win.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

联邦委员会已经认可了我们对于§H[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]§!研究的内在价值，授予§Y[ruler.GetTitle][ruler.GetRegnalName]§!在下一届的领导权。人们向[ruler.GetTitle]和[ruler.GetHerHis]的研究团队致以贺词。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3108`

### English

The Federation Committee has recognized the inherent value of our study into §H[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]§!, granting §Y[ruler.GetTitle] [ruler.GetRegnalName]§! leadership for the next term. Congratulatory sentiments have been offered to our [ruler.GetTitle] and [ruler.GetHerHis] team of researchers.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3596`

## fedel.1506.win.autocracy.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.1506.win.autocracy.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

联邦委员会已经认可了由我们§Y[ruler.GetTitle][ruler.GetRegnalName]§!领导的研究及其对于§H[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]§!的可靠论证。[ruler.GetSheHeCap]在下一任中的领导应该会相当成功。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3109`

### English

The Federation Committee has recognized our infallible reasoning in a study conducted by §Y[ruler.GetTitle] [ruler.GetRegnalName]§! on §H[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]§!. [ruler.GetSheHeCap] shall assume a most prosperous leadership for the next term.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3597`

## fedel.1506.win.gestalt.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.1506.win.gestalt.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

联邦委员会已经认可了我们对§H[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]§!整合研究的价值。他们已经授予了我们在[root.GetAllianceName]的下一届领导权。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3110`

### English

The Federation Committee has recognized the worthiness of our amalgamated study into §H[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]§!. They have granted leadership of the [root.GetAllianceName] to us for the next term.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3598`

## fedel.1506.fail.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.1506.fail.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

联邦委员会略过了我们提交的论文，对来自[winning_thesis.GetName]的关于§H[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]§!的空洞研究加以青睐。科学本身应该为这种理性的丧失哀悼。同时，§Y[winning_thesis.GetName]§!确保了在[root.GetAllianceName]的领导权。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3111`

### English

The Federation Committee has passed over our proposal, favoring a vacuous study from the [winning_thesis.GetName] on §H[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]§!. Science itself shall mourn this loss of reason. In the meantime, the §Y[winning_thesis.GetName]§! assumes leadership of the [root.GetAllianceName].

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3599`

## fedel.1506.fail.gestalt.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.1506.fail.gestalt.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

联邦委员会犯下种种错误，轻率地选择了§Y[winning_thesis.GetName]§!的论文而不是我们的。§H[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]§!的研究莫名其妙地赢得了[winning_thesis.ruler.GetTitle][winning_thesis.ruler.GetRegnalName]在下一届的领导权。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3112`

### English

In a wanton act of motley failure, the Federation Committee has selected a thesis by the §Y[winning_thesis.GetName]§! rather than our own. Their study of §H[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]§! has inexplicably granted [winning_thesis.ruler.GetTitle] [winning_thesis.ruler.GetRegnalName] leadership for the next term.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3600`

## fedel.1506.insufficient.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.1506.insufficient.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在我们缺席该项竞赛的同时，联邦委员会选择了获胜的议题。§Y[winning_thesis.GetName]§!由于它们关于§H[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]§!的研究被授予了在下一届的领导权。这次竞赛水平低下，要是我们研究团队参赛的话很可能能走上领奖台。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3113`

### English

The Federation Committee chose its winning argument whilst we remained absent from the contest. The §Y[winning_thesis.GetName]§! has been granted leadership following their study of §H[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]§!. A low bar has been set for the time when a research team of our own might take to the podium.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3601`

## fedel.1805.desc.base

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.1805.desc.base&lang=en)

### 中文

是时候选举出一位[Root.GetAllianceName]的新领袖了。联邦内最神圣的个体们组成的教团齐聚在一起来决定哪个帝国将作为他们的代表和领袖。他们将会集中在一个秘密房间中，里面包含了所有做出决定所需要的信息。\n\n尽管在教团中展开的讨论是高度机密的，但据了解，他们主要评估每个成员为保护和提升灵性以及传统价值观所提供的服务、还有在飞升和超凡入圣方面是否取得特定进展。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3119`

### English

The time has come for a new leader of the [Root.GetAllianceName] to be chosen. A Conclave of the holiest individuals within the alliance have gathered together to decide which empire shall act as their representative and leader. They will meet in a sealed chamber, wherein all the information required to make their decision is contained.\n\nWhile the discussions that take place within the Conclave are highly confidential, it is understood that they primarily assess the services rendered by each member towards the preservation and advancement of spirituality and traditional values, as well as any particular advances towards ascension and transcendence.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3608`

## fedel.1825.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.1825.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在一阵密集的鼓点之后，一阵薄雾从慢慢打开的教团密室中徐徐飘出。一位代表登上前台。现场鸦雀无声，安静到全[Root.GetAllianceName]都能听见一根针掉到地上的声音。\n\n他们宣布，§Y[conclave_winner.GetName]§!被选为下一任主席！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3135`

### English

After a burst of drumroll, an ethereal mist starts seeping from the now-opened Conclave Chambers. A delegation emerges. There is a dramatic pause, and a silence so profound a pin drop would appear loud falls across the [Root.GetAllianceName].\n\nThey declare the §Y[conclave_winner.GetName]§! to be their choice for the presidency!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3624`

## federations3.121.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.121.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

访问者：§Y欢迎来到$NAME_Wenkwort$§!。无论您是慕名已久还是故地重游，我们都非常乐意为您的花园之旅提供帮助。\n\n谨代表$NAME_Gardeners$并根据WAPP-715号命令，请不要擅自闯入指定的$NAME_wenkwort_prime$生物区。不遵守我们的指引将会降低所有相关人员的生存机会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3144`

### English

Visiting entity: §Ywelcome to $NAME_Wenkwort$§!. Whether this visit is your first or your hundredth, we are glad to facilitate your appreciation of the gardens.\n\nOn behalf of the $NAME_Gardeners$ and in accordance with directive WAPP-715, I ask that you refrain from harsh intrusion upon the biota of planetary designate $NAME_wenkwort_prime$. Failure to comply with our guidelines will diminish the survival odds of all concerned.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3636`

## federations3.121.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.121.a&lang=en)

### 中文

命令……啥？你是谁？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3145`

### English

Directive... What? Who are you?

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3637`

## federations3.121.a.response

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.121.a.response&lang=en)

### 中文

我是这个称为[root.System.GetName]星系的自动监护机器。我代表此恒星系和其他所有奥隆帝国中$NAME_Gardeners$的利益。我的任务大致是保护及引导你周围的一切事物。\n\n§YWAPP-715命令§!限制诸如[root.Planet.GetName]等阿卡摩尔级星球的工业化。只有你可以阻止大规模生物灭绝！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3146`

### English

I am the automated custodian of the system designated [root.System.GetName]. I represent the interests of the $NAME_Gardeners$, here and in other systems of the Auron Empire. My role is defined broadly as protector of - and guide to - all you see around you.\n\n§YDirective WAPP-715§! curtails the industrialization of Ackamore-class worlds such as designate [root.Planet.GetName]. Only you can prevent mass biome extinction!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3638`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.121.b&lang=en)

### English

Nonsense. We'll develop our colony as we see fit.

## federations3.125.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.125.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

妙啊！指导方针将会立刻发送给你。\n\n总之：WAPP-715命令允许对$NAME_Wenkwort$花园进行负责任的、非破坏性的使用。我们非常重视保护这些世界现有的特性，但是我们不希望扼杀在<错误：帝国信标超出范围>内部的发展。\n\n<请求紧急监控部门派遣人员到坐标19c14a05……失败。重试……失败。重试…>

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3149`

### English

Splendid! Guidelines will be delivered to you imminently.\n\nIn summary: Directive WAPP-715 allows for responsible, non-destructive use of the $NAME_Wenkwort$ gardens. Great importance is attached to preserving these worlds' existing character, however we do not wish to stifle development within-<ERROR: imperial beacon out of range>.\n\n<Requesting urgent Monitor Division dispatch to co-ordinates 19c14a05... Failed. Retrying... Failed. Retrying...>

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3641`

## federations3.130.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.130.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

真令人失望。就这样吧。\n\n<请求执法部门派遣人员到坐标—\n<错误：无法找到帝国信标。还原至备份导航系统……成功。>\n<执法部门已在途；预计在2个大周期后抵达。礼节协议暂停。>

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3150`

### English

How disappointing. So be it.\n\n<Requesting Enforcer Division dispatch to co-ordinates-\n<ERROR: imperial beacon could not be found. Reverting to backup navigation systems... Success.>\n<Enforcer Division en route; estimated arrival 2 grand cycles. Courtesy protocols disengaged.>

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3642`

## federations3.115.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.115.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

绝大多数[From.GetName]地表的景观确乎是运用了某种形式的美学设计。我们的科学家猜想即使是星球其余的“处女地”也不过是为了满足一个更广阔的园艺目标而被刻意雕琢成那样的。\n\n在我们进一步的调查过程中，我们碰巧发现了一座信标，这是这整颗星球上唯一一个科技存在的例证。启动这座信标时，它上传了一份包含[From.GetName]上所有动植物品种的目录，以及一个指向邻近的[event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]的参考指针。但仍没有任何用来找到这颗行星的设计者的线索。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3163`

### English

Some form of aesthetic design has been employed over most of the surface landscape on [From.GetName]. Our scientists suspect that even the remaining, 'untouched' areas are merely crafted wilderness - there to serve a wider horticultural goal.\n\nTowards the conclusion of our research, we stumbled across a beacon - the sole example of technology on this world. When activated, it uploaded a catalog of every plant and animal species found on [From.GetName], as well as a reference pointer to nearby [event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]. No clue was left with which to identify the planet's designers.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3658`

## federations3.100.name

## federations3.100.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.100.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

初看，[From.GetName]上的一切都似乎平淡无奇。只有当[Root.GetName]上的一位科学家在一次偶然的观测中发现地表之下有一块巨大棱镜在反射星光。扫描仪很快对物体进行了辨识，它的宽度几乎相当于一座中等大小的岛屿。\n\n探针遥测表明，构成该棱镜的化学物质具有非常高的价值；其物理结构可能在我们星系内也是独一无二的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3168`

### English

At first glance, everything about [From.GetName] seemed routine and normal. Only during a chance alignment did a scientist aboard the [Root.GetName] notice starlight reflecting off a vast lens near the surface below. Scanners were quickly trained upon the crystalline object, whose breadth is that of a moderately-sized island.\n\nProbe telemetry suggests the chemical make-up of this lens is highly valuable; its physical structure may also be unique within our galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3664`

## federations3.100.a

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.100.a&lang=en)

### English

## colony_fed.100.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony_fed.100.name&lang=en)

### 中文

不可能的凹地

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3174`

### English

Impossible Corrie

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3671`

## colony_fed.100.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony_fed.100.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

一处[Root.GetName]上的地理学异常现象引起了我们的注意。一个采矿设施周围突然出现了碗状的凹地，随后我们对此展开了调查。这个凹地的特征几乎从未在冰川区以外的地方发现过，但奇怪的是：当暴露在某些电磁波段时，这个“圆凹地”的侧壁会产生共振，并且会产生花瓣状的可见光散射。调查正在进行。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3175`

### English

A geological anomaly has come to our attention on [Root.GetName]. We began surveying after a bowl-shaped depression suddenly appeared alongside a mining facility there. Features like this are almost never found outside of a glacial region, but stranger still: the walls of this 'cirque' scatter visible light in a flower-petal pattern, and have been found to resonate when exposed to certain electro-magnetic bands. Investigations are ongoing.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3672`

## colony_fed.105.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony_fed.105.name&lang=en)

### 中文

蓝荷计划

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3176`

### English

Project Blue Lotus

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3674`

## colony_fed.105.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony_fed.105.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的科学家报告称，这些在[Root.GetName]新发现的蓝色晶状物质对延迟擦除光子能量响应剧烈。这些矿物将光子的波长过滤，并反射了一道可以将普通的硅化物转化为新型超导合金的光束——尽管只有在日光下才能进行。\n\n由于该过程涉及到在一个狭小空间内反射高能辐射，若干科学家已经提出异议。而另一群热血沸腾的研究者则提出了相反的意见，他们强调这种现象可以彻底变革我们精练贵金属的方式。但无论如何：进一步开发这项科技都需要巨大的投入。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3177`

### English

Our scientists report that the newly-uncovered, crystalline blue deposits on [Root.GetName] respond dramatically to delayed-erasure photon energy. The minerals filter its wavelengths and reflect a beam which is capable of transforming ordinary silicates into a new, super-conductive alloy - though only ever during daylight.\n\nGiven that this process essentially involves bouncing high levels of radiation around an enclosed space, some scientists have already come out in protest. A different group of excited researchers offers a counter-argument, stressing that this phenomenon could revolutionize the way we refine precious metals. Either way: developing this technique further will be costly.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3675`

## colony_fed.105.gestalt.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony_fed.105.gestalt.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

在[Root.GetName]的盆地中发现了一台运行着独立程序的离群的无人机。受到改进我们矿物冶炼方式的初始指令驱动，它找到了一种将硅化物转化为新种类合金的方法。\n\n这一过程似乎涉及将高能束从特征墙中的矿物质反射回来。该无人机孜孜不觉的工作似乎导致了这一区域被填满了高能辐射。因此该无人机被捕获，而究竟是重新整合进系统还是将其个体摧毁从而获取相关知识有待决定。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3178`

### English

A rogue drone has been found running its own project within the cirque on [Root.GetName]. Driven by its initial directive - to refine our methods of mineral extraction - it has since stumbled onto a means of transforming everyday silicates into a new type of alloy.\n\nThe process seems to involve bouncing high-energy beams off mineral deposits in the feature's wall. The drone's eagerness in its task has caused it to flood the area with excessive levels of radiation. It has therefore been isolated pending either re-integration, or destruction of its individuality and acquired knowledge.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3676`

## colony_fed.106.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony_fed.106.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]上呈现出令人遗憾的场景，一群过于痴狂的科学家在计划的最后关头横加干涉。由于被自己的研究所迷醉，他们以“为了新科学”的名义试图夺取嬗变实验的控制权。引发的斗殴导致了设备的损坏，继而造成了无法控制的连锁反应。\n\n最后在盆地中残存下来的是一个近乎晶洞的结构：岩质的外壳中包覆着由原来构成仪器设备和反对者们的物质转变而成的晶体。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3184`

### English

Regrettable scenes on [Root.GetName], as a group of obsessive scientists sought to intervene in the project's closure. Dazzled by their own research, they attempted to wrest control of the transmutation experiments 'for the benefit of new science.' The resulting scuffle caused equipment to be damaged, and a runaway cascade took hold.\n\nWhat remains of the cirque is something akin to a geode: a rocky shell around what used to be the equipment and protestors, now re-rendered in crystalline form.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3683`

## colony_fed.107.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony_fed.107.name&lang=en)

### 中文

离经叛道的炼金术士

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3185`

### English

Breakaway Alchemist

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3685`

## colony_fed.107.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony_fed.107.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

那个迷途的无人机和它的发现被彻底地抹除了。现在其意外的实验成果也仅是一片混乱，少量有用的物质被收集了起来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3186`

### English

The wayward drone and its findings have been successfully purged. The results of its fluke experiments now litter the landscape; a small amount of useful material has been reclaimed.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3686`

## colony_fed.110.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony_fed.110.name&lang=en)

### 中文

炼金术运转中

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3187`

### English

Alchemy in Motion

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3688`

## colony_fed.110.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony_fed.110.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]上的实验室得出了可靠的结果。虽然目前这一过程只能将少量的岩石转化成合金，但研究者对更大规模的操作抱有高度的信心。他们请求获得更多的资源。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3188`

### English

The laboratory on [From.GetName] is yielding verifiable results. Although their process can still only transmute small amounts of rock into alloys, researchers have high hopes for a larger-scale operation. They have requested access to further resources.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3689`

## colony_fed.110.gestalt.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony_fed.110.gestalt.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]上凶险的实验得出了结果。虽然这一过程目前仍只能将少量物质转化为这种新金属，但该实验非常可靠。可能需要委以更多专项研究工作。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3189`

### English

The rogue experiments on [Root.GetName] are yielding results. Although the process can still only transmute small amounts of matter into this new metal, the experiment is now verifiable. This could warrant more dedicated research efforts.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3690`

## colony_fed.111.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony_fed.111.name&lang=en)

### 中文

蓝荷崩溃

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3190`

### English

Lotus Collapse

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3692`

## colony_fed.111.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony_fed.111.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]上的嬗变实验失败了，然而这一失败也避免了未来更大灾难的发生。当这种新型的设备刚一上线时，在设定的容忍限度内其表现良好。然而当对其发出关闭指令时，该过程会突然加速并达到故障保护极限。随后设施的外壳发生了转化，周围的物质全部变为了一种相同的超导合金。\n\n该过程发生的地面爆炸夺去了许多生命，并且摧毁了周围的区域。从中我们只能获取一层有用物质，和一个无法解明的事故教训。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3191`

### English

The transmutation experiments at [From.GetName] have failed - though their failure may actually have prevented future catastrophe. When new, more refined equipment was first brought online, it ran well within design tolerances. However, when shut-down instructions were issued, the process accelerated beyond the reach of its failsafes. Conversion took hold in the facility's housing, transmuting it and its surroundings into the same, super-conductive alloy.\n\nThe resulting ground explosion has taken a number of lives along with significant chunks of the surrounding landscape. We're left with little other than a seam of good material, and a cautionary tale in metaphysics.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3693`

## colony_fed.115.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony_fed.115.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们下一阶段的实验性生产设施上线了。以“蓝荷”命名的晶体嬗变设施现在正在夜以继日将前所未有规模的基础材料转化为有用的合金。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3194`

### English

The next phase of our experimental production facility has come online. The Blue Lotus crystalline transmutation facility is now busy converting unprecedented amounts of base material into useful alloys.

蓝荷自噬

### English

Lotus Eats Itself

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3701`

## colony_fed.120.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Acolony_fed.120.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]上的实验性设施发生了灾难性的失败。操作员说，我们可能永远也无法查明到底是什么导致了安全壳的失效，结果是整个设施、包括建筑物和周围的一大片区域都被失控的嬗变反应转变成了同一种超导合金。于此可以发掘出大量的有用材料。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3198`

### English

A catastrophic failure has occurred at the experimental facility on [Root.GetName]. Operatives say we may never know what specifically caused the failure in containment, but the result was runaway transmutation of the equipment, its housing, and a vast chunk of the surrounding landscape - all into the same, superconductive alloy. A rich seam of this material is all that remains.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3702`

It's thought that the unique, reflective properties of this geographical phenomenon may be harnessed in order to transmute base rocks into superior alloys.

## WENKWORT_PROJECT_DESC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AWENKWORT_PROJECT_DESC&lang=en)

### 中文

[event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]的表面上留下了圆形的山脊，优雅地环绕着无数的火山口和山脉。这一设计是否具有什么用意？这里与这个恒星系内的$wenkwort_drone_plural$之间到底有什么关系？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3205`

### English

Circular ridges have been impressed upon the surface of [event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName], sweeping elegantly around its myriad craters and mountains. Is there some purpose to their design? What relation might there be to the $wenkwort_drone_plural$ in this system?

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3711`

## federations3.135.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.135.name&lang=en)

### 中文

[event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]之山河

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3206`

### English

Mountains and Rivers of [event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3712`

## federations3.135.human.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.135.human.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

若非庞大的规模以及与[Owner.Capital.GetName]之间遥远的距离，§Y[event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]§!可能会被误认为是一座我们所建造的禅境。它的地表是一座宏大而风格独特的景观，点缀着无数小至卵石，大如陨星的岩石。我们的学者注意到，其水体与陆地的外观呈现具有一种算术精确性。虽然无碍美观，但其确实偏离了自然的形态，而更像一种刻意的模仿。\n\n无论其来源几何，这颗精心雕琢的星球与最近其表现上涌现的§Y$wenkwort_drone_plural$§!具有明确的关联。目前为止，追溯它们来源的努力仍未得出任何结果。\n\n也许我们被引到这颗禅境星球是一种暗示，这意味着我们日益增长的问题会在适当的时候被解答。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3207`

### English

Were it not for its sheer scale and remoteness from [Owner.Capital.GetName], §Y[event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]§! might be mistaken for a zen garden of our own making. Its surface is a vast, stylized landscape punctuated with rocks which range in size from small boulders to landed asteroids. Our scholars note an algorithmic precision to its apparent depictions of water and land. It remains decorative, but somehow divorced from natural forms - like a studied imitation.\n\nWhatever its origin, there is a clear link between this sculpted world and the §Y$wenkwort_drone_plural$§! which recently emerged from its surface. Our attempts to backtrace their origin have, however, yielded no results.\n\nPerhaps our being led to this zen planet is a hint - that answers to our growing stack of questions may reveal themselves in due time.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3713`

## federations3.135.nonhuman.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.135.nonhuman.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

[event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]上巨大的几何形式显然不是自然形成的。这颗行星上别具一格的景观是无尽的沙海，上面点缀着无数小至卵石，大如陨星的岩石。\n\n我们的研究院认为，这种景观应该是一种艺术作品，或是一种仪式的产品。然而，唯一可能造成这些的只有我们此前发现的§Y$wenkwort_drone_plural$§!。目前为止，追溯它们来源的努力仍未得出任何结果。也许只能等待时间给我们答案……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3208`

### English

The vast, geometric forms on [event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName] are certainly not of natural origin. The planet's stylized landscape is reminiscent of a vast and dusty sea, punctuated with rocks which range in size from small boulders to landed asteroids.\n\nOur researchers conclude that this landscape is likely an art piece, or else is part of some ritual practice - however, the only perpetrators appear to be the §Y$wenkwort_drone_plural$§! we saw earlier. Our attempts to backtrace their origin have yielded no results. Perhaps time will tell...

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3714`

## relicrails_digsite

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Arelicrails_digsite&lang=en)

### 中文

轨路遗迹

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3212`

### English

Relic Rails

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3719`

## relicrails_digsite_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Arelicrails_digsite_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

最近，[From.Planet.GetName]上的地陷将其地下的交通隧道网揭露了出来。这些精致的道路和复杂的信号设施已经深埋地下数百年；它们的设计与我们之前在这片太空区域所发现的一切均不相同。究竟是谁为了什么建造了它们呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3213`

### English

Recent cave-ins on [From.Planet.GetName] have revealed a network of underground transportation tunnels. Its elaborate archways and complex signalling equipment have lain undiscovered for centuries; their design is unlike anything else we've encountered in this region of space. Who built it, and why?

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3720`

## federations3.1005.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.1005.name&lang=en)

### 中文

地下室位移

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3214`

### English

Basement Shift

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3721`

## federations3.1005.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.1005.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上最新建设计划被深层地陷打断了。伤亡不大，并且我们的基础设施没有受到太大影响。然而该地质活动揭露了一座地下交通网络的一角。尴尬的测量师们已经开始勘察这些突然出现的隧道。似乎这属于[From.Planet.GetName]过去的历史……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3215`

### English

Deep-level cave-ins have shaken our newest building project on [From.Planet.GetName]. Casualties were minimal, and none of our primary infrastructure was affected. This geological activity has, however, revealed part of a network of transportation tunnels. Embarrassed surveyors have already begun looking into their sudden appearance. It would seem [From.Planet.GetName] has a prior history...

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3722`

## federations3.1010.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.1010.name&lang=en)

### 中文

站点贮藏

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3216`

### English

Depot Deposits

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3723`

## federations3.1010.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.1010.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

发掘进行没多久，设计更为错综、建造更加牢靠的隧道和设备就显露了出来。宽轨铁轨与卧铺列车保存状况良好，周围还有各式各样的遗物以及扔了几个世纪的垃圾。\n\n在这些残骸中留有各种经过精心阳极氧化处理的引擎和信号设施部件，和§Y维修站§!里会有的东西一样。所有部件上都刻有精致而复杂的几何图样，或许这其中有高级的艺术技巧，甚至曾令人引以为豪。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3217`

### English

It wasn't long before our excavations revealed tunnels and equipment of sturdier construction and more intricate design. Heavy-gauge rails and sleepers lie preserved and intact, surrounded by myriad relics and centuries-old garbage.\n\nAmongst the debris lie various precisely-anodized pieces of engine and signalling equipment, such as one might find in a §Ymaintenance depot§!. All are inscribed in singular detail with complex, geometric patterns - suggesting high levels of artistry and perhaps even pride.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3724`

## federations3.1015.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.1015.name&lang=en)

### 中文

访客全副武装

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3218`

### English

The Well-Armed Visitor

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3725`

## federations3.1015.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.1015.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在对一条狭窄辅道试探性发掘时，找到了一个死去多时的爬行动物，死因是大约§Y800年§!前发生的顶板塌陷。遗体出现在这条隧道里的原因一开始是个谜题，但我们在对其身上携带的许多武器进行研究后找到了答案。\n\n发现的带刃工具中有许多挂在一顶装饰性盾牌的内侧，制造这些工具的技术和我们比起来只能算原始，但却与在隧道轨路上使用的技术明显不同。这位带着盾牌的来访者如同我们一样，并不属于这颗星球，而且看起来还在进行与我们类似的考古研究，直至在隧道中丧生为止。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3219`

### English

Our chance excavation of a narrow side-tunnel has revealed a long-dead reptilian occupant, whose demise by ceiling collapse dates back some §Y800 years§!. Their presence in this tunnel was something of a puzzle, solved only when we completed a study of the many weapons found on their person.\n\nThe technology underlying these bladed implements - many of which were mounted on the inside of a decorative targe - is primitive compared to our own, yet markedly different to that used on the railroad. This targe-bearing visitor was as alien to this world as we are, and they seem to have been conducting similar archaeological research - that is, before the tunnel claimed their life.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3726`

## federations3.1020.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.1020.name&lang=en)

### 中文

负盾者

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3221`

### English

The Targe-Bearer

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3728`

## federations3.1020.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.1020.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

负盾者的记录把我们带到了一座§Y变电站§!，这座变电站曾经用于维持这个维修场。看起来他们的探险打破了该设施的气密封印；这里很少有腐烂的迹象。布满灰尘的电缆管道在几十个监视器周围形成柱廊。正是在这样一个通道上，我们发现了残留的来自§Y另一感性物种的§!遗迹。\n\n负盾者的探险队称这是一群软体动物技术人员——他们仍然保存完好的尸体挤在一起，以相互保护或取暖。记录中还记录了两次试图重新启动这个有千年历史的变电站的尝试，但使用的工具都不如我们的。我们有机会完成这项工作，这样做会使进一步的挖掘工作更容易。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3222`

### English

The Targe-bearer's notes have led us to an §Yelectrical substation§! which once served this maintenance yard. It looks like their expedition broke an atmospheric seal on the facility; there are comparatively few signs of decay here. Dust-covered cable ducts form colonnades around dozens of monitors. It is down one such aisle of monitors that we found trace remains from §Ysentients of a different species§!.\n\nThe Targe-bearer's expedition described this as a group of molluscoid technicians - their still-preserved bodies huddled together for mutual protection or warmth. The records also note two attempts to restart the millennia-old substation, using tools which are inferior to ours. There's a chance we could complete this effort - and in so doing, make further excavation much easier.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3729`

## federations3.1021.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.1021.name&lang=en)

### 中文

不幸的线圈

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3223`

### English

Tragic Coil

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3730`

## federations3.1021.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.1021.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

就在我们利用一台便携式相位发生器，从[From.Planet.GetName]上启动变电站的几分钟后，该设施突然响起刺耳的警报。几秒钟后，就在我们的挖掘小组工作的地方，部分天花板和铁路旁边的一段墙壁坍塌了。\n\n故障已经被追踪到一个我们以为它是不相连的§R腐蚀的电阻器线圈§!。这一疏忽造成了几人受伤，并决定了我们挖掘队十多名队员的命运；他们现在正步上了负盾者的悲惨的后尘。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3224`

### English

Mere minutes after we jump-started the substation on [From.Planet.GetName] using a portable phase generator, the facility erupted with piercing alarms. Seconds later, part of the ceiling and a section of wall adjoining the railroad collapsed, right where our excavation team was working.\n\nThe fault has been traced to a §Rcorroded resistor coil§!, which we'd thought disconnected. This oversight caused several injuries and has sealed the fates of a dozen members of our dig team; they now follow in the Targe-bearer's tragic footsteps.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3731`

## federations3.1022.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.1022.name&lang=en)

### 中文

进入不同的轨路

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3225`

### English

Onto a Different Track

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3732`

## federations3.1022.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.1022.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

这个变电站遗迹的复杂性让我们吃惊。我们用一台便携式相位发生器启动了它，但随之而来的爆炸活动导致我们周围有千年历史的建筑部分坍塌。\n\n幸运的是，我们的队伍得到了足够的预警，找到了避险处。他们发现一些地区现在已经被完全封锁，但一些新的地区已经取而代之地开放。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3226`

### English

This relic of a substation has surprised us with its complexity. We jump-started it using a portable phase generator, but the ensuing burst of activity caused parts of the millennia-old structure around us to collapse.\n\nFortunately our team had sufficient warning to find shelter. They emerged to find some areas now firmly closed off, but some new areas have opened in their stead.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3733`

## federations3.1026.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.1026.name&lang=en)

重新上线

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3227`

### English

Back in Service

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3734`

## federations3.1026.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.1026.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们对这个挖掘地点的意外“改造”暴露了一条长距离的铁路隧道，根据我们破译的控制面板，一列火车躺在那里，隐藏在侧边。同时，这个系统也对列车应用了不同的优先级标记，包括一个我们称之为“§Y仓库§!”的词。\n\n因为很少有一个关键的人工制品以这样大的形式出现在我们面前，我们派去一个团队让火车再次启动。古董火车头本身就是一件足够优雅的工程，但它背后每一辆精心装饰的汽车都被证明是一座博物馆。\n\n火车最好被理解为一个漫游的时间胶囊，随时准备被移动到安全的地方。三千年来，它保存了整个现在我们知道他们管自己叫做叫做§Y皮耶普§!的文化的历史、文化和科学记录。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3228`

### English

Our accidental remodelling of this dig site exposed a long-distance rail tunnel down which - according to the control panels we deciphered - a train lay, tucked away in sidings. Those same systems had applied various priority markers to the train, including a word we've identified as '§Yrepository§!.'\n\nA team was dispatched to get the train moving again, for rarely does a key artifact come to us in a form as large as this. The antique locomotive is an elegant enough piece of engineering in itself, but every one of the elaborately-decorated cars behind it has proven to be a museum in its own right.\n\nThe train may best be described as a roaming time capsule, ever ready to be moved out of harm's way. For 3,000 years it has preserved the historical, cultural and scientific records of an entire culture, whom we now learn called themselves the §YPeeyeps§!.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3735`

### English

## federations3.1027.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.1027.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

我们对这个挖掘地点的意外改造暴露了一个货场，它是从一个巨大的拱形洞穴屋顶下凿出来的。在它众多巨大而空无一人的仓库中，只有留下了一个安全封条没有启封；在重新打开的时候，我们发现了更多的负盾者的尸体。他们来这里寻找补给，却与一个有千年历史的警报系统发生冲突。\n\n根据他们留下的日志，这个巡回的§Y芬鲁尼尔远征队§!正在调查[From.Planet.GetName]是否为宜居世界。他们没有料到会在这里发现废墟。由于没有受过训练，对考古学也不感兴趣，他们对遗址进行了彻底的搜查，而不是进行调查。\n\n那些在仓库里挨饿的人用特别生动的语言指出，他们的同志把大量的物资运到货船上，几乎没留下什么。我们自己的调查证实，尽管有大量的古董机器，但几乎没有什么东西能告诉我们这些神秘的铁路建造者是谁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3231`

### English

Our accidental remodelling of this dig site has exposed a goods yard, hewn from under a vast and vaulted cave roof. Of its many vast and vacant warehouses, only one had its security seals tripped; upon re-opening it we found the remains of more of the Targe-bearer's people. They had come seeking supplies, only to fall foul of a millennia-old alarm system.\n\nAccording to the logs they left behind, this itinerant '§YFenrunir Expeditionary Group§!' was investigating [From.Planet.GetName] as part of a habitable worlds survey. They hadn't anticipated finding ruins here. Untrained and uninterested in archaeology, they ransacked the site rather than investigating it.\n\nThose who met with starvation inside the warehouse note - in particularly colorful language - that their comrades removed a great deal of material to their freighters, leaving little behind. Our own surveys confirm that although there is an abundance of antique machinery, little else remains to tell us who the enigmatic railroad-builders were.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3738`

## federations3.1030.name

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.1030.name&lang=en)

### 中文

铁路与避难

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3232`

### English

Rails and Refuge

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3739`

## federations3.1030.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afederations3.1030.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

来自[From.From.Planet.GetName]的铁路建造者留下的记录告诉我们这群狂热的软体动物是如何逃离他们对恐惧科技的家园，通过机械化的努力来寻求更好的自我。他们撤退到一个神秘而遥远的§Y地下洞穴网络§!，后来通过铁路隧道连接和扩大了它们的栖息地。\n\n由于担心他们的文化有一天会被猎杀和消灭，皮耶普人为了安全在地下修建。在接下来的200年里，他们的社会发展缓慢，在此期间，他们的家乡的政府变得更加孤立和偏执。一次激进的转变就促使他们以前所未有的规模进行军事化；就在这时，编年史突然结束了。\n\n即使有了随后的负盾者自己不完整的发现，我们也只能推测两国人民的悲惨命运。进一步的考古证据要么丢失了，要么没有记录下来；现在唯一剩下的就是他们的隧道，他们的记录和他们的火车。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3233`

### English

The records left by the railroad-builders of [From.From.Planet.GetName] tell how this fervent band of molluscoids fled their technophobic homeland, seeking to better themselves through mechanical endeavor. They retreated to a secret and distant network of §Yunderground caves§!, later linking and expanding their habitats by means of railroad tunnels.\n\nFearful that their very culture may one day be hunted and eradicated, the Peeyeps built deep - for security and preservation. Their society grew slowly over the next 200 years, during which time their homeland's government turned more insular and paranoid. A single, radical swing provoked them into militarization on an unprecedented scale; at this point the chronicle ends abruptly.\n\nEven with the Targe-bearer's own subsequent, patchy findings, we can only speculate upon the tragic fates of both peoples. Further archaeological evidence has either been lost or gone unrecorded; all that remains of the Peeyeps now are their tunnels, their records and their trains.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3740`

## peeyeps_legacy_desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Apeeyeps_legacy_desc&lang=en)

### 中文

重新发现的巨大的，古老的铁路系统已经点燃了我们的研究者的想象力。

## fedel.899.desc

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.899.desc&lang=en)

### 中文

用以决出联邦领袖的黄金律挑战赛将在数日后举行。由当前的联邦领袖开始，联邦中的每个帝国都有机会进行投标，直至仅剩一个参与国为止。这一投标国就是被选出的联邦领袖。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3285`

### English

In a few days the Golden Rule challenge for federation leadership will commence. Starting with the current leader: each empire in the federation will have a chance to place bids, until only one participant remains. That bidder is then elected leader of the federation.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3803`

## fedel.899.desc.subject

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3Afedel.899.desc.subject&lang=en)

$fedel.899.desc$\n\n不幸的是，由于我们不是一个独立的国家，我们被禁止参加，因为我们没有资格领导联邦。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/federations_l_simp_chinese.yml:3286`

### English

$fedel.899.desc$\n\nUnfortunately, as we are not an independent state, we are barred from participation as we are not eligible to lead the federation.

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3804`

依据黄金律挑战赛的规则，[Root.GetName]被委任为联邦领袖。恭喜！\n\n接下来要做的第一件事，就是决定用这些“奖金”来做些什么。奖金总额为£energy£§G[bidding_federation_leader.current_pot_variable]§!。\n\n§R注意：某些强制税款和费用可能适用，这会明显改变实际给出的数额。§!

### English

[Root.GetName] has been appointed Federation Leader in accordance with the rules for the Golden Rule challenge. Congratulations!\n\nThe first order of business is to decide what will happen with the 'prize money'. The current sum is £energy£ §G[bidding_federation_leader.current_pot_variable]§!.\n\n§RNote that some mandatory taxes and fees will apply, effectively altering the sum before pay-out.§!

Source: `localisation/english/federations_l_english.yml:3822`
